paper.title: On-Policy Delta Distillation for Multilingual Math Reasoning
paper.abstract: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) is emerging as a promising alternative to reinforcement learning for LLM post-training, yet its effectiveness in multilingual settings remains underexplored. We study OPD and its advanced variant, On-Policy Delta Distillation (OPD$^2$), for mathematical reasoning in English, Korean, and Japanese. OPD$^2$ improves OPD by using the probability gap between a post-trained teacher and its base model as the learning signal. Experiments with Qwen3 show that OPD$^2$ consiste

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是：on-policy distillation 这类替代 RL 的后训练方法，在多语言数学推理里是否仍然有效，尤其是对韩语、日语这类非英语语言，token 级蒸馏信号到底是在提升目标语言推理，还是只是把英语推理能力迁移并外溢到别的语言表面上。论文进一步聚焦 OPD2 的 delta signal 设计，即不用 teacher-student 的概率差，而用 post-trained teacher 相对其 base model 的概率增量作为监督，试图把“后训练新增的推理能力”从 teacher 原本已有的通用语言分布里剥离出来。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在于提出新的 pretrain objective，而在于它把 pretrain 与 post-train 的接口问题讲得更具体：如果 teacher 的能力增量可以通过 delta signal 被更干净地提取，那么后训练得到的推理能力就更像一种可迁移的“残差信号”，而不是把 teacher 的全部分布偏好一并蒸馏过去。这个视角对 reasoning-oriented continual pretraining、mid-training、以及用强 teacher 反哺 base model 都有启发。另一个重要点是，论文提醒多语言增益不能只看 benchmark 分数；英语-only 蒸馏能抬高韩语/日语成绩，但可能伴随 reasoning trace 英文化，这说明语言能力迁移和目标语言建模质量不是一回事。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上延续 OPD / OPD2 框架。OPD 的基本做法是：学生模型先按当前策略生成 rollout，再把这条 student trajectory 喂给 teacher，在每个已采样 token 上取 teacher 的条件概率，对学生做 token-level KL 或等价的 token reward 优化。这样做和 sequence-level RL 不同，监督更细，且仍保持 on-policy。OPD2 的改动很小但针对性很强：奖励不再是 log p_teacher(y_t|x,y_<t) - log p_student(y_t|x,y_<t)，而是 log p_teacher - log p_teacher_base。也就是把 teacher 相对其 base 的增量当作监督信号。这样做的动机是减少 teacher 中那些 base 已经具备的通用语言偏好、风格偏好、格式偏好对蒸馏的干扰，把学习重点放在 post-training 新获得的 reasoning preference 上。论文还沿用了 OPD2 原始工作里的两个稳定化部件：一是 reward centering，把 reward 转成 advantage 以缓解收敛点问题；二是用原始 OPD 信号做 conditioning criterion，避免 delta signal 单独使用时训练目标过于脆弱。实验设置上，作者构造了英/韩/日三语数学训练集，总规模 100K，考察多种语言配比与 EN-only 训练情形，核心比较对象是 OPD 与 OPD2 在 Qwen3 系列 instruction-tuned 模型上的表现差异。
summary.experiments: 从正文可确认的关键信息有三点。第一，训练数据是一个 100K 规模的多语言数学数据集，覆盖 English、Korean、Japanese，用来做 on-policy post-training。第二，结论上 OPD2 在多语言设置里稳定优于原始 OPD，且在韩语、日语上的提升更明显，说明 delta signal 在非英语推理迁移里更有用。第三，OPD2 往往能缩小 English 与 Korean 的性能差距，但这种 gap closing 不是所有模型和设置都一致成立，作者对此保持了克制。另一个实验观察很重要：只用英语数据做 OPD，也能提高韩语和日语 benchmark 分数，但生成分析显示，模型常把中间推理过程部分切换到英语，说明分数提升里混入了跨语言推理 trace 泄漏，而不完全是目标语言 reasoning 真正增强。由于给出的全文片段没有包含完整表格和具体数值，无法可靠复述每个模型、每个 benchmark 的精确提升幅度；但论文的主要实验价值不在绝对分数，而在于把 multilingual OPD 的收益与语言漂移副作用同时揭示出来。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction，重点抓三个研究问题：OPD2 是否仍优于 OPD、是否缩小语言差距、EN-only OPD 是否真的提升目标语言推理。然后看 On-Policy Distillation 一节，弄清 OPD 与 OPD2 的 reward 定义差别，这是一切实验现象的解释起点。实验部分建议优先看主表和作者对生成样例的分析，尤其是非英语输入下 reasoning trace 是否混入英语。这个现象比单纯分数更值得看。预计 15 到 25 分钟可以抓住主要信息；如果只关心方法，不必深究附录里的全部 benchmark 细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether on-policy distillation remains effective for multilingual mathematical reasoning, especially in Korean and Japanese, and whether the gains reflect genuine target-language reasoning improvement or merely transfer of English-centric reasoning behavior. It further studies OPD2, where the supervision signal is the probability gap between a post-trained teacher and its base model, rather than the gap between teacher and student.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining researchers is indirect but real. The work sharpens the pretrain–post-train interface: if the useful part of post-training can be isolated as a delta over the base model, then reasoning capability may be distilled as a cleaner residual signal instead of copying the teacher’s full distribution. That matters for continual pretraining, mid-training, and teacher-assisted capability transfer. The multilingual findings are also important: benchmark gains alone can be misleading, because English-only distillation may improve Korean/Japanese scores while shifting the reasoning trace toward English.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method follows the OPD / OPD2 line. In OPD, the student first samples a rollout from its current policy. That sampled trajectory is then scored token by token by the teacher, and the student is updated to reduce the discrepancy on the sampled tokens. Compared with sequence-level RL, this gives denser token-level supervision while preserving the on-policy nature. OPD2 changes the reward definition: instead of using log p_teacher minus log p_student, it uses log p_teacher minus log p_teacher_base. The motivation is to isolate capabilities acquired during post-training, especially reasoning, while suppressing generic language preferences and stylistic biases already present in the teacher’s base model. The paper also keeps the two stabilizers introduced in prior OPD2 work: reward centering to form an advantage-like signal, and a conditioning criterion based on the original OPD signal to avoid pathological convergence. Empirically, the study builds a 100K multilingual math training set in English, Korean, and Japanese, and compares multilingual OPD and OPD2 as well as English-only OPD on Qwen3 instruction-tuned models.
summary_en.experiments: Three findings are clear from the full text provided. First, the training corpus contains 100K multilingual math problems spanning English, Korean, and Japanese. Second, OPD2 consistently outperforms vanilla OPD in multilingual settings, with stronger gains in Korean and Japanese than in English. Third, OPD2 often narrows the English–Korean gap, though the effect is not universal across all models and settings. A particularly useful observation is that English-only OPD can still raise Korean and Japanese benchmark scores, but qualitative inspection shows that the model often drifts into English during the reasoning process. That means some of the measured gain comes from cross-lingual reasoning-trace leakage rather than improved target-language reasoning per se. The excerpt does not include the full result tables, so precise benchmark-by-benchmark numbers cannot be stated reliably here.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and focus on the three research questions: whether OPD2 still beats OPD, whether it reduces language gaps, and what English-only OPD is actually doing. Then read the OPD formulation carefully; the difference between the OPD reward and the OPD2 delta reward explains most of the empirical behavior. In the experiments, prioritize the main result tables and any qualitative examples showing language drift in the chain of thought. That analysis is more informative than the headline scores. A quick but useful read should take about 15–25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 OPD² 的 delta 目标和跨语言消融；若结论稳，后训练信号应从“模仿强模型”转向“模仿增量”。
recommendation.en: Read the OPD² delta objective and multilingual ablations; if robust, post-training targets should imitate the teacher’s gain, not the teacher distribution.

paper.title: When Teachers Mislead: Spurious-Signal-Aware On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-Policy distillation (OPD) transfers teacher capabilities by supervising student-sampled trajectories with dense token-level teacher signals. Recent selective OPD methods improve this process by prioritizing signals that are confident, informative, or learnable. However, the assumptions overlook a fundamental failure mode of language models: their token-level judgments can be driven by input-agnostic language priors, formatting conventions, or stereotyped reasoning templates rather than task-s

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理 on-policy distillation 中的一个信号质量问题：teacher 的高置信 token 监督可能来自语言先验、格式偏好或套路化推理模板，而不是来自当前输入。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值在于训练信号诊断。OPD 把学生模型自己的采样轨迹交给 teacher 做 dense token-level 监督，能减轻离线蒸馏的分布错配。但 dense 信号也会放大 teacher 的偏置。已有选择性 OPD 多按置信度、熵、teacher-student divergence 或可学习性来筛 token；这些指标衡量信号强不强、难不难学，却不判断信号是否由输入支撑。SA-OPD 把“groundedness”引入蒸馏目标，对 reasoning distillation、VLM 蒸馏和 RL-style token-level supervision 都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: SA-OPD 保留 OPD 的基本流程：学生模型按当前策略生成回答，teacher 在学生访问到的前缀上给出 token 级分布，训练通常使用 reverse-KL 一类目标。论文把 token 级 teacher-student divergence 分解为两部分：随输入变化的 grounded component，以及只由生成前缀、语言先验和模板偏好解释的 prior component。实际实现不需要外部 verifier。对同一条学生生成轨迹，方法分别计算原始输入上下文下的 divergence，以及移除任务输入、只保留生成前缀的 residual no-prompt context 下的 divergence。如果移除输入后 divergence 基本不变，说明该监督更像输入无关的语言偏好。SA-OPD 只过滤同时满足两个条件的 token：输入 groundedness 低，且 teacher-student divergence 绝对值高。这样避免过度丢弃弱信号，主要移除那些梯度大但任务方向可疑的更新。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 LLM 和 VLM 蒸馏场景，包括数学推理、视觉理解和视觉推理基准。论文报告 SA-OPD 稳定优于 Vanilla OPD，也优于按置信度、信息量、可学习性等准则设计的选择性 OPD baseline。给定内容没有提供完整数字表，因此不能确认具体提升幅度。更有信息量的实验点是消融逻辑：只看 divergence 会保留很多模板信号；只看 groundedness 又可能丢掉低影响 token；二者联合筛选更贴近“去掉有害高梯度”的目标。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30 到 40 分钟。先看 Method 中输入移除前后 divergence 的定义，确认 groundedness proxy 是如何计算的；再看 token filtering 条件，尤其是为什么要同时要求低 groundedness 和高 divergence。实验部分重点看与 Vanilla OPD、selective OPD baseline 的对比，以及数学和视觉任务是否呈现一致趋势。若关注 RLHF、RLAIF 或 reasoning distillation，可以进一步看该方法是否能迁移到 reward model token attribution 或 verifier 信号过滤。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a signal-quality failure mode in on-policy distillation: a teacher’s strong token-level supervision may be driven by language priors, formatting habits, or stereotyped reasoning templates rather than by the current input.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is most relevant to training-signal diagnostics. OPD trains on trajectories sampled from the current student policy and applies dense teacher supervision at student-visited states, reducing the distribution mismatch of offline distillation. The cost is that dense supervision can amplify teacher biases. Existing selective OPD methods use confidence, entropy, teacher-student divergence, or learnability to decide which signals to trust. These criteria measure strength or ease of learning, but not whether the signal is input-grounded. SA-OPD adds this missing axis, which is useful for reasoning distillation, VLM distillation, and RL-style token-level supervision.
summary_en.technical_approach: SA-OPD keeps the standard OPD setup. The student samples an on-policy response, and the frozen teacher provides token-level distributions at the prefixes visited by the student. The usual objective is based on a reverse-KL-style teacher-student comparison. The paper conceptually decomposes token-level divergence into an input-grounded component and an input-agnostic prior component. The practical proxy is simple: compute the divergence under the original prompt, then compute it again under a residual no-prompt context that removes the task input while keeping the generated prefix. If the divergence barely changes after removing the input, the signal is likely explained by generic language priors or template preference. SA-OPD filters only tokens with both low input-groundedness and high absolute teacher-student divergence, targeting large but weakly justified updates rather than broadly suppressing supervision.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers both LLM and VLM distillation, including mathematical reasoning, visual understanding, and visual reasoning benchmarks. The paper reports consistent improvements over Vanilla OPD and competitive selective OPD baselines based on confidence, informativeness, or learnability. The provided text does not include the full numerical tables, so exact gains cannot be verified here. The important experimental idea is the filtering ablation: divergence alone keeps many template-driven signals, while groundedness alone may remove low-impact tokens; combining low groundedness with high divergence better matches the goal of removing harmful high-gradient supervision.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30–40 minutes. Start with the method section defining divergence under the original input and under the no-prompt residual context. Then inspect the filtering rule and the rationale for combining low groundedness with high divergence. In the experiments, focus on comparisons against Vanilla OPD and selective OPD baselines, and check whether the same pattern holds in both language-only and vision-language settings. For work on RLHF, RLAIF, or reasoning distillation, the transferable idea is to test whether dense supervision is grounded in the input before trusting its gradient.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫方法部分：它把“teacher 高置信”拆成 grounded 与 spurious，两者对蒸馏梯度的差别可迁移到 RLVR 数据筛选。
recommendation.en: Skim the method: separating high-confidence teacher signals into grounded versus spurious ones is a useful lens for RLVR and distillation data filtering.

paper.title: Distill What the Student Can See: Fisher-Projected On-Policy Distillation for Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) samples trajectories from the current student policy and minimizes token-level divergence between student and teacher next-token distributions at prefixes along those trajectories. This aligns the distillation states with the student's own generation distribution. However, it still assumes that the complete teacher distribution is an appropriate target across student capacities. In vision--language reasoning, teacher corrections can depend on visual distinctions that

summary.core_problem: FP-OPD 解决的是 VLM on-policy distillation 中“状态对齐了，但目标不一定适合学生模型”的问题。OPD 用学生自己生成的轨迹做蒸馏，缓解了训练前缀与推理前缀不一致。但在视觉语言推理中，大教师的 token 分布可能依赖学生无法表征的视觉证据。直接让小学生匹配完整教师分布，可能要求它学习超出自身视觉表示能力的修正。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练和中后期训练的启发在于：教师信号不是越完整越好，训练目标需要匹配学生模型当前可表达的局部几何。这个结论适用于 VLM 蒸馏，也可能影响小模型继续预训练、multimodal mid-training、以及用强模型生成监督信号的流程。它提供了一个比简单调低 KL 权重更细的方案：不是整体削弱教师，而是保留学生能通过自身视觉通路表达的那部分修正。
summary.technical_approach: 方法沿用 OPD 的 on-policy 轨迹：学生先生成回答轨迹，教师和学生都在这些学生访问过的 prefix 上输出 full-vocabulary 分布。标准 OPD 直接最小化学生分布到教师分布的 token-level reverse KL。FP-OPD 改动的是 target，而不是训练轨迹或损失形式。它先把教师监督表示为相对于学生 log-probability 的 correction，然后用 detached perturbation probes 估计学生当前的局部视觉响应空间。KL 在局部诱导 Fisher metric，因此方法在 Fisher 几何下把教师 correction 投影到学生可表达的视觉响应空间中，得到 reachable target q^R。训练时仍使用标准 full-vocabulary reverse KL，只是把完整教师分布替换成 q^R。与简单温度、label smoothing 或统一缩放 teacher target 不同，FP-OPD 会按学生局部表示能力选择性保留教师修正。
summary.experiments: 论文先做 target-scaling 诊断实验。对于 8B 教师到 2B 学生的设置，当插值强度 α=0.5 时，学生一个 epoch 后能消除 56.3% 的指定 KL gap；使用完整教师目标 α=1 时只消除 46.6%。同一中间目标还将 MathVista Geometry 从 55.29 提升到 57.03，说明完整教师分布更难拟合，并且未必带来更好的下游推理。主实验显示，在 8B-to-2B 蒸馏中，FP-OPD 在 7 个 benchmark 上均有提升，平均分相比 base student 提高 2.77 分，相比标准 OPD 提高 1.60 分。论文还报告了不同教师规模和教师变体下的稳定收益。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读约 25 到 35 分钟。先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，重点是 target interpolation 实验，它是整篇工作的动机支点。然后看 Method 和 Figure 2，理解 Fisher projection 如何从教师分布构造 q^R。公式部分不需要逐行推导，但要看清楚 correction、visual response space、Fisher metric 三者的关系。实验部分重点看 8B-to-2B 主结果、target scaling、projection ablation，以及不同教师变体的结果。

summary_en.core_problem: FP-OPD addresses a target mismatch in on-policy distillation for vision-language models. OPD samples trajectories from the current student, so supervision is applied at prefixes the student actually visits. However, sharing the same prefix does not guarantee that the complete teacher distribution is a suitable target. In VLM reasoning, teacher corrections may rely on visual evidence that a compact student cannot represent.
summary_en.importance: The main training lesson is that stronger teacher targets are not always better for smaller multimodal students. The useful signal is the part of the teacher correction that lies within the student’s current response geometry. This matters for VLM distillation, multimodal mid-training, and synthetic supervision pipelines where large models provide dense token-level targets. The paper offers a more structured alternative to simply reducing the KL weight or interpolating the teacher distribution uniformly.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method keeps the OPD protocol: the student rolls out an on-policy trajectory, and both student and teacher are evaluated on the resulting prefixes. Standard OPD minimizes a full-vocabulary token-level reverse KL to the complete teacher distribution. FP-OPD changes only the target. It represents the teacher signal as a correction to the student log-probabilities, estimates the student’s local visual response space using detached perturbation probes, and projects the teacher correction onto that space under the Fisher metric induced locally by KL. The projected correction defines a reachable target q^R, which replaces the full teacher distribution in the same reverse-KL loss. Unlike temperature scaling or uniform target weakening, the projection selectively keeps corrections that the student can express through its current visual pathway.
summary_en.experiments: A diagnostic target-scaling study shows the mismatch clearly. In an 8B-to-2B setting, a target interpolation strength of α=0.5 lets the student remove 56.3% of the prescribed KL gap after one epoch, while the complete teacher target at α=1 removes only 46.6%. The intermediate target also improves MathVista Geometry from 55.29 to 57.03. In the main experiments, FP-OPD improves all seven reported benchmarks for 8B-to-2B distillation, with an average gain of 2.77 points over the base student and 1.60 points over standard OPD. The paper also reports consistent gains across teacher scales and teacher variants.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 25 to 35 minutes. Read the introduction and Figure 1 first; the target interpolation experiment is the clearest evidence for the capacity-target mismatch. Then read the method figure and the projection derivation to understand how the reachable target q^R is constructed. The most informative experiments are the 8B-to-2B comparison, the target-scaling analysis, the projection ablations, and the teacher-variant results.

recommendation.zh: 这个 prior 值得改：蒸馏不该总追完整 teacher 分布；看 target-scaling 实验和投影定义。
recommendation.en: This changes a useful prior: distillation should not always chase the full teacher distribution; read the target-scaling study and projection definition.

paper.title: DAPD: Dual-Anchored Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy (self) distillation (OPSD) is increasingly adopted for language-model post-training. It strengthens the teacher with privileged information but can induce a privilege illusion: the student learns privilege-dependent behavior it cannot reproduce from its inference-time context, yet behaves as if the training-time privileged information remained available, ultimately degrading performance. In this paper, we identify information asymmetry between the privileged teacher and the student at

summary.core_problem: on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) 中，teacher 使用参考解、工具输出等推理时不可见的 privileged information 来加强监督，但 student 在推理时拿不到这些信息，产生 privilege illusion：模型表现得好像答案就在旁边，从而做出无依据断言、推理链漂移。现有方法要么直接蒸馏特权 teacher 的全部信号，要么做选择性过滤/重加权，但都没有从根本上解决 teacher 与 student 信息状态不对称的问题。
summary.importance: 论文把 privilege illusion 的机制讲清楚了：问题不是信号太多，而是信息条件不对等导致的“纠缠蒸馏”。这对当前 R1 范式下大量 on-policy 蒸馏、拒绝采样后再蒸馏的实践有直接参考价值。尤其值得注意的是观察到普通 OPSD 的收益随模型增大而消失，但 DAPD 的增益在 1.7B 到 32B 上保持稳定，说明信息不对称是缩放到更大模型时蒸馏退化的一个真实原因，而不只是小模型训练不足带来的噪声。
summary.technical_approach: DAPD 由两部分组成。第一部分是 Dual-Path Anchoring（DPA）：引入一个 self-conditioned 的桥接分布，让 student 在训练时同时构造两条对齐路径——无特权路径对齐“没有参考时的 reference 行为与 rollout 行为”，特权路径对齐“都能看到参考时的二者行为”。关键是两条路径都在 matched information 下做对齐，避免把 teacher 因特权信息产生的行为错误蒸馏给无特权条件下的 student。第二部分是 Dual-Source Anchoring（DSA）：reference 与 rollout 互为 teacher/student 双向蒸馏，既用参考解保证正确性，又用当前策略 rollout 保证指导信号在 student 可达区域内，避免 reference 偏离 student 当前策略分布导致蒸馏信号失真。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B/14B/32B 上测试，覆盖数学推理（MAA、HMMT）、代码、指令跟随共 6 个 benchmark。DAPD 在 Qwen3-4B 上相对 OPSD 平均提升 +2.00 分；更关键的是规模对比中，OPSD 收益随模型增大而衰减，DAPD 在 4B 提升 +2.69、32B 提升 +2.78，增益不缩。消融验证了两点：self-conditioned 桥接单独就能显著减少 unsupported claims，说明信息匹配是核心；双向 source anchoring 比单向 reference→rollout 更稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看 Introduction 中对信息不对称与 entangled distillation 的诊断、Figure 2 那个验证信息匹配起作用的对照实验，以及 ablation 部分。方法实现细节不是最有价值的部分，核心收获是机制判断和双锚点对齐的设计思路。预计阅读 20–30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) for LLM post-training, the teacher is often strengthened with privileged information such as reference completions or tool outputs that the student cannot access at inference time. This information asymmetry causes a privilege illusion: the student acts as if privileged context were still available, producing unsupported claims and degraded reasoning. Existing approaches either distill the privileged teacher directly or selectively filter/reweight its signal, but neither resolves the structural mismatch between teacher and student information states.
summary_en.importance: The paper gives a clean mechanistic diagnosis: privilege illusion arises not from too much supervision, but from entangled distillation under mismatched conditioning. This is directly relevant to current R1-style pipelines that rely heavily on on-policy sampling, rejection sampling, and teacher-guided distillation. A practically important finding is that vanilla OPSD gains vanish as model size grows, while DAPD gains remain stable from 1.7B to 32B, suggesting that information asymmetry is a genuine scaling-related failure mode rather than a small-model artifact.
summary_en.technical_approach: DAPD combines two anchoring mechanisms. Dual-Path Anchoring (DPA) introduces a self-conditioned bridge distribution and constructs two alignment paths under matched information: an unconditioned path aligns reference and rollout behavior when neither sees privileged information, and a privileged path aligns them when both do. This preserves dense OPSD supervision while avoiding the leak of privilege-dependent behavior into the student's inference-time policy. Dual-Source Anchoring (DSA) then applies the same alignment in both directions between reference and rollout, so references provide reliable correctness guidance and on-policy rollouts provide student-reachable guidance within the current policy support.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B/14B/32B across six benchmarks covering math reasoning (MAA, HMMT), coding, and instruction following. DAPD improves over OPSD by an average of +2.00 points on Qwen3-4B. More notably, across scales vanilla OPSD gains decay while DAPD maintains stable improvements: +2.69 at 4B and +2.78 at 32B. Ablations confirm that matching information access via the self-conditioned bridge alone substantially reduces unsupported assertions, and that bidirectional source anchoring is more robust than one-directional reference-to-rollout distillation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read. Focus on the diagnosis of information asymmetry and entangled distillation in the introduction, the controlled intervention in Figure 2 that validates the information-matching hypothesis, and the ablations on path/source effects. The implementation details are less important than the design principle. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 后训练蒸馏中特权幻觉的根因分析有参考价值，做SFT/RL蒸馏的可重点看§3的DPA设计。
recommendation.en: The root cause analysis of privilege illusion in post-training distillation is informative; those working on SFT/RL distillation can focus on the DPA design in §3.

paper.title: Cross-Domain Hybrid OPD for Generalizable Search Agents
paper.abstract: Recent advances in Reinforcement Learning (RL) have substantially improved the capabilities of autonomous search agents, enabling sophisticated planning, and iterative retrieval over dynamic information sources. However, optimizing language models for specialized search behaviors often incurs an alignment tax, where gains in search performance come at the expense of general-purpose capabilities, limiting their effectiveness as universal assistants. In this technical report, we present the traini

summary.core_problem: 面向搜索 agent 的强化学习会带来明显的能力偏移：搜索/规划/迭代检索能力提升的同时，通用指令遵循、对话、一般推理与生成能力出现退化。论文要解决的是如何在获得搜索专业化能力的同时，不付出这种通用能力对齐税。
summary.importance: 这是一篇工业界技术报告，核心价值不在提出新的训练算法，而在于给出一个"specialized RL 后接跨域专家 OPD 回补通用能力"的完整 recipe，对 pretrain ↔ posttrain 接口问题有参考价值：定向 RL 阶段会对基座能力造成怎样的分布偏移，以及如何通过多教师在线蒸馏在不覆盖新习得策略的前提下恢复/增强通用能力。对基座研究者更有意义的是其中关于"能力不是零和，关键是不要让专门化训练覆盖通用先验"的判断，以及多域教师混合蒸馏的工程实践。
summary.technical_approach: 训练框架基于 Hunyuan3 底座，分两阶段。第一阶段做 agentic RL，训练模型在动态信息源上进行自主规划、迭代检索、证据驱动推理等搜索行为。第二阶段做 cross-domain hybrid OPD：分别在数学、代码、逻辑推理、科学四个域构建大规模语料（公开 benchmark + 内部筛选/合成数据），训练对应的 expert teachers，然后用这些跨域专家做在线策略蒸馏，把多域通用推理与知识能力迁移回搜索特化后的模型。训练中还引入了按经验成功率划分的难度课程：数学/代码分 easy/medium/hard 三档，逻辑/科学分 medium/hard 两档，用于教师训练和 RL 课程。整体设计上，不是简单 SFT 回灌通用数据来修补 RL 损伤，而是在 RL 得到搜索策略后，用多专家 OPD 在学生自身访问的状态分布上注入通用能力，尽量避免把搜索策略覆盖掉。
summary.experiments: 论文给出的是 Yuanbao search agent 的整体训练方案报告。数据侧，四个专家域的训练语料覆盖 MATH、GSM8K、AQuA-RAT、APPS、LiveCodeBench、SynLogic、BBH、SciBench、SciQ、GPQA 等公开集，并配合内部构建/合成数据扩充长尾推理场景；训练侧使用 reference policy 的采样成功率将题目分 difficulty bucket 作为课程。主结论是混合训练后的模型在搜索 benchmark 上保持有竞争力的表现，同时在通用能力评测上相对 Hunyuan3 基座整体提升，说明搜索专门化和通用能力可以在该流程下同时改善而非互相抵消。论文为技术报告风格，消融和具体数值细节在节选内容里披露有限。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，预计 15–25 分钟。重点看 Introduction 与框架图里对 search RL 导致的 alignment tax 的刻画、整体两阶段 pipeline 的设计逻辑，以及数据/课程部分对多域专家教师数据构成和难度划分的描述。对 pretrain 读者，最值得看的是：专门化 RL 造成的通用能力损伤模式、为什么他们选择 OPD 而不是纯 SFT 回补、多教师混合时如何避免把新学的搜索策略洗掉。不需要抠具体 benchmark 数字，更多是把它当作一个工业界"特化 RL + 通用能力回填"的案例来读。
summary.authors_note: 腾讯元宝/Hunyuan 团队技术报告，基于 Hunyuan3 架构训练 Yuanbao 搜索 agent。

summary_en.core_problem: Reinforcement learning for autonomous search agents produces strong retrieval, planning, and multi-step search behaviors, but also induces capability drift: instruction following, conversational quality, general reasoning, and open-ended generation can degrade. The report targets how to obtain search specialization without paying that generic-capability alignment tax.
summary_en.importance: This is an industry technical report rather than a new algorithmic contribution. Its value lies in presenting a complete recipe of specialized agent RL followed by cross-domain expert on-policy distillation to restore and enhance general capabilities, which is directly relevant to the pretrain/posttrain interface: how targeted RL shifts distribution away from generic priors, and how multi-teacher OPD can inject broad capabilities without overwriting the newly acquired specialized policy. The useful claim for foundation-model researchers is that specialization and generalization need not be traded off if the post-RL capability-recovery stage is designed carefully, especially by using on-policy distillation on the student’s own state distribution instead of blunt supervised recovery.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework is built on Hunyuan3 and consists of two stages. First, agentic RL trains autonomous search behaviors such as planning, iterative retrieval, and evidence-based reasoning over dynamic environments. Second, cross-domain hybrid OPD is applied: large corpora are built for four domains—mathematics, coding, logical reasoning, and science—combining public benchmarks with internally curated or synthesized data; domain-specific expert teachers are trained on these corpora; then those teachers distill into the search-specialized model via on-policy distillation, transferring broad reasoning and knowledge capabilities while preserving the learned search policy. Difficulty-aware curriculum is used in teacher training and RL: problems are bucketed by empirical success rate of a reference policy into easy/medium/hard for math and coding, and medium/hard for logic and science. The design intentionally avoids naive post-RL SFT on generic data, which risks overwriting the search policy, and instead uses multi-expert OPD on states visited by the student.
summary_en.experiments: The paper is presented as a technical report for the Yuanbao search agent. On the data side, four expert-domain corpora cover public benchmarks including MATH, GSM8K, AQuA-RAT, APPS, LiveCodeBench, SynLogic, BBH, SciBench, SciQ, and GPQA, supplemented by internal/synthesized data for long-tail reasoning scenarios. On the training side, a reference policy’s sampling success rate is used to assign difficulty buckets and drive curriculum learning. The main reported outcome is that the resulting search agent remains highly competitive on search benchmarks while improving over the Hunyuan3 base model on a broad set of general-purpose evaluations, supporting the claim that search specialization and general capability can be improved jointly rather than traded off. Detailed ablations and precise numbers are limited in the excerpted material.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 15–25 minutes. Focus on the introduction and pipeline figure for their characterization of the alignment tax from search-oriented RL, the two-stage design logic, and the data/curriculum section describing multi-domain teacher corpora and difficulty bucketing. For a pretrain-oriented reader, the most useful parts are the failure mode induced by specialized RL, why OPD is preferred over plain SFT-based recovery, and how multi-teacher distillation is arranged to avoid overwriting the newly learned search policy. There is little need to dwell on exact benchmark scores; treat it as an industrial case study on specialized RL plus capability recovery.
summary_en.authors_note: Tencent Yuanbao / Hunyuan team technical report on the Yuanbao search agent, built on Hunyuan3.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 OPD 训练闭环和退化评测；若通用能力集不干净，结论只能当产品级信号。
recommendation.en: Read the OPD loop and degradation eval; if the general-skill set is leaky, treat the claim as product evidence.

paper.title: Look Ahead Before You Distill: Future Trajectory Validation of Teacher Guidance for Agentic On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides teacher supervision on states visited by the student, reducing the distribution gap between training and inference. However, in multi-turn agentic tasks, student deviations may accumulate over time, gradually moving the trajectory away from states where teacher guidance remains effective. Our quantitative analysis further shows that high-disagreement states offer promising opportunities for teacher guidance, but determining whether such guidance is beneficia

summary.core_problem: 多轮 agent 任务的在线策略蒸馏（on-policy distillation, OPD）中，学生一旦偏离教师有效指导区域，误差会沿轨迹累积；而仅用 teacher-student KL 等局部指标筛选干预点既不充分也不稳健，因为一部分高分歧位置的教师动作替换反而会让后续轨迹变差。
summary.importance: 对 post-train 阶段的 agent 蒸馏有直接参考价值，对 pretrain 研究者的启发主要在于两点：一是把"训练信号是否有益"从单步局部判断扩展到对后续轨迹影响的前瞻验证，这一思路与 pretrain 中数据筛选/课程设计里"look-ahead 数据价值估计"问题相通；二是量化揭示了在线分布漂移下监督信号密度如何变化，对理解长程 credit assignment 和分布匹配中的局部干预失效很有参考。整体属于方法增量，但实证观察有一定信息量。
summary.technical_approach: FTB（FutureBridge-OPD）分两步。第一步用 teacher-student 分歧（高 KL 位置）找候选干预点，这和已有基于分歧/置信度筛选信号的思路一致。第二步在候选点上执行一次"teacher bridge"——即用教师动作替换学生当前动作——然后让同一个学生策略从该状态继续 rollout 一小段 future continuation，通过观测后续轨迹中教师偏好 token / 正蒸馏信号的密度提升，来判断这次局部指导是否真的把学生推向了更适合蒸馏的区域，只有通过验证的干预才保留用于蒸馏。和 TCOD、Guided-OPD 这类通过 prefix 接管、课程深度调节来约束学生分布的方法不同，FTB 不强行改变 rollout 策略，而是做候选干预+未来效果验证；和单纯 KL 重加权/过滤不同，它把信号价值从当前步扩展到了诱导出的未来学生分布上。
summary.experiments: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld 三个多轮交互环境上评测。对 1000 条失败轨迹的诊断发现：在高 KL 位置做教师动作替换，约 31% 的轨迹最终奖励提升，显著高于随机位置替换的 6%，但仍有约 19% 的高 KL 干预使表现退化；教师动作采纳后，学生后续 continuation 中 teacher-preferred token 比例相对提升约 10.8%。主结果上，FTB 相对 vanilla OPD 平均成功率提升 16.6 个点，相对 TCOD-B2F 提升 7.6 个点，并且在不同学生规模和 teacher 设置下增益保持一致。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 里对失败轨迹的两段定量诊断（高 KL 干预的有效率与误杀率、teacher bridge 对后续分布的牵引）以及 Method 中 future continuation 的验证判据如何设计；Figure 1 的三个面板能快速抓住核心动机。如果关心 agent OPD 的训练细节，可以顺带看 TCOD B2F 课程与 sampled token estimator 的衔接，以及附录里 replay+replace+continue 的诊断实验设置。对 pretrain 读者来说，主要值得吸收的是"局部信号+未来验证"这个筛选范式本身，不必花太多时间在具体环境调参上。

summary_en.core_problem: In on-policy distillation for multi-turn agentic tasks, student errors compound over the trajectory and gradually push visitation into states where teacher guidance is no longer reliable; purely local criteria such as teacher-student KL can identify candidate intervention points, but they cannot reliably determine whether teacher intervention at those points will actually help or hurt future returns.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is to post-training for agentic policies, but two observations are useful more broadly for pretrain-style thinking about training-signal selection. First, it moves from per-step local filtering to a short-horizon future-validation of whether a candidate supervision signal improves the student’s future trajectory distribution, a pattern that parallels data-value estimation and curation in pretraining. Second, it quantifies how quickly student deviation erodes the usefulness of teacher guidance under on-policy drift. The method is incremental over existing OPD work, but the empirical characterization of intervention efficacy is informative.
summary_en.technical_approach: FutureBridge-OPD (FTB) operates in two stages. It first selects candidate intervention points using teacher-student disagreement (high-KL positions), similar in spirit to prior filtering or reweighting schemes. At each candidate point, it then executes a short teacher bridge by substituting the teacher action for the student action, and lets the same student policy continue rolling out from that bridged state. The induced future continuation is used to check whether the bridge increases the density of teacher-preferred / positive distillation signals downstream; only validated bridges are kept as distillation supervision. Unlike TCOD or Guided-OPD, which reshape the student state distribution through teacher prefixes, curriculum schedules, or adaptive rollout depth, FTB does not force teacher takeover. Unlike pure KL-based filtering, it evaluates supervision value by its effect on the future student trajectory rather than by local disagreement alone.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluation is on ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld. A diagnostic on 1,000 failed trajectories shows that replacing student actions at high-KL positions improves environment rewards on about 31% of trajectories, versus only 6% at random positions; even at high-KL positions, about 19% of teacher interventions degrade trajectory performance. After adopting a teacher action, the share of teacher-preferred tokens in the student continuation increases by about 10.8% in relative terms. End-to-end, FTB improves average success rate by 16.6 points over vanilla OPD and 7.6 points over TCOD-B2F, with consistent gains across student scales and teacher settings.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the two diagnostic findings in the introduction (hit rate and harm rate of high-KL interventions, and the downstream shift of student continuations after a teacher bridge) and on the method section’s validation criterion over future continuations; the three panels of Figure 1 summarize the core idea efficiently. Readers interested in agent OPD mechanics can also review how FTB interfaces with TCOD’s B2F curriculum and the sampled-token distillation estimator, plus the replay/replace/continue analysis in the appendix. For a pretrain audience, the main takeaway is the local-cue-plus-future-validation screening pattern, not the environment-specific tuning details.

recommendation.zh: 多步Agent蒸馏的轨迹偏移处理思路可借鉴，重点看分歧状态判定和桥接轨迹设计部分，无需复现
recommendation.en: The trajectory deviation handling approach for multi-step agent distillation is referenceable; focus on the disagreement state judgment and bridge trajectory design, no reproduction required

paper.title: SAF-OPD: Stable Advantage Fusion for On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) broadcasts a single response-level reward to every token, while on-policy distillation (OPD) scores each token against a stronger teacher for a dense advantage but caps performance at teacher quality and discourages exploration beyond it. Their complementarity makes combining RLVR and OPD promising, but we find that fusing the two advantages with a fixed coefficient triggers entropy collapse from two miscalibrations: a magnitude mismatch, whe

summary.core_problem: RLVR（以GRPO为代表）的响应级稀疏优势与on-policy蒸馏（OPD）的token级稠密优势直接用固定系数融合时，会触发训练早期熵崩溃，根源是两个独立失配：一是量级失配，OPD的token级优势无界且重尾，会数值上盖过有界的RLVR优势信号；二是时间失配，训练全程保持全强度OPD会持续将学生拉向教师分布，限制学生探索并超越教师的能力，单一固定系数无法同时解决这两个不同维度的问题。
summary.importance: 属于后训练对齐阶段RLVR与蒸馏融合方向的实用方法改进，为RLHF/RLVR流水线中的优势融合提供了可直接落地的稳定策略，避免了单一融合系数调参的盲区，对做对齐训练的工程师有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SAF（Stable Advantage Fusion）框架，用两个独立机制分别对应两种失配：1）token级量级控制器：对单条响应内的OPD优势分布做稀疏化和幅值截断，消除重尾token对更新的主导作用；2）训练阶段控制器：在线跟踪学生与教师的KL散度，检测OPD信号作用耗尽的节点，逐步退火OPD的全局系数，仅在指导有效时保持全强度。方法无需额外模型或辅助损失，仅对采样得到的OPD优势做轻量变换即可接入现有训练流程。
summary.experiments: 诊断实验验证了固定系数融合基线的失效模式：训练早期策略熵即崩溃并维持低位，学生被过度对齐到教师分布，最终精度低于可控融合方案；进一步验证了量级失配与时间失配分别作用于token级尺度和训练时间尺度两个独立维度，仅靠调整单一全局系数无法同时解决两个问题。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看第3章SAF的四阶段融合规则细节，以及第4.4节的失配诊断实验与消融分析，预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Direct fixed-coefficient fusion of sparse response-level advantages from RLVR (e.g. GRPO) and dense token-level advantages from on-policy distillation (OPD) triggers early training entropy collapse. The failure stems from two independent mismatches: magnitude mismatch, where unbounded heavy-tailed token-level OPD advantages numerically overwhelm bounded RLVR signals; and temporal mismatch, where full-strength OPD applied throughout training continuously pulls the student toward the teacher distribution, limiting exploration beyond teacher quality. A single fixed coefficient cannot address both mismatches across their distinct axes.
summary_en.importance: Practical method improvement for RLVR-distillation fusion in post-training alignment, providing a deployable stabilization strategy for advantage mixing in RLHF/RLVR pipelines and eliminating blind spots in single-coefficient tuning. Directly relevant for engineers working on alignment training workflows.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes SAF (Stable Advantage Fusion), a framework with two dedicated mechanisms matched to each mismatch: 1) Token-level magnitude controller: sparsifies and bounds the per-response OPD advantage distribution to eliminate heavy-tailed token dominance in updates; 2) Training-stage controller: tracks online student-teacher KL divergence to detect when OPD guidance is no longer useful, then anneals the global OPD coefficient to maintain full strength only while guidance remains effective. The method requires no additional models or auxiliary losses, and can be integrated into existing pipelines as a lightweight transformation of sampled OPD advantages.
summary_en.experiments: Diagnostic experiments confirm the failure mode of fixed-coefficient fusion baselines: policy entropy collapses early in training and stays low, the student is over-aligned to the teacher, and final accuracy falls short of controlled fusion schemes. Further experiments verify that magnitude mismatch (token-level scale) and temporal mismatch (training-time schedule) operate on independent axes, so retuning a single global coefficient cannot resolve both issues.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 3 for details of the four-stage SAF fusion rule, and Section 4.4 for mismatch diagnosis experiments and ablation studies. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 后训练RL与OPD融合的熵崩溃机制分析有参考价值，重点看两类失配的发现和对应解法。
recommendation.en: The entropy collapse mechanism analysis for RL-OPD fusion is informative; focus on the two mismatch findings and corresponding solutions.

paper.title: VAD: Attributing Visual Evidence for Target Reconstruction in Multimodal On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: Multimodal on-policy distillation (OPD) transfers fine-grained visual knowledge by supervising student-generated trajectories with a privileged-view teacher. Yet its next-token corrections are source-mixed, combining visual signals with linguistic priors and teacher-specific effects. The key challenge is to estimate which corrections are supported by visual evidence, not merely where or how strongly to distill. We introduce Visual Attribution Distillation (VAD), a counterfactual target-reconstru

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是多模态 on-policy distillation 里的一个很具体但常被忽略的问题：教师给出的 next-token 修正并不等于“视觉证据支持的修正”。在学生自己生成的前缀上，教师分布里混有视觉信息、语言先验、教师自身风格偏置，以及对上下文的惯性延续。已有做法要么直接蒸馏 evidence-present teacher 的完整分布，要么用 visual advantage 给 token 或轨迹加权，但都没有回答“教师修正里哪一部分真的是由受控视觉干预引起的”。VAD 的目标就是把这部分可归因于视觉证据的修正从 source-mixed teacher correction 里估出来，再只蒸馏这部分，而不是把整份教师分布照单全收。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接相关性不算高，它更接近多模态 post-train / distillation 配方，而不是基座预训练范式本身。但它提出的问题很干净：当监督信号是由多个来源混合形成时，不能只做强度重加权，还要重构监督方向本身。这个想法对更广义的 teacher-student 训练、RLAIF/RL 中 reward attribution、以及多模态对齐里的“信号去混合”都有启发。贡献量级上，它不是在改 backbone，也不是在改统一建模目标，而是在蒸馏目标构造上做了更细的因果式拆分。若关心 MLLM 训练信号质量，这篇有方法论价值；若只看 LLM 基座预训练，它属于可泛读而非必读。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是用受控视觉干预构造一个“视觉方向代理”，再把教师修正投影到这个方向上。训练时，学生在完整图像 x^0 上生成前缀 y<t；固定教师在相同文本前缀下分别看 evidence-present 视图 x+ 和 evidence-removed / degraded 视图 x-，得到两个 next-token 分布。二者的 centered log-probability 差定义为 u_t，它不是严格的因果分解，也不是 oracle grounding label，而是“当相关视觉证据被显式加入或移除时，候选 token 对数几率如何变化”的有符号代理。这个 signed proxy 很关键，因为视觉证据既可能支持某些 token，也可能反驳学生当前走偏的 token。

在此基础上，VAD 不直接匹配 privileged teacher 分布，而是先看原始教师修正相对学生分布的偏移，再通过 regularized projection 提取其中与 u_t 对齐的分量。可以把它理解成：教师想把学生往某个方向推，但只有与视觉干预响应一致的那一部分被认为值得蒸馏；剩余部分被视为 proxy-unexplained residual，不再默认当作应学习信号。随后，方法围绕学生当前的 full-image 分布重构 target：对被证据支持的候选提高概率，对被证据反驳的候选降低概率，而不把未被代理解释的教师偏移硬塞给学生。

实现上还有两个稳定化设计。第一，保留一个弱的 teacher-correction regularizer，避免完全依赖 noisy proxy 导致训练发散或监督过稀。第二，把 u_t 拆成 support 和 refutation 两个分支，分别控制“该抬谁”和“该压谁”。这比只用正向 visual advantage 更细，因为很多视觉错误不是缺少支持，而是需要明确压低错误 token。作者反复强调，VAD 改的是 what to distill，而不是 how much to distill；这也是它和 Vision-OPD、VA-OPD、V-Zero 的主要区别。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 4B 和 9B 两个学生规模、六个细粒度视觉 benchmark。全文给出的关键信号不是单一榜单数字，而是几类一致性证据。第一，作者在诊断中指出，Vision-OPD 里 strongest response-token corrections 只有 23.2%（4B）和 22.8%（9B）与 evidence-conditioned response 强对齐，说明直接蒸馏 privileged teacher 时，大部分高强度修正其实是 source-mixed 的。这个诊断是整篇方法成立的前提。

第二，主实验里 VAD 在两种模型规模、六个基准上都稳定优于 direct privileged-view distillation 和 visual-advantage weighting。摘要和引言没有给出完整逐表数字，但从正文描述看，提升不是靠单一任务拉高，而是跨任务较稳，说明 target reconstruction 比简单重加权更有效。

第三，语义层面的 token 分析是这篇比较有说服力的部分。作者检查 intervention-derived proxy 及其 aligned correction 所富集的 token 类型，发现它们更偏向视觉相关、任务相关、且更接近正确答案的候选，而不是泛化的语言续写 token。这是在验证“代理方向确实抓到了视觉修正”而不是仅仅引入另一种启发式偏置。

第四，离线控制实验显示，重构后的 target 能保留有用的视觉修正，同时过滤掉一部分 proxy 无法解释的教师偏移。若看消融，重点应关注：去掉 projection、去掉 support/refutation 分支、去掉 weak regularizer 后性能和稳定性的变化；这些消融决定 VAD 是不是一个完整系统而不只是 counterfactual scoring 的包装。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓住三件事。第一，看 Introduction 里对 Vision-OPD、VA-OPD、V-Zero 的批评，尤其是 Figure 1 和那组 23% 左右的对齐诊断。若不接受“teacher correction 是 source-mixed”这个前提，后面的方法就没有必要。第二，看方法部分 Figure 2、Algorithm 1，以及 u_t 的定义、centered log-probabilities、regularized projection、support/refutation split 这几处。这里决定了它到底是在做 attribution，还是只是另一种 importance weighting。第三，看 token semantic analysis 和 offline target study，这两部分比主表更能说明方法是否真的学到了视觉归因。

预计阅读时间 25 到 40 分钟。若只想判断是否值得跟进，读引言、方法总览、主结果表、两组分析图即可。若要复现或迁移到别的多模态蒸馏场景，再细看 evidence-present / removed 视图如何构造、训练时三路 teacher query 的开销、以及正则项的具体形式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a precise failure mode in multimodal on-policy distillation: a teacher’s next-token correction is not the same as a visually grounded correction. On student-generated prefixes, the teacher distribution mixes visual evidence, language priors, teacher-specific stylistic bias, and continuation effects from the textual context. Existing methods either distill the full evidence-present teacher distribution or reweight tokens/trajectories with a visual-advantage score, but neither isolates which part of the correction is actually induced by a controlled visual intervention. VAD is designed to estimate that visually attributable component and distill only that part.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper in the narrow LLM sense; it sits closer to multimodal post-training and distillation. Still, the training-signal question is important: when supervision is source-mixed, rescaling the loss is not enough, because the direction of the target itself may be wrong. That idea is relevant beyond MLLM distillation, including teacher-student training more broadly, reward attribution in RL-style pipelines, and multimodal alignment where supervision blends multiple causes. The contribution is methodological rather than architectural: it refines target construction instead of changing the backbone or the modeling objective.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method builds a proxy for the “visual direction” using a controlled intervention, then projects the teacher correction onto that direction. During training, the student generates prefixes on the full image x^0. A fixed teacher is queried on the same textual prefix under two training-only views: an evidence-present view x+ and an evidence-removed or degraded view x-. The difference between their centered log-probabilities defines u_t, a signed proxy for how revealing or removing the relevant evidence changes token odds. The sign matters: visual evidence can support some candidates and actively refute others.

VAD then avoids directly matching the privileged teacher distribution. Instead, it starts from the teacher correction relative to the student distribution and extracts the component aligned with u_t through a regularized projection. Intuitively, the teacher may want to move the student in many directions, but only the part consistent with the intervention response is treated as distillable visual correction. The remaining component is kept as an unexplained residual rather than being assumed to be useful supervision. A new target is reconstructed around the student’s current full-image distribution: tokens supported by the intervention are raised, tokens refuted by the intervention are suppressed, and teacher shifts not captured by the proxy are excluded.

Two stabilization choices matter. First, the method keeps a weak regularizer derived from the original teacher correction, so optimization does not rely entirely on a noisy counterfactual proxy. Second, u_t is split into support and refutation branches, allowing separate control over which candidates should be promoted and which should be pushed down. This is a meaningful departure from positive-only visual-advantage weighting. The paper’s central claim is that VAD changes what to distill, not merely how strongly to distill it.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation uses 4B and 9B students on six fine-grained visual benchmarks. The most important empirical signal is not a single leaderboard number but a set of consistent diagnostics. First, the paper shows that in Vision-OPD only 23.2% of the strongest response-token corrections for the 4B model and 22.8% for the 9B model are strongly aligned with the evidence-conditioned teacher response. That diagnostic is the empirical basis for the source-mixing claim.

Second, VAD consistently outperforms direct privileged-view distillation and visual-advantage weighting across both model scales and all six benchmarks. The introduction does not expose the full table values, but the paper presents the gains as broad rather than concentrated in one task, which supports the target-reconstruction argument.

Third, the token-level semantic analyses are particularly useful. The intervention-derived proxy and the proxy-aligned correction are enriched in visually relevant, task-relevant, and answer-correct tokens, rather than generic language continuation tokens. This is one of the stronger pieces of evidence that the method is capturing visually attributable correction instead of introducing another heuristic bias.

Fourth, controlled offline studies indicate that the reconstructed targets preserve useful visual correction while filtering teacher shifts that the proxy cannot explain. The key ablations to inspect are the removal of the projection step, the support/refutation split, and the weak teacher regularizer, since those determine whether VAD is a coherent training recipe rather than just counterfactual scoring.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, focus on three parts. First, read the introduction carefully, especially the critique of Vision-OPD, VA-OPD, and V-Zero, along with Figure 1 and the ~23% alignment diagnostic. If that premise is not convincing, the rest of the method is much less compelling. Second, read the method overview, Figure 2, Algorithm 1, and the definitions of u_t, centered log-probabilities, the regularized projection, and the support/refutation split. Those sections tell you whether the paper is doing genuine target reconstruction or just another weighting scheme. Third, read the token semantic analysis and the offline target studies; they are more informative than the headline benchmark tables.

A practical skim should take about 25 to 40 minutes. If the goal is only to decide whether to track the idea, the introduction, method overview, main result table, and analysis figures are enough. If the goal is adaptation or reproduction, then inspect how evidence-present and evidence-removed views are constructed, the cost of the extra teacher queries, and the exact form of the regularization term.

recommendation.zh: 多模态蒸馏中用反事实方法分离视觉信号的思路很扎实，做多模态对齐蒸馏时可直接复用§3的目标投影逻辑
recommendation.en: Counterfactual visual signal separation in multimodal distillation is solid; directly reuse the target projection logic in §3 for multimodal alignment distillation.

paper.title: Pass the Baton: Trajectory-Relayed On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) grounds token-level supervision in the student's own trajectory, yet suffers from prefix failure: once the student commits to a wrong reasoning direction, all subsequent generation builds on this deviation, producing misdirected continuations that elicit unreliable supervision and waste compute. We identify a teacher-student continuation asymmetry on failed prefixes, where the teacher tends to redirect while the student continues along the original direction, and con

summary.core_problem: On-policy distillation（OPD）在长链推理里会遇到 prefix failure：学生模型早期走错方向后，后续 token 都建立在错误前缀上，导致老师在这些状态上给出的 token 级监督既不可靠也浪费算力。论文要解决的是：不引入额外标注/奖励/验证器的前提下，在线检测“何时学生已经偏航”，并用最小代价把轨迹拉回可学习区域。
summary.importance: 对 post-train/蒸馏 recipe 有直接启发，间接影响预训练-后训练接口：它把“纠错发生在轨迹生成过程中”当作核心设计点，而不是事后重写或固定截断。关键价值在于两个观察：1）老师与学生在失败前缀上的 continuation 行为存在可利用的不对称；2）极少量、很早的 teacher token 介入就能显著提升效果并减少无效 rollout。对做 reasoning 蒸馏、R1 类 on-policy 数据生成、以及任何需要控制 rollout 成本的训练流程都实用。
summary.technical_approach:
Relay-OPD 的核心是“接力轨迹（relay trajectory）”：学生按自身策略生成，一旦触发 handoff trigger，就让老师短暂接管生成一个 teacher leg（用于重定向），随后把控制权交还学生继续生成。
- Handoff trigger：基于“teacher–student continuation asymmetry”构造的无标签触发信号。直观上是在某个前缀状态下，老师倾向于停下来反思/改道，而学生倾向于沿原方向继续。论文把这种分歧转成在线可检测的触发点（不需要 verifier 或 reward）。
- Relay budget：限制 teacher leg 的次数与长度，保证轨迹仍接近学生的 on-policy 分布，同时把干预集中在最早的失败点（因为越晚老师也会被学生上下文牵引，难以改道）。
- 优化：生成得到的 relay trajectory 仍按标准 OPD 做 token 级蒸馏（文中回顾了 OPD 的 reverse KL / advantage 形式），区别在于轨迹分布被“少量老师 token”纠偏，从而减少在明显失败状态上的训练与计算浪费。
- 实现：把师生交替生成统一在一个 speculative-decoding 引擎里，降低在线切换开销。
summary.experiments:
论文给了较明确的关键数字：
- 轨迹干预实验显示“纠错可以非常局部”：只在每个 trigger 处替换单个 reflection token，teacher tokens 仅占全部生成 token 的 0.35%，准确率从 27.73 提升到 34.96（+7.23）。
- 干预价值前置：固定干预长度但把干预从最早 trigger 挪到更晚 trigger，准确率从 41.99 降到 33.98 再到 29.49，说明越早纠偏越有效。
- 综合对比：在 8 个数学推理基准、两种学生规模上，1.7B 学生 Relay-OPD 相比标准 OPD 提升 +5.73，相比 FastOPD 提升 +1.49；同时平均训练轨迹长度减少超过 50%。
这些结果支持论文的主张：用极少 teacher 计算换来更高质量的 on-policy 监督，并显著降低 rollout 成本。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读路径建议 30–45 分钟：
- 先看 Introduction 里对 prefix failure 的问题刻画，以及 Figure 2 的两条经验规律（局部性、前置性），这是方法设计的直接依据。
- 再看 Method 里 trigger 的定义与 relay budget 的约束方式，理解它如何在“纠偏”与“保持 on-policy”之间取舍。
- 最后扫实验表：重点关注 teacher token 占比、轨迹长度缩短幅度、以及与 OPD/FastOPD 的增益对比。若要复现，实现细节（speculative-decoding 引擎里如何做师生切换）值得细看。

summary_en.core_problem: On-policy distillation (OPD) for long-chain reasoning suffers from prefix failure: once the student deviates early, the rest of the rollout is conditioned on a wrong prefix, producing low-quality teacher supervision and wasting compute. The paper aims to detect such failures online without labels/verifiers and to minimally intervene so trajectories stay in a learnable region.
summary_en.importance: This is a practical post-training/distillation recipe improvement with implications for the pretrain↔posttrain loop when on-policy rollouts are used (reasoning distillation, R1-style data generation, compute-controlled training). The key insight is that tiny, early teacher interventions can correct trajectories and cut rollout waste, outperforming fixed truncation or offline rewriting while keeping supervision grounded in student-visited states.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Relay-OPD constructs “relay trajectories” by interleaving student generation with brief teacher takeovers.
- Handoff trigger: a label-free signal derived from teacher–student continuation asymmetry on failed prefixes—teachers tend to pause/redirect while students keep pushing along the wrong direction. This divergence is used to decide when to hand control to the teacher.
- Teacher leg + relay budget: when triggered, the teacher generates a short segment to steer the reasoning back, then control returns to the student. A budget caps the number/length of teacher legs to keep trajectories close to the student’s on-policy distribution and to concentrate intervention early.
- Optimization: the student is distilled on the resulting relay trajectory using the standard OPD token-level objective (reverse-KL/advantage-style), but with fewer tokens spent in obviously failed regions.
- Implementation: teacher/student interleaving is integrated into a single speculative-decoding engine to reduce switching overhead.
summary_en.experiments:
Key reported numbers:
- Locality of correction: replacing only a single reflection token at each trigger (teacher tokens ≈ 0.35% of generated tokens) improves accuracy from 27.73 to 34.96 (+7.23).
- Front-loaded value: shifting a fixed-length intervention from the earliest triggers to later ones drops accuracy from 41.99 to 33.98 and then 29.49, consistent with the teacher being increasingly constrained by the student’s prefix.
- Benchmark results: across 8 math reasoning benchmarks and two student scales, for a 1.7B student Relay-OPD beats standard OPD by +5.73 and FastOPD by +1.49, while reducing average training trajectory length by >50%.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim in 30–45 minutes:
- Introduction + Figure 2: the intervention studies (locality and timing) are the empirical backbone.
- Method section: focus on how the handoff trigger is defined and how the relay budget enforces the on-policy constraint.
- Experiments: track three metrics together—accuracy, teacher-token fraction, and rollout length—to understand the compute/quality trade-off. If implementing, read the speculative-decoding-based interleaving details carefully.

recommendation.zh: 点子不大，但抓住了 OPD 最脏的地方：错误前缀会污染整条监督轨迹；先看 trigger 定义和 budget ablation，若干净可迁到 RL/SFT rollout 训练里。
recommendation.en: Not a paradigm shift, but it targets the dirtiest part of OPD: bad prefixes poison the whole supervision trajectory; check the trigger design and budget ablations first.

paper.title: FlowCTS: On-policy Continuous Trajectory Supervision of Flow Models
paper.abstract: While on-policy distillation (OPD) effectively addresses sparse rewards and exposure bias in large language model post-training, its extension to flow models remains underexplored. To this end, we propose Flow Continuous Trajectory Supervision (FlowCTS), which matches subsequent student and reference trajectories initialized from the same student-visited state. Using the integral relation between trajectories and velocity fields, we derive a temporally weighted velocity-matching upper bound and

summary.core_problem: 现有on-policy蒸馏方法可解决LLM后训练的稀疏奖励与暴露偏差问题，但无法适配流模型的连续轨迹特性，需设计面向流模型的轨迹感知监督框架用于对齐训练。
summary.importance: 流模型是当前图像/视频类多模态基座的主流建模范式之一，该工作将on-policy蒸馏思路从自回归LLM拓展至流模型，为流模型的多目标对齐、蒸馏效率提升提供了新的训练目标设计路径，对多模态基座预训练后的对齐阶段（RL/蒸馏）有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Flow连续轨迹监督（FlowCTS），核心利用流模型中轨迹与速度场的积分关系，从学生模型访问过的同一状态出发对齐学生与参考模型的后续轨迹；推导出带时间权重的速度匹配上界，离散为可通过监督步数K参数化的可训练目标（K=1为单步速度监督，K>1为多步轨迹段监督），支持多参考模型设置，可适配on-policy（FlowCTS-OPD）与off-policy（FlowCTS-SFT）两种场景。
summary.experiments: 基于SD3.5-Medium基座开展实验：on-policy多参考设置下，FlowCTS-OPD（K=1）较vanilla KL-based OPD，GenEval从0.90升至0.93、OCR从0.90升至0.92、PickScore从22.75升至23.06，整体得分从0.890升至0.912；K=2时GenEval进一步提升至0.94，收敛速度显著快于vanilla OPD，能更早接近专家模型水平，且在三个目标上实现更均衡的性能，避免了FlowGRPO单目标优化的性能权衡问题。off-policy设置下，FlowCTS-SFT较vanilla SFT主要提升OCR指标，其余指标基本持平。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看方法节中轨迹-速度场积分关系的推导过程，结合表1的主结果与图3的训练动态曲线理解方法收益，关注监督步数K对性能的影响规律，预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: On-policy distillation (OPD) effectively addresses sparse rewards and exposure bias in LLM post-training, but its direct extension to flow models remains under-explored due to the continuous trajectory nature of flow-based generation, so this work develops a trajectory-aware supervision framework tailored for flow model alignment.
summary_en.importance: Flow models are a dominant paradigm for modern image/video multimodal foundation models. This work extends on-policy distillation from autoregressive LLMs to flow models, providing a new objective design for multi-objective alignment and distillation efficiency improvement, which offers reference for the post-pretraining alignment (RL/distillation) stage of multimodal foundation models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Flow Continuous Trajectory Supervision (FlowCTS). The core idea is to leverage the integral relation between trajectories and velocity fields in flow models, aligning subsequent student and reference trajectories initialized from the same student-visited state. It derives a temporally weighted velocity-matching upper bound, then discretizes it into practical trainable objectives parameterized by supervision step K (K=1 for single-step velocity supervision, K>1 for multi-step trajectory segment supervision). The framework supports multi-reference setups and adapts to both on-policy (FlowCTS-OPD) and off-policy (FlowCTS-SFT) settings.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on the SD3.5-Medium base model. In the on-policy multi-reference setup, FlowCTS-OPD (K=1) improves GenEval from 0.90 to 0.93, OCR from 0.90 to 0.92, PickScore from 22.75 to 23.06, and overall score from 0.890 to 0.912 over vanilla KL-based OPD; with K=2, GenEval further reaches 0.94. It converges significantly faster than vanilla OPD, approaches expert-level performance earlier, and delivers more balanced performance across three objectives without the performance trade-offs of task-specific FlowGRPO variants. In the off-policy setup, FlowCTS-SFT mainly improves OCR over vanilla SFT while maintaining comparable GenEval and PickScore performance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the method section for the derivation of the integral relation between trajectories and velocity fields, focus on the main results in Table 1 and training dynamics curves in Figure 3 to understand the method's gains, and note the performance trend with varying supervision step K. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 看 §方法推导和 temporal mismatch 分析；对 flow/diffusion LM 的后训练目标设计有可迁移信号。
recommendation.en: Read the method derivation and temporal-mismatch analysis; the transferable signal is for post-training objectives in flow or diffusion LMs.

paper.title: Rethinking Classifier-Free Guidance in On-Policy Diffusion Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) adapts diffusion models by querying a teacher along trajectories generated by the current student, but how it should behave under classifier-free guidance (CFG), a default component of modern diffusion systems, remains poorly understood. Existing OPD methods naturally extend velocity matching to the CFG-composed prediction, directly matching teacher and student guided velocities. We show that this objective is under-identified at the branch level: positive- and negat

summary.core_problem: 现有在线策略扩散蒸馏直接匹配教师与学生的CFG引导速度，存在分支级欠定问题，正负分支误差可相互补偿导致目标失效。
summary.importance: 揭示了CFG场景下在线策略扩散蒸馏的误差动态机制，明确了朴素匹配目标的适用边界与失效条件。
summary.technical_approach: 从理论上分析CFG速度匹配目标的可识别性，对比共享负条件、教师负分支持有学生不可得特权信息两种场景下的分支误差演化规律。
summary.experiments: 在标准图像扩散蒸馏任务上验证：当教师负分支包含特权信息时，朴素目标会诱发对抗性分支误差动态，导致正分支误差上升；修正目标可缓解该问题。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing on-policy diffusion distillation directly matches CFG-guided velocities between teacher and student, which is under-identified at the branch level: positive and negative branch errors can compensate each other and break the objective.
summary_en.importance: Reveals the error dynamics of on-policy diffusion distillation under CFG, clarifying the applicable boundary and failure conditions of naive velocity matching objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach: Theoretically analyze the identifiability of CFG velocity matching objectives, compare branch error evolution in two scenarios: shared negative conditioning, and teacher negative branch holding privileged information unavailable to the student.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on standard image diffusion distillation tasks: when teacher negative branch contains privileged information, naive objective induces antagonistic branch error dynamics and increases positive branch error; corrected objective mitigates this issue.

recommendation.zh: 核心针对图像扩散蒸馏，仅做文本扩散LM的研究者可扫一眼结论，其他人无需读。
recommendation.en: Focuses on image diffusion distillation; only glance if you work on text diffusion LMs, skip otherwise.

paper.title: Zing: Social Mind for LLMs
paper.abstract: As large language models move from isolated task solving toward long-term service in human environments, they require social intelligence: the ability to infer mental states, track social relations, reason over norms, and adapt behavior under context. This report presents Zhijing, an integrated framework for measuring, internalizing, and grounding social intelligence. For measurement, we introduce SoMBench, a psychology-grounded benchmark spanning 3 primary dimensions, 17 secondary dimensions, a

summary.core_problem: 如何把“社会智能”（心智推断、关系与规范推理、情境化行为）从零散任务评测，推进到可诊断、可训练、可部署支撑的一整套框架；并回答一个更工程化的问题：当模型要长期在社会环境中服务时，哪些社会能力缺口最关键、如何补、如何在推理时稳定落地。
summary.importance:
对基座预训练研究的直接关联偏弱，更像是面向对齐/agent 的能力框架与评测+训练配方集合。但它提供了两类可迁移启发：
- 评测资产层面：把社会智能拆成结构化能力空间（多维度、多范式、共享场景控制变量），这类“诊断式 benchmark”思路可迁移到预训练阶段的能力剖面评估（而不只是单分数）。
- 训练闭环层面：强调“诊断→定向监督→on-policy 蒸馏→rubric RL→部署时外部支撑”的流水线，体现了 post-train 信号如何被组织成可迭代工程系统。若团队在做长期交互式 agent 或安全对齐，这套组织方式可能比单点算法更有用。
summary.technical_approach:
Zing（知境）由三块组成：
1) SoMBench：心理学启发的社会智能评测基准，把能力定义成结构化空间（3 个一级维度、17 个二级维度、71 种任务范式），并通过共享场景（284 个）控制题型、叙事视角、上下文长度等变量，减少“换题即换能力”的噪声。
2) 训练配方：用能力诊断来构造定向监督数据，然后做 SFT、on-policy distillation（更贴近交互分布）、以及基于 rubric 的强化学习来强化社会推理与行为选择。
3) Actio：部署时的 harness-controlled 架构，把推理所需的“类型化支撑”路由进来，包括程序性指导、运行时心智状态表示、可复用经验、外部社会/规范知识等，试图把一部分难以参数化的社会先验放到检索/工具/结构化记忆里。
整体取舍是：不把社会智能当成单一数据集或单一 reward，而是把它拆成可测的子能力，并在训练与推理时分别提供稳定支撑。
summary.experiments:
给定全文片段主要是框架与动机描述，未包含可核对的关键数值（例如：在 SoMBench 上相对哪些基线提升多少、训练各阶段的增益、Actio 的在线收益等）。从摘要信息可知 SoMBench 含 3,481 个实验任务（experiments）与 284 个共享场景，并控制多种元数据变量。若要判断其方法有效性，建议在全文中重点核对：
- SoMBench 的评分协议（自动/人工、rubric 细则、可靠性）与泄漏控制；
- 分阶段训练的消融：SFT vs on-policy distill vs rubric RL 的边际贡献；
- 部署时支撑（Actio）对长程交互稳定性的增益，以及是否引入新的失败模式（例如过度依赖外部规范库）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45 分钟）：
- 先读 SoMBench 的能力空间定义与任务范式列表，判断它是否覆盖你关心的社会场景，控制变量是否合理。
- 再读训练配方章节的“数据如何从诊断来、rubric 如何写、on-policy 如何采样”，这是可复用的工程细节。
- 最后读 Actio 的系统设计：它更像部署架构提案，适合评估可实现性与维护成本。
如果只关心预训练：可以只取其“诊断式 benchmark 设计”方法论，训练与部署部分可快速略读。

summary_en.core_problem: How to turn “social intelligence” (mental-state inference, social relations and norms reasoning, context-sensitive behavior) from fragmented tasks into a diagnosable, trainable, and deployment-grounded stack for LLMs operating as long-term collaborators in human environments.
summary_en.importance: Weak direct linkage to base pretraining; it is closer to alignment/agent capability engineering (benchmark + training recipe + deployment harness). Still, it offers transferable ideas: (1) diagnostic benchmarking via a structured capability space and controlled shared scenarios—useful as a template for pretraining-stage capability profiling beyond single aggregate scores; (2) an explicit closed loop from diagnosis to targeted supervision, on-policy distillation, rubric-based RL, and inference-time supports, illustrating how post-training signals can be operationalized into an iterative system rather than a one-off fine-tune.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work packages three components:
1) SoMBench: a psychology-grounded benchmark that defines social intelligence as a structured capability space (3 primary dimensions, 17 secondary dimensions, 71 task paradigms). It uses shared scenarios (284) and controls factors like question format, narrative perspective, and context length to reduce confounds.
2) Zing training recipe: capability diagnosis is used to construct targeted supervision, followed by SFT, on-policy distillation to better match interactive distributions, and rubric-based reinforcement learning to strengthen social reasoning and behavior.
3) Actio deployment harness: a harness-controlled architecture that routes typed supports into inference—procedural guidance, runtime mental-state representations, reusable experience, and external social/normative knowledge—explicitly offloading part of the “social priors” from parameters to structured retrieval/tools/memory.
The key design choice is to treat social intelligence as a layered capability with measurement, parametric internalization, and runtime grounding, rather than as a single dataset or reward.
summary_en.experiments: The provided excerpt is largely conceptual and does not include verifiable headline numbers (e.g., gains over baselines on SoMBench, stage-wise ablations, or online improvements from Actio). From the available text: SoMBench includes 3,481 experiments and 284 shared scenarios with controlled metadata. To assess effectiveness, the critical checks in the full paper are: (i) scoring protocol and reliability (rubrics, human/auto judging, leakage control), (ii) ablations across SFT vs on-policy distillation vs rubric RL, and (iii) deployment-time impact of Actio on long-horizon interaction stability and any new failure modes introduced by external normative knowledge.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the SoMBench capability taxonomy and task paradigms first; verify coverage and whether the controlled variables are well-motivated.
- Then read the training recipe details: how diagnosis maps to data construction, how rubrics are specified, and how on-policy sampling is done—these are the most reusable engineering parts.
- Finally read Actio as a deployment architecture proposal; evaluate feasibility and maintenance cost.
If your focus is strictly pretraining, treat this mainly as a diagnostic-benchmark design reference and skim the training/deployment sections.

recommendation.zh: 社会智能拆维度的 eval 设计可借鉴；训练 recipe 先当 post-train 弱信号，重点看错误分布而非总分。
recommendation.en: The social-intelligence decomposition is reusable for eval design; treat the training recipe as weak post-training signal and focus on error distributions, not aggregate score.

paper.title: The Physics of Multi-Turn Long-Horizon Planning: From Pre-training to Post-training via Single- and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Agentic Distillation
paper.abstract: Multi-turn long-horizon planning is critical for foundation model agents, yet how to fundamentally improve it remains unclear. Existing models are trained on uncontrollable and opaque Internet data, making it difficult to identify how planning ability is acquired, shaped, and integrated. To address this challenge, we introduce a unified and controlled multi-turn environment that enables precise control. It allows systematically study long-horizon planning across three stages. (1) Planning abilit

summary.core_problem: 多轮长程规划能力在预训练和后训练中分别如何获得、塑造，并应怎样在 agent 训练中分配数据与蒸馏信号。
summary.importance: 在可控多轮环境中系统研究预训练数据格式/分布/质量以及 GRPO/on-policy distillation 对长程规划的影响，对理解 pretrain→posttrain 接口上 agent 能力的形成有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 构建统一可控的多轮环境，分三阶段研究：(1) 预训练中规划能力习得——比较 CoT 状态转移显式建模、原子技能 vs 长程数据、次优轨迹影响；(2) GRPO 与 OPD（on-policy distillation）后训练塑形，用互信息分析；(3) 单教师/多教师 on-policy agentic distillation 方案。
summary.experiments: 受控环境下的多阶段消融，给出"少量长程数据即可支撑组合泛化、次优轨迹因误差累积显著损害性能、CoT 显式状态转移建模更强"等定性发现；未在 abstract 报告具体模型规模或标准 benchmark 数字。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自中国科学院大学；学术团队工作，非顶级实验室旗舰报告。

summary_en.core_problem: How multi-turn long-horizon planning ability is acquired during pretraining, shaped in post-training, and how data and distillation signals should be allocated across stages.
summary_en.importance: Uses a controlled multi-turn environment to ablate pretraining data format/distribution/quality and the role of GRPO and on-policy distillation, shedding light on how agentic capabilities form across the pretrain–posttrain boundary.
summary_en.technical_approach: A unified controlled multi-turn environment enables three-stage study: (1) pretraining-time acquisition comparing explicit CoT state-transition modeling, atomic skills versus long-horizon data, and the impact of suboptimal trajectories; (2) shaping via GRPO and on-policy distillation (OPD) with mutual-information analysis; (3) single- and multi-teacher on-policy agentic distillation.
summary_en.experiments: Controlled-environment ablations reporting qualitative findings: small amounts of long-horizon data suffice for compositional generalization, suboptimal trajectories severely hurt due to error amplification, and explicit CoT state transitions generalize better; no model sizes or standard benchmark numbers in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors from University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; academic group work, not a flagship industrial lab report.

recommendation.zh: 受控小环境里的长程规划归因结论和我们大规模上的经验大体一致，当思路索引备查即可，无需细读。
recommendation.en: The qualitative findings on long-horizon data mix and suboptimal trajectories match large-scale intuitions; treat as a reference, not a deep read.

institutions: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

paper.title: Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation via Byte-Prefix Marginalization
paper.abstract: Open-weight language models from different families exhibit complementary capabilities, motivating their consolidation into a compact student through on-policy distillation (OPD). However, full-vocabulary OPD typically assumes a shared tokenizer, while existing cross-tokenizer methods may discard teacher probability mass or assign it to student tokens with unrelated content. We introduce Byte-Prefix Marginalization (BPM), which re-expresses the teacher's next-token distribution over the student

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决的是跨 tokenizer 的全词表 on-policy distillation 问题。标准 OPD 在学生生成的轨迹上查询教师，并让学生匹配教师的 next-token 分布，但它默认师生共享 tokenizer。现实中更常见的情况是，Qwen、GLM、MiniMax 等模型族 tokenizer 不同，教师 token 和学生 token 的边界、词表坐标都不一致。已有方法要么只在候选集合上传递一部分概率质量，要么用 rank matching 把概率分给字节内容并不对应的学生 token，要么退化成 sequence-level KD，无法提供密集的 full-vocabulary token-level 监督。论文要构造一个在学生词表上的教师目标分布，同时满足三个条件：覆盖学生词表、按 byte 内容对齐、保留教师概率总质量。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-train 之间的接口有直接意义。很多团队希望把多个开放模型的能力蒸馏进一个更小的 base 或 reasoning student，但 tokenizer 绑定会限制教师选择。BPM 的贡献不是简单换一个 KD loss，而是给跨 tokenizer 的 dense distribution matching 提供了一个可检查的构造：概率质量在共享 byte 空间中重表达，并显式处理无法匹配的 residual mass。这让 OPD 可以更自由地使用异构教师。另一个有价值的点是它暴露了代码数据里的 tokenizer 伪监督问题：byte-level 对齐过于精确时，可能学到教师 tokenizer 的空白符切分习惯，而不是语义预测行为。这类失败模式对大规模蒸馏 recipe 很实用。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是 Byte-Prefix Marginalization。给定某个学生前缀位置，先用同一段 byte prefix 对齐教师状态，再取教师的 next-token 分布。对教师词表中的每个 token，取它的 byte 表示，寻找学生词表中 byte 表示是该教师 token byte 前缀的最长学生 token。教师 token 的概率质量被分配给这个学生 token；多个教师 token 映射到同一个学生 token 时做求和。无法找到合法前缀匹配的质量进入显式 residual category。这个 residual 不是实现细节，而是保证 mass preservation 的必要条件，否则目标分布会天然小于 1。论文还处理了 byte prefix 跨越多个教师 token 的位置：在不跨 teacher token 的情况下，BPM 精确恢复教师的 byte-prefix marginal；在跨越情况下，用保质量的 chain-factorized lower bound。训练时仍然是 on-policy：学生生成响应，教师在学生实际访问的状态上给出监督，学生用 generalized Jensen-Shannon divergence 匹配 BPM 变换后的目标。相比 SimCT 这类 candidate-set 方法，BPM 不丢弃未覆盖质量；相比 ULD/GOLD 这类 rank-based 方法，它不把概率分给 byte 内容无关的 token；相比 SeqKD，它保留了 token-level 分布监督。针对代码任务中的空白符问题，论文加入预计算 mask，排除目标完全由 whitespace 组成的位置，避免学生模仿教师 tokenizer 的缩进/空格切分模式。
summary.experiments: 实验把三个异构教师分别蒸馏到同一个 thinking-mode student：Qwen3-32B、GLM-Z1-9B-0414、MiniMax-M2.7。这些教师和学生的 tokenizer 距离不同，用来检验方法对异构 tokenization 的鲁棒性。所有 on-policy 方法使用相同训练预算；SeqKD 按其标准 offline recipe 训练，且没有更小预算的限制。结果上，最佳 BPM 变体在每个 teacher-student pair 上都超过最强基线，分别关闭对应 teacher-student 性能差距的 33.5%、43.9%、34.4%。论文还报告了一个关键统计：超过 99% 的训练位置满足精确恢复 byte-prefix marginal 的条件，说明跨 token spanning 的近似分支在实际训练中占比很低。消融里最有信息量的是代码空白符失败案例：某个师生组合在未屏蔽 whitespace-only target position 时，代码 pass rate 从 49% 降到 9%；加入 whitespace mask 后避免了这种 collapse。这个结果说明跨 tokenizer 蒸馏不能只看分布变换是否形式正确，还要检查 tokenization artifact 是否被当作训练信号。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读方法和实验诊断部分。先看引言中 D1/D2/D3 的定义，它把跨 tokenizer full-vocabulary distillation 的要求讲得很清楚，也能帮助判断已有方法为什么不够。随后看 BPM 的构造：最长 byte-prefix 匹配、概率聚合、residual category、spanning position 的 chain factorization。附录里的 Proposition C.3 值得看，它说明什么条件下 BPM 是精确的，以及为什么实验中超过 99% 的位置落在精确情形。实验部分重点看三组教师的主结果表、tokenizer distance 相关分析，以及 Section 4.3 的 whitespace-only mask。最值得深挖的是两个问题：一是 generalized JSD 相比 KL 在 residual mass 存在时的训练稳定性；二是类似 whitespace 的 tokenizer artifact 是否也存在于数学公式、代码标识符、多语言文本和 byte-fallback token 中。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses full-vocabulary on-policy distillation when teacher and student models use different tokenizers. Standard OPD queries the teacher on student-generated trajectories and matches the teacher’s next-token distribution, but it assumes aligned token positions and a shared vocabulary. That assumption breaks for heterogeneous model families such as Qwen, GLM, and MiniMax. Existing cross-tokenizer methods either drop unmatched teacher probability mass, assign mass by rank rather than byte content, or avoid dense token-level supervision altogether. The target problem is to build a teacher distribution over the student vocabulary that is complete, byte-aligned, and mass-preserving.
summary_en.importance: The work is practically relevant for consolidating capabilities from multiple open-weight model families into a compact student without being constrained by tokenizer compatibility. Its contribution is not just another distillation loss; it defines a byte-space transformation that makes dense OPD feasible across tokenizers. This matters for pretrain-to-posttrain pipelines where distillation is used to merge reasoning, coding, tool-use, or domain-specific behavior from heterogeneous teachers. The paper also identifies a real training failure in code data: exact byte-level supervision can transfer tokenizer-specific whitespace segmentation instead of useful predictive behavior. That diagnostic is valuable for designing robust large-scale distillation recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, Byte-Prefix Marginalization, rewrites the teacher’s next-token distribution in the student vocabulary through a shared byte representation. For each teacher token, BPM takes its byte string and finds the longest student token whose byte string is a prefix of that teacher token’s bytes. The teacher token’s probability is assigned to that student token, and probabilities mapped to the same student token are aggregated. Probability mass that cannot be matched is assigned to an explicit residual category, which is required to preserve total mass. When byte prefixes do not span multiple teacher tokens, the transformed target exactly recovers the teacher’s byte-prefix marginal. At spanning positions, the method uses a mass-preserving chain-factorized lower bound. Training remains on-policy: the student generates trajectories, the teacher is queried at the corresponding byte-aligned states, and the student minimizes a generalized Jensen-Shannon divergence to the transformed target. Compared with candidate-set methods such as SimCT, BPM avoids dropping mass; compared with rank-based methods such as ULD or GOLD, it avoids assigning probability to byte-unrelated student tokens; compared with SeqKD, it keeps dense next-token supervision. A precomputed mask removes all-whitespace target positions in code data to prevent learning tokenizer-specific formatting artifacts.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments distill three heterogeneous teachers into the same thinking-mode student: Qwen3-32B, GLM-Z1-9B-0414, and MiniMax-M2.7. These pairs cover different tokenizer distances. All on-policy baselines use the same training budget, while SeqKD follows its standard offline setup without receiving a smaller budget. The best BPM variant outperforms the strongest baseline for every teacher-student pair, closing 33.5%, 43.9%, and 34.4% of the corresponding teacher-student performance gaps. The paper reports that more than 99% of training positions satisfy the exact byte-prefix marginal condition, so the approximate spanning-position branch is rarely invoked in practice. The most important ablation is the whitespace failure case in code generation: for one teacher-student pair, distilling all-whitespace target positions drops code pass rate from 49% to 9%. Masking those positions prevents the collapse, showing that formally correct byte alignment can still carry harmful tokenizer artifacts.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the problem formulation around the D1/D2/D3 criteria first; it cleanly separates vocabulary completeness, byte-level alignment, and mass preservation. Then focus on the BPM construction: longest byte-prefix matching, aggregation, residual mass, and the chain-factorized treatment of spanning positions. Proposition C.3 in the appendix is worth reading because it states when the transformation is exact and explains why the exact case dominates in experiments. In the experiments, prioritize the main teacher-student comparison tables, any tokenizer-distance analysis, and the whitespace-only masking study in Section 4.3. Two details deserve extra scrutiny: how generalized Jensen-Shannon divergence behaves when residual mass is present, and whether similar tokenizer artifacts appear in math notation, multilingual text, byte-fallback tokens, or code identifiers.

recommendation.zh: 这不是小修小补；cross-tokenizer distillation 以前很多做法 target 就不对，建议直接看方法定义和误差分解，内部蒸馏实验应尽快补这个对照。
recommendation.en: This is not a cosmetic tweak: many prior cross-tokenizer distillation setups had the wrong target, so read the method definition and error decomposition and add this control to any internal distillation study.
