paper.title: AdaFlash: Adaptive Speculative Decoding via On-Policy Distilled Diffusion Drafters
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding, in which a lightweight draft model first generates a draft sequence that is then verified in parallel by the target model, has become a prevalent paradigm for accelerating large language model inference. Recent work such as DFlash further boosts drafting efficiency by leveraging diffusion drafters, whose parallel denoising mechanism enables draft generation in a single forward pass. In this work, we uncover a central pitfall of diffusion drafters: bidirectional attention is

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 diffusion drafter 用于 speculative decoding 时一个很具体、但此前没有被讲透的问题：单步并行起草虽然便宜，但 bidirectional attention 带来的全局耦合会让 draft 质量方差明显变大。这个方差有两层表现。第一层是 domain-level variance：同一个 diffusion drafter 在不同任务域上的 acceptance rate 波动比 AR drafter 更大，静态蒸馏好的 drafter 一旦遇到分布偏移，速度收益会迅速掉下去。第二层是 token-level variance：同一条 draft 序列里，不同位置 token 的接受概率差异很大，固定 candidate length 会让 target model 花不少验证算力在低接受概率 token 上。论文要解决的不是“如何再做一个更快的 speculative decoding”，而是“如何让 diffusion drafter 在真实 serving 场景里更稳、更自适应，不因为方差问题把理论并行优势吃掉”。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在预训练，而在建模范式与 serving 接口：如果 diffusion LM 想作为 AR LM 的实用补充，而不是只停留在离线实验里，就必须回答稳定性和系统适配问题。AdaFlash 给出的结论很清楚：diffusion drafter 的优势不是天然成立的，必须配合在线分布适配和长度自适应，才能在高并发、跨域请求下持续兑现吞吐收益。这个判断对所有“非 AR 模型作为辅助生成器”的路线都有参考价值，包括 masked/any-order drafter、MTP 辅助头、甚至小型 verifier-free 草稿器。贡献量级上，它更像是把 DFlash 这类单步 diffusion drafting 从一个漂亮想法推进到可部署方案，而不是提出新的语言建模目标。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分成两部分。第一部分是 on-policy distillation，目标是降低 domain-level variance。作者不是继续用离线 teacher-student 蒸馏，而是让 drafter 在真实请求分布上在线采样，再用 target model 的分布做蒸馏更新。这里的关键设计有两个。其一是 reverse-KL，而不是常见的 forward-KL/CE。reverse-KL 会更强调 mode-seeking，鼓励 drafter 把概率集中到 target 更确信的 token 上，这和 speculative decoding 的 acceptance 目标更一致，因为 acceptance 取决于 p/q 的比值，q 在 target 低概率区域铺得太宽会直接伤害接受率。其二是 entry-wise divergence clipping，用来抑制 diffusion drafter 训练时局部 token 分布偏差过大导致的不稳定更新。论文把这个 clipping 设计成逐项裁剪的散度约束，而不是简单全局梯度裁剪，针对的是在线蒸馏里少数高偏差 token 把整个 batch 拉坏的问题。

第二部分是 adaptive length head，目标是降低 token-level variance 带来的无效验证开销。作者在 drafter 上额外接一个长度预测头，根据当前 prefix 和 draft 置信度动态决定 candidate length，而不是固定 k。直觉上，这相当于把“是否继续多起草几个 token”变成一个条件决策：当后续位置接受概率已经明显下降时，提前截断，少让 target 做无谓并行验证；当当前上下文容易预测时，再把长度放长，吃到单步并行的收益。这个设计和 AR speculative decoding 里固定 k 的思路不同，更接近 token-budget allocation。

系统层面还有两点实现值得注意。一个是 asynchronous training-inference pipeline，把在线蒸馏更新和在线服务解耦，避免 adaptation 直接阻塞请求路径。另一个是 adaptive request scheduling，在 serving engine 里根据请求状态和 drafter 行为做调度，尽量把在线适配带来的额外开销藏在系统流水线里。论文强调高并发下 prior 方法会退化到不如 AR baseline，说明他们不是只做算法指标，而是把 queueing 和 GPU 利用率也纳入了设计约束。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 8 个 benchmark、3 个 foundation model，并且同时包含 dense 和 MoE target，这一点比只在单一 7B dense 模型上报数更有说服力。摘要里给出的主结果是：相对标准 AR decoding，最高达到 5.3× speedup；在高并发场景下，相比先前方法吞吐最高可再高 66%。对比对象包括 EAGLE-3、multi-token prediction 和 DFlash，说明作者把当前主流 speculative 路线都纳入了比较。

从论文叙述看，关键实验不是单看平均 speedup，而是看方差控制是否真的奏效。应重点关注三类结果。第一类是 acceptance rate 在不同 domain 上的分布，AdaFlash 应该显著缩小 diffusion drafter 相比 AR drafter 的跨域波动。第二类是 adaptive length head 对 verification cost 的影响：通常会看到 acceptance length 只小幅下降，但 target 端验证 token 数下降更明显，因此整体吞吐上升。第三类是高并发 serving 曲线：不少 speculative 方法在低并发时有收益，但并发一高，draft/verify 协调和额外 kernel 开销会把收益吃掉；AdaFlash 的卖点正是这里仍能维持正加速。

从消融角度，值得留意 reverse-KL 与 clipping 是否缺一不可。若只做在线蒸馏而不用 reverse-KL，通常会出现 acceptance 提升有限；若不用 divergence clipping，则在线更新可能不稳定，尤其在 OOD 请求批次上更明显。长度头的消融则应看固定 k 与动态 k 的 trade-off：动态策略不是提高单 token 接受率，而是提高每单位 target 计算换来的 accepted tokens。摘要没有给出参数量、训练 token 数和在线更新频率等细节，阅读正文时需要补这些数字，因为它们决定方法是否真有部署可行性。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓住问题定义，再看两个自适应模块如何分别对应两类方差。优先看 Introduction 和 Background 里关于 diffusion drafter 高方差的动机图，尤其是 domain-level 与 token-level variance 的可视化；如果这部分证据不扎实，后面的方案价值会打折。然后看方法部分里 OPD 的目标函数，重点确认 reverse-KL 的具体写法、teacher 分布来自哪里、entry-wise clipping 裁剪的是哪一项散度，以及它为什么比普通 CE 蒸馏更贴 acceptance。接着看 adaptive length head 的训练信号：它是直接预测最优 k、预测 acceptance profile，还是做某种成本收益近似。最后看高并发实验和 serving 端实现，判断收益是算法本身带来的，还是系统工程优化占了主要部分。

预计阅读时间 25 到 35 分钟。若只想抓核心，读动机图、方法总览图、主表和高并发曲线即可；若想判断是否能迁移到别的 non-AR drafter，需要把 OPD 目标和长度头细节读细。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a specific failure mode of diffusion-based drafters in speculative decoding. One-step parallel drafting is attractive because it amortizes draft generation over multiple tokens, but the same bidirectional attention that enables parallel denoising also creates strong global coupling. That coupling increases variance in draft quality at two levels. At the domain level, acceptance rates fluctuate much more across tasks and distributions than with autoregressive drafters. At the token level, acceptance probabilities vary sharply across positions within the same drafted span, so a fixed candidate length wastes verifier compute on low-probability tokens. The real question here is not simply how to make speculative decoding faster, but how to make diffusion drafters stable and adaptive enough for real serving workloads where request distributions shift and concurrency is high.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance is mainly at the interface between modeling and serving rather than pretraining proper. If diffusion LMs are to become practical auxiliary generators for AR targets, they need a story for robustness under distribution shift and for compute allocation during verification. AdaFlash makes a useful point: the gains of diffusion drafting are not automatic. Without online adaptation and dynamic control of draft length, the theoretical parallel advantage can collapse in realistic deployments. That lesson likely extends beyond diffusion drafters to other non-AR assistants, including masked or any-order drafters and multi-token auxiliary heads. The contribution is best viewed as turning one-step diffusion drafting from a promising idea into a more deployable system, not as a new language modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two main components. The first is on-policy distillation, designed to reduce domain-level variance. Instead of relying on purely offline teacher-student distillation, the drafter is adapted on requests sampled from the live serving distribution, with the target model providing the supervision signal. Two design choices matter. First, the distillation objective uses reverse KL rather than the more common forward KL or plain cross-entropy. That choice is aligned with speculative decoding: reverse KL is more mode-seeking, so it encourages the drafter to concentrate probability mass on tokens the target strongly prefers, which is exactly what improves acceptance under the p/q ratio. A drafter that spreads mass too broadly over low-target-probability tokens hurts acceptance. Second, the paper introduces entry-wise divergence clipping to stabilize online updates. This is more targeted than generic gradient clipping: it limits the effect of a small number of badly mismatched token entries that would otherwise dominate the update and destabilize adaptation.

The second component is an adaptive length head, aimed at token-level variance. Instead of using a fixed candidate length k, the drafter predicts how long the draft should be for the current prefix and confidence pattern. The idea is simple but important: if acceptance probability is likely to decay quickly over the drafted span, stop early and avoid wasting target-side verification on unlikely tokens; if the context is easy, draft longer and exploit the one-pass parallelism. This turns candidate length into a conditional compute-allocation decision rather than a static hyperparameter.

The system layer also matters. The paper adds an asynchronous training-inference pipeline so online adaptation does not block serving, and an adaptive request scheduler inside the serving engine. That is important because many speculative methods look good in isolated latency measurements but degrade under queueing pressure and high concurrency. AdaFlash is explicitly designed for that regime.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation spans eight benchmarks and three foundation models, including both dense and MoE targets. That is stronger evidence than a single-model study. The headline number in the abstract is up to 5.3x speedup over standard autoregressive decoding. Against prior speculative baselines, including EAGLE-3, multi-token prediction, and DFlash, the method also reports up to 66% higher throughput at high concurrency.

The most important results are likely not the average speedup alone, but whether the proposed controls actually reduce variance. There should be three result groups worth checking closely. First, acceptance-rate distributions across domains: AdaFlash should narrow the cross-domain spread that diffusion drafters otherwise exhibit. Second, the effect of the adaptive length head on verification cost: the accepted length may drop only slightly, while the number of target-side verified tokens drops more, yielding better throughput. Third, the high-concurrency serving curves: many speculative systems lose their gains once scheduling overhead, verifier contention, and extra kernels become dominant; AdaFlash claims to remain net-positive there.

For ablations, the key question is whether reverse KL and divergence clipping are both necessary. Online adaptation without reverse KL would likely improve alignment only modestly, while removing clipping should make updates less stable, especially on out-of-distribution batches. For the length head, the right comparison is fixed-k versus dynamic-k in terms of accepted tokens per unit of target compute, not just raw acceptance. The abstract does not expose model sizes, adaptation frequency, or online training budget, so those details need to be pulled from the main text to judge deployment realism.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the motivation figures that visualize the two variance types. If the evidence for domain-level and token-level variance is weak, the rest of the paper matters less. Then read the method section with a narrow focus: how exactly reverse KL is defined, where the teacher distribution comes from, what quantity is clipped by the entry-wise divergence clipping, and why that objective should correlate better with acceptance than standard CE distillation. After that, inspect the adaptive length head: what target it predicts, how it is trained, and whether it is effectively learning an acceptance profile or directly optimizing a cost-benefit proxy. Finally, read the high-concurrency serving results and the systems section to separate algorithmic gains from engineering gains.

For a skim, 25 to 35 minutes is enough. Read the motivation figures, the method overview, the main comparison table, and the concurrency plots. If you are interested in transferring the idea to other non-AR drafters, spend extra time on the OPD objective and the dynamic-length mechanism.

recommendation.zh: 对扩散式draft模型的诊断（方差问题）比方法本身更有价值；做推测解码的看§3的问题分析即可，方法属增量。
recommendation.en: The diagnosis—that variance, not mean quality, limits diffusion drafters—is more useful than the method itself; read §3 if you work on speculative decoding, treat the method as incremental.

paper.title: Distilled Reinforcement Learning for LLM Post-training
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) post-training is essential for improving reasoning, adaptation, and alignment. Existing methods mainly follow two paradigms: reinforcement learning (RL) and on-policy distillation (OPD). However, RL relies on coarse-grained outcome supervision, resulting in difficult credit assignment and limited capability to acquire new knowledge. OPD, meanwhile, unconditionally matches teacher logits through KL divergence, which creates a dilemma: similar teachers provide little new

summary.core_problem: LLM后训练中RL存在信用分配难、难以吸收新知识的问题，而策略内蒸馏（OPD）无条件模仿教师logits，跨家族教师常导致训练失效。
summary.importance: 方法创新：首次将教师监督以选择性方式融入RL目标，统一解决RL粗粒度监督和OPD无条件模仿的双重缺陷。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Distilled RL，包含三个核心组件：带裁剪的反向重要性采样以稳定离策略教师信号、负样本重置避免错误知识迁移、序列级几何噪声注入提升泛化；在RL奖励项外引入教师条件KL项实现选择性知识迁移。
summary.experiments: 在推理、对齐和知识获取三类后训练任务上对比纯RL、OPD及混合基线；在跨家族教师场景下显著优于OPD，同时保留RL的结果监督优势，在多个基准上获得稳定提升。

summary_en.core_problem: In LLM post-training, RL suffers from coarse outcome supervision and poor credit assignment, while on-policy distillation (OPD) unconditionally matches teacher logits and fails with substantially different cross-family teachers.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: first framework that selectively integrates teacher supervision into the RL objective, jointly addressing the limitations of both coarse RL and unconditional OPD imitation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Distilled RL with three components: clipped reverse importance sampling to stabilize off-policy teacher signals, negative sample reset to avoid erroneous knowledge transfer, and sequence-level geometric noise injection for better generalization; adds a teacher-conditioned KL term alongside RL reward for selective knowledge transfer.
summary_en.experiments: Compared against pure RL, OPD, and hybrid baselines on reasoning, alignment, and knowledge-acquisition post-training tasks; outperforms OPD significantly in cross-family teacher settings while retaining RL's outcome-supervision advantages, delivering consistent gains across benchmarks.

recommendation.zh: 做后训练的人应立刻在内部ablation复现反向重要性采样和负样本重置两个组件，跨家族教师蒸馏终于有了比硬KL更稳的配方。
recommendation.en: Post-training researchers should immediately reproduce the clipped reverse-importance-sampling and negative-sample-reset components in internal ablations — this gives a more stable recipe than vanilla KL for cross-family teacher distillation.

paper.title: SEED: Self-Evolving On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly trained as interactive agents for long-horizon tasks involving multi-turn interaction, tool use, and environment feedback. Outcome-based reinforcement learning (RL) provides a practical optimization paradigm, but its sparse trajectory-level rewards offer limited guidance on intermediate decisions, leaving a supervision gap between episode-level outcomes and token-level policy learning. We propose SEED (SElf-Evolving On-Policy Distillation), a self-evolving

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 agentic RL 中一个很具体的监督缺口：环境通常只给 trajectory-level 的 outcome reward，但策略学习发生在 token/action 级别，长时程交互里很难把“最后成没成功”有效分配到中间每一步。论文想解决的不是再造一个更强的 RL 算法，而是把 on-policy 轨迹在事后暴露出的结构化信息——哪些观察关键、哪些工具调用有用、哪里偏离了有效流程——转成可训练的密集监督，并且让这套监督随着策略演化而持续更新。
summary.importance: 它属于 post-train/agent RL 范畴，不是预训练论文，但对基座研究有两个启发。第一，长时程 agent 学习里，单靠 outcome reward 的信息密度太低，必须引入更细粒度的训练信号；这和预训练里讨论 token-level loss 是否足够表达复杂能力是同一类问题。第二，论文把“hindsight skill”做成参数化蒸馏信号，而不是部署时外挂 memory 或 reflection prompt，这对 pretrain↔posttrain 接口有参考意义：很多看似 inference-time 的策略知识，最终都可以回流成模型内部参数。贡献量级上，它更像一个训练框架设计，而不是基础算法突破；价值主要在于把 on-policy distillation、trajectory hindsight 和 self-improving agent 这三件事接到一起。
summary.technical_approach:
方法名 SEED，核心是 self-evolving on-policy distillation。整体分两阶段。

第一阶段是 hindsight-skill SFT。作者先让模型学会分析完整轨迹，并把轨迹压缩成自然语言 skill，内容包括可复用 workflow、关键观察、失败规避规则等。这里 skill 不是给用户看的总结，而是训练期的 privileged signal。这样做的目的，是把原本分散在长轨迹里的后见之明提炼成一个更紧凑、可条件化的表示。

第二阶段是自演化的 OPD 训练循环。当前策略先在环境中按 on-policy 方式采样轨迹；同一个模型随后扮演 analyzer，对这些已完成轨迹生成 hindsight skills。接着，作者固定采样得到的原始动作序列，不重新搜索动作，而是分别在“普通上下文”和“skill 增强上下文”下对这些已发生动作重新打分。两者的概率差异被解释为 skill 对行为的偏好修正，并转成 token-level 的 distillation 信号。最终优化目标是 outcome-based RL loss 与这个 OPD loss 的联合。

这里有几个设计点值得注意。其一，为什么强调 on-policy：因为 skill 的价值依赖当前策略会访问哪些状态、会犯哪些错，离线静态 skill 库很快就会失配。其二，为什么用同一个模型同时做 actor 和 analyzer：不是为了省模型，而是为了让“会做事”和“会复盘”一起进化，避免 teacher 固定不动。其三，为什么不把 skill 直接放到推理时：作者希望把 hindsight 变成参数内化的能力，而不是额外的 inference-time memory 机制。

从方法关系上看，它和 verbal reflection、episodic memory、self-distillation 有亲缘性，但区别在于：SEED 不把反思文本当外部记忆长期挂在上下文里，而是把 skill 仅作为训练期 privileged context，通过概率重打分产生密集监督；也不同于纯 outcome RL，因为它提供了 decision-level credit signal；也不同于传统 teacher-student distillation，因为 teacher 不是外部更强模型，而是同一策略在更有 hindsight 的条件下的“增强视角”。
summary.experiments:
论文在 embodied interaction、web navigation、search-based 等长时程 agent 环境上做评测，目标是验证 SEED 是否能比只用 outcome reward 的 RL 学得更稳、更快。虽然给出的全文片段没有完整表格数字，但从实验设计可以看出作者主要验证四件事。

第一，联合 OPD 后，任务成功率相对纯 RL 基线有稳定提升，说明 hindsight skill 确实提供了额外可学习信号，而不是只增加训练噪声。第二，这种提升不是来自 inference-time 提示增强，因为 skill 只在训练时使用，测试时不需要额外 memory 或 prompt。第三，自演化机制优于静态 skill 或一次性蒸馏：随着策略变强，后续生成的 skills 也更贴近当前分布，能继续提供有效监督。第四，token-level 重打分比只在轨迹级别做偏好学习更有效，因为它把 trajectory hindsight 下沉到了具体决策位置。

如果看消融，最值得关注的通常是：去掉 skill analyzer 只做 RL；使用固定 analyzer 或离线 skill 数据；把 skill 当作测试时外部提示而不是训练期蒸馏；以及只做 sequence-level distillation 不做 token-level probability shift。论文的主张成立，依赖的是这几项对照能把收益来源拆清楚。

从研究判断上，这类结果更应关注增益是否跨环境稳定、训练成本增加多少、以及 analyzer 生成的 skill 质量是否会在策略早期阶段成为瓶颈。若全文表格里有 sample efficiency、success rate 曲线、以及不同 horizon 任务上的收益差异，这些比单点平均分更值得看。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction，明确作者要补的是 sparse outcome reward 与 token-level policy learning 之间的监督缺口。然后直接看方法图和 OPD 目标定义，弄清楚 skill 是如何从 completed trajectory 生成、又如何通过重打分变成密集监督的。这里是整篇工作的核心。

实验部分建议优先看三类内容：主结果表，确认相对纯 RL 和其他 hindsight/reflective baselines 的提升；消融，确认 self-evolving、on-policy、token-level distillation 各自的必要性；案例分析，看看生成的 skills 到底是泛化的 workflow 还是只是对单条轨迹的复述。预计 35-45 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读。

更值得深挖的问题有两个。第一，skill 生成质量是否会受模型当前能力上限约束，导致早期自举不稳。第二，OPD 的概率差分是否会引入偏置：skill-augmented context 下更高概率的动作，未必总是因果上更优，只是更符合 analyzer 的语言解释。若要复现，这两点需要重点盯。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a specific supervision gap in agentic reinforcement learning. In long-horizon interactive environments, the agent often receives only sparse trajectory-level outcome rewards, while policy learning happens at the token or action level. That makes credit assignment extremely weak: a final success or failure says little about which intermediate observations, tool calls, or local decisions should be reinforced. The paper does not propose a new RL optimizer. Instead, it asks how to convert hindsight information from completed on-policy trajectories into dense training signals that can guide token-level policy updates.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training and agent-RL paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is relevant for foundation-model researchers for two reasons. First, it highlights a general issue: coarse end-level supervision is often too weak for learning complex sequential behavior, so denser internal training signals matter. Second, it shows a concrete way to turn what would otherwise be inference-time reflection or memory into parametric supervision. That is useful for thinking about the pretrain-posttrain interface: some forms of external reasoning support can be distilled back into the model rather than carried forever as prompts or memory. The contribution is best understood as a training framework that combines hindsight skill extraction, on-policy data, and self-distillation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SEED stands for Self-Evolving On-Policy Distillation. The framework has two stages.

Stage one is hindsight-skill supervised fine-tuning. The model is trained to analyze completed trajectories and produce natural-language skills that summarize reusable workflows, decisive observations, and failure-avoidance rules. These skills are not meant as user-facing summaries. They are privileged training-time signals that compress trajectory-level hindsight into a compact, conditionable representation.

Stage two is the self-evolving OPD loop. The current policy collects trajectories on-policy in the environment. The same model then acts as an analyzer and generates hindsight skills for those completed trajectories. Next, the sampled action sequence is kept fixed. The model re-scores those already-taken actions under two contexts: the original context and a skill-augmented context. The probability shift between the two is treated as a dense token-level distillation signal that indicates how hindsight would have changed the policy’s preference over the observed decisions. Training then jointly optimizes the standard outcome-based RL objective and this OPD objective.

Three design choices are central. First, the method is on-policy because useful hindsight depends on the states and failure modes induced by the current policy; a static offline skill bank would quickly become mismatched. Second, the actor and analyzer are the same evolving model, so decision-making ability and trajectory-analysis ability improve together instead of relying on a frozen teacher. Third, skills are used only during training, not at inference time, because the goal is to internalize hindsight into the policy parameters rather than depend on external memory or extra prompts.

Relative to nearby work, SEED is related to verbal reflection, episodic memory, and self-distillation, but it differs in a precise way. It does not keep reflection text as persistent inference-time context. It uses hindsight text only as privileged context during training to produce dense supervision. It also differs from pure outcome-based RL by providing decision-level credit signals, and from standard teacher-student distillation by using the same policy under a more informed hindsight-conditioned view rather than an external stronger teacher.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper evaluates SEED on long-horizon agent settings including embodied interaction, web navigation, and search-based tasks. The main empirical question is whether hindsight-skill distillation improves learning beyond outcome-only RL. The full excerpt provided here does not include the complete result tables, but the experimental structure makes the intended claims clear.

First, adding OPD on top of outcome-based RL improves task success over pure RL baselines, suggesting that hindsight skills provide learnable supervision rather than just extra noise. Second, the gains are not due to inference-time prompting, because the skills are used only during training and are not required at test time. Third, the self-evolving loop outperforms static skills or one-shot distillation, which supports the claim that hindsight supervision should track the current policy distribution. Fourth, token-level re-scoring is more effective than staying at the trajectory level, because it pushes hindsight information down to concrete decision points.

The most informative ablations are likely the following: removing the skill analyzer and keeping only RL, replacing the evolving analyzer with a fixed analyzer or offline skill dataset, using skills as test-time prompts instead of training-time distillation, and replacing token-level probability-shift supervision with sequence-level distillation only. Those comparisons are what establish where the gains actually come from.

From a research perspective, the most important things to inspect are whether the gains are stable across environments, how much extra training cost the analyzer loop adds, and whether skill quality becomes a bottleneck early in training when the policy is still weak. If the paper reports sample-efficiency curves, success-rate trajectories, and breakdowns by task horizon, those are more informative than a single averaged score.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, start with the introduction to pin down the exact problem: sparse trajectory-level rewards are too coarse for token-level policy learning. Then go straight to the method figure and the OPD objective. The key is to understand how a completed trajectory is turned into a hindsight skill, and how that skill is converted into dense supervision through action re-scoring. That is the conceptual center of the paper.

In the experiments, prioritize three things: the main result table against pure RL and other hindsight or reflection baselines, the ablations that isolate self-evolving, on-policy, and token-level components, and the qualitative examples of generated skills. Those examples matter because they reveal whether the model is extracting reusable workflows or merely paraphrasing individual trajectories. A useful skim should take about 35-45 minutes.

Two deeper questions are worth tracking. One is whether skill generation quality is limited by the current policy’s own capability, which could make early self-bootstrapping unstable. The other is whether the probability shift under skill-augmented context introduces bias: an action can become more likely because it matches the analyzer’s verbal explanation, not necessarily because it is causally better. Those are the main points to watch if you plan to reproduce or extend the method.

recommendation.zh: 值得看训练环路而不是结果表；若 on-policy 自解释不塌缩，内部 Agent RL 可复现 skill 蒸馏消融。
recommendation.en: Read the training loop more than the score table; if on-policy self-analysis does not collapse, the skill-distillation ablation is worth reproducing internally.

paper.title: On-Policy Delta Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation is an alternative post-training method in reinforcement learning that alleviates the constraints imposed by reward models by providing token-level supervision from a teacher model. Although on-policy distillation has been studied and applied across various settings, its fundamental design remains underexplored. In this paper, we introduce a new distillation reward, termed the delta signal, instead of directly imitating the teacher's output distribution. The delta signal is

summary.core_problem: 现有on-policy蒸馏（OPD）直接用教师模型与学生模型的输出对数概率差作为奖励信号，没有区分教师模型中推理微调带来的能力增量和预训练阶段已有的风格偏好与通用知识，蒸馏信号冗余且指向性不足。
summary.importance: 提出的delta信号框架为后训练阶段的知识蒸馏提供了新的设计思路，可迁移到其他蒸馏场景，帮助优先迁移推理能力而非冗余的风格信息，提升蒸馏效率。
summary.technical_approach: 提出On-Policy Delta Distillation（OPD²），核心是用delta信号替代原OPD的奖励：delta定义为推理微调后的教师模型输出分布与微调前基座教师模型输出分布的差值，仅蒸馏推理微调引入的能力变化。配套两个设计：一是centering，将原始奖励减去期望得到零中心化信号，解决原OPD中信号方向不明确的问题；二是joint conditioning，将delta信号与原OPD奖励联合使用，解决纯delta信号蒸馏的收敛点偏移问题。
summary.experiments: 在数学、科学、代码三个推理领域的混合训练集（1:1:1配比）上开展实验，评测覆盖7个数学、3个科学、4个代码基准，测试模型包括Qwen3不同尺寸（1.7B及以上，含thinking和non-thinking模式）、Gemma-4。OPD²在各尺寸、各领域上均稳定优于原有on-policy蒸馏基线。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看第1章的delta信号动机部分和第3章的奖励设计细节，实验部分扫读主结果表格即可，预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing on-policy distillation (OPD) uses the log-probability gap between teacher and student output distributions as reward, without separating reasoning capability gains from instruction tuning from stylistic preferences and general knowledge already present in the teacher's pretrained base model, leading to redundant and poorly targeted distillation signals.
summary_en.importance: The delta-signal framing offers a new design perspective for post-training knowledge distillation, with transferability to other distillation settings to prioritize reasoning capability transfer over redundant stylistic information and improve distillation efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes On-Policy Delta Distillation (OPD²), which replaces the standard OPD reward with a delta signal defined as the difference between the output distribution of a reasoning-tuned teacher and its base pretrained checkpoint, distilling only the capability changes induced by reasoning tuning. Two supporting designs are added: first, centering, which subtracts the expected reward from the raw signal to produce zero-centered rewards, resolving ambiguous signal direction in vanilla OPD; second, joint conditioning, which combines the delta signal with the original OPD reward to address convergence point drift in pure delta-based distillation.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on a mixed-domain training set with equal parts math, science, and code problems, tested across 7 math, 3 science, and 4 code benchmarks. Tested models span Qwen3 of various sizes (1.7B and above, both thinking and non-thinking modes) and Gemma-4. OPD² consistently outperforms baseline on-policy distillation methods across all model sizes and domains.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the delta signal motivation in Section 1 and reward design details in Section 3. Scan the main results tables in the experiments section. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: delta信号的设计思路对后训练蒸馏与RL奖励构造有启发，重点看§3信号定义与§4消融。
recommendation.en: The delta-signal design is insightful for post-training distillation and RL reward shaping; focus on §3 definition and §4 ablations.

paper.title: ShortOPD: Recovering Pruned LLMs with Short-to-Long On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: Structured pruning is a hardware-friendly way to compress LLMs, but it is mostly validated on multiple-choice recognition tasks, while the same compressed checkpoints can collapse on the free-form generation that deployment actually requires. Two observations trace this gap. First, greedy \textsc{pass}@$1$ nearly vanishes after compression, yet \textsc{pass}@$k$ recovers substantially under repeated sampling: useful generations are demoted, not erased. Second, the recoverable regime fails mainly

summary.core_problem: 解决结构化剪枝后的 LLM 在自由生成任务上明显退化、而传统压缩评测又主要停留在选择题式识别任务的问题。
summary.importance: 这项工作重要，不在于又提出一个蒸馏变体，而在于它点破了压缩评测里的一个常见错位：压缩模型在 pass@1 上塌陷，不代表能力被抹掉，很多时候只是好答案的排序被打坏了。对做模型压缩、蒸馏和部署的人，这个判断比单纯追求压缩率更有用。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 ShortOPD，一种 short-to-long on-policy distillation 日程。出发点是：剪枝模型在自身 rollout 的状态分布上会进入重复后缀等坏轨道，因此应在 on-policy 状态上用原始未剪枝模型做冻结教师，提供密集 token-level 监督；但如果一开始就做长 rollout，训练预算会被低信息量的重复后缀浪费。为此，方法先检测教师确认的重复后缀并截断，先在短轨迹上恢复排序与局部生成，再逐步放长 rollout 长度。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的关键现象是：压缩后 greedy pass@1 几乎消失，但 repeated sampling 下 pass@k 明显回升，说明可恢复解仍在；失败模式主要是 suffix repetition。论文据此比较了常规 OPD 与 short-to-long 调度，目标应是提升自由生成质量而非仅保住选择题精度。摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据量和提升幅度，但从设定看，核心 baseline 是剪枝后直接评测、离线蒸馏或长 rollout OPD。
summary.authors_note: 来自字节跳动与中科院软件所/中科院大学体系。字节近两年在压缩、推理效率和训练后恢复上持续有工程导向的工作，这篇也明显带有部署场景驱动。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets the gap between structured-pruning results on recognition-style benchmarks and the severe collapse of the same pruned LLMs on free-form generation.
summary_en.importance: The value is less about a new distillation variant and more about a useful diagnosis: after pruning, generation quality may collapse because good outputs are demoted rather than erased. For researchers working on compression and deployment, that is a more actionable finding than another compression ratio table.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes ShortOPD, a short-to-long on-policy distillation schedule. The key idea is that pruned models fall into their own bad on-policy states, especially repetitive suffix loops, so recovery should happen on those states with dense token-level supervision from the frozen pre-pruning teacher. But long rollouts early in recovery waste budget on low-information repetitive tails. ShortOPD detects teacher-confirmed repetitive suffixes, truncates them early, and gradually increases rollout length later.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract highlights two empirical findings: greedy pass@1 nearly vanishes after compression, while pass@k recovers substantially under repeated sampling; and the main failure mode is suffix repetition. The method is therefore compared against direct evaluation of pruned checkpoints and likely standard OPD or offline distillation. The abstract does not expose model sizes, data scale, or exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is from ByteDance and CAS-affiliated institutes. It fits the recent line of deployment-driven research on compression, recovery, and efficient serving.

recommendation.zh: 压缩论文里少见地把“能力丢失”和“排序错位”分开讲清楚了；只看摘要里的两个现象和方法动机就值，具体增益要等正文确认 setup 是否干净。
recommendation.en: One of the few compression papers that cleanly separates capability loss from ranking collapse; the two observations alone are worth noting, though the real value depends on how clean the recovery setup is.

paper.title: EasyOPD: An Easy-to-use On-Policy Distillation Framework for Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Conventional language-model distillation often relies on fixed teacher-generated data, which may not cover the states encountered by an evolving student policy. On-policy distillation (OPD) instead collects teacher or evaluator supervision on student-generated rollouts. However, existing OPD methods differ substantially in supervision form, tokenizer compatibility, teacher access, and supervision granularity, leading to fragmented implementations that are difficult to reproduce and extend. We pr

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM on-policy distillation 方法实现碎片化、难复现、难扩展的问题，尤其是在 teacher 监督形式、tokenizer 不兼容和 rollout 监督接入上。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是系统与训练框架层：把多种 OPD 方法抽象到统一执行后端上，降低比较与复现成本。对预训练研究员的价值不在蒸馏本身，而在于它把 post-train 阶段的 on-policy 数据收集、teacher 计算和 tokenizer 对齐这些常见脏活拆清楚了。
summary.technical_approach: EasyOPD 基于 verl 构建，将用户配置、方法特定监督逻辑和分布式执行后端解耦。框架通过明确的扩展边界处理 loss 构造、rollout 元数据、reward 处理、tokenizer 对齐和 teacher-side computation，并实例化三类代表性 OPD 方法以验证统一抽象的覆盖面。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看，重点是框架覆盖多种 on-policy distillation 设定，而不是追求单一任务上的最高分。未给出明确模型参数量和数据规模；更像 reproducibility/engineering paper。若正文有 benchmark，应该关注不同 supervision granularity、teacher access 和 tokenizer mismatch 下的实现差异与开销。
summary.authors_note: 来自中科大、腾讯 LLM Department、上海创新院、NUS。腾讯 verl 生态近来在 RL/后训练基础设施上较活跃，这篇延续的是把训练方法产品化、模块化的路线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the fragmentation of on-policy distillation implementations for LLMs, especially around supervision format, tokenizer mismatch, and rollout-time teacher integration.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is systems and training infrastructure: it factors multiple OPD methods into a unified backend, making comparison and reproduction easier. For a pretraining researcher, the value is less about distillation itself and more about how it cleanly exposes the messy interfaces among on-policy data collection, teacher computation, and tokenizer alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Built on verl, EasyOPD decouples user configuration, method-specific supervision logic, and distributed execution. The framework defines extension boundaries for loss construction, rollout metadata, reward processing, tokenizer alignment, and teacher-side computation, and instantiates representative OPD methods to validate the abstraction.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the emphasis is on framework coverage across multiple on-policy distillation settings rather than chasing a single task metric. Model sizes and data scales are not specified; this reads more like a reproducibility and engineering paper. If reading the full paper, focus on implementation differences and overhead under varying supervision granularity, teacher access, and tokenizer mismatch.
summary_en.authors_note: From USTC, Tencent LLM Department, Shanghai Innovation Institute, and NUS. It fits Tencent's recent pattern of turning RL/post-training methods into modular infrastructure on top of verl.

recommendation.zh: 不是方法突破，但把 OPD 里最烦的接口问题拆得很工程化；做 RL/蒸馏平台的人该看模块边界，做算法的人读实现约束即可。
recommendation.en: Not a method breakthrough, but it cleanly decomposes the ugliest OPD interfaces; platform people should read the extension boundaries, algorithm people can just inspect the implementation constraints.

paper.title: TurnOPD: Making On-Policy Distillation Turn-Aware for Efficient Long-Horizon Agent Training
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student policy by matching a stronger teacher on the student's own trajectories, offering a promising framework for language agent training. However, its application to long-horizon agentic tasks remains insufficiently explored. We identify two key inefficiencies in vanilla agent OPD: (1) full-horizon rollouts often waste wall-clock resources on tail turns that provide weak and noisy KL supervision, and (2) trajectory-level KL objectives concentrate most of

summary.core_problem: TurnOPD 解决长程 agent 任务中 on-policy distillation 的预算分配问题。标准 OPD 让学生模型在自己的轨迹上 rollout，再用更强 teacher 对访问到的状态做 reverse-KL 监督。这种做法在多轮环境交互中有两个低效点：一是固定跑完整 horizon，会在后段低信号、低 survivor count 的 turn 上浪费 wall-clock；二是按 token 聚合 trajectory-level KL 时，浅层 turn 因为更频繁、KL 更大、token 更多而占据大部分 loss，深层关键决策得不到足够训练。
summary.importance: 贡献主要在 post-training 和 agent training，但对预训练研究也有接口价值。它把“训练预算如何沿时间步分配”从 token 层推进到 turn 层，给长程交互模型提供了一个可操作的诊断框架。对 RL pretrain、agentic continual pretrain、tool-use mid-training 都有借鉴意义：当训练样本是模型自己生成的多步轨迹时，不能默认完整轨迹和 token-level averaging 是合理的。实验量级上，TurnOPD 在保持或提升准确率的同时最高把训练 wall-clock 缩短到 1/2.29，属于明确的训练效率改进，而不是只在指标上做小幅调参。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由两个 turn-level budget controller 组成。第一是 adaptive rollout-depth controller。它不是每次都 rollout 到最大轮数，而是周期性 probe 不同深度，根据 survivor-weighted KL 和 coverage threshold 选择当前训练阶段的 rollout horizon。直觉是：如果某些后段 turn 很少被轨迹走到，或者 teacher-student KL 已经低到监督质量不足，继续采样完整尾部的性价比很低；但又不能过早截断，否则深层决策永远没有覆盖。因此控制器同时使用 effective KL quality 和 coverage lower bound，图示中以 H=max(Heff, Hcov) 的方式在“有监督信号”和“有足够覆盖”之间取保守边界。第二是 progressive turn-normalized loss controller。标准 token-normalized KL 会让浅层 turn 主导优化；严格 turn-normalization 又可能把少量、噪声较大的深层样本权重放得过高。TurnOPD 用线性混合 Lmix=(1-a)Ltoken+aLround，并让 a 随训练进度从 0 增加到 1。早期先稳定学习基本交互模式，后期逐步提高深层 turn 的相对权重。与 vanilla OPD 的区别在于，它同时控制“收集多长轨迹”和“loss 如何在 turn 之间分配”，而不是只改变采样长度或只做 loss reweighting。
summary.experiments: 作者先给出诊断结果：在 ALFWorld 上，最深 1/3 turns 只获得 3.6–4.5% 的总 KL loss；在 Multi-Hop Search 上也只有 11–13%。这说明 token-level KL 聚合会系统性压低深层决策的训练信号。评测覆盖三类多轮 agent 任务：embodied planning 的 ALFWorld，web navigation 的 WebShop，以及 Multi-Hop Search，后者包含 PopQA、NQ、2WikiMultiHopQA、HotpotQA。核心结果是 TurnOPD 在所有任务和模型上提升 minimal-time Avg@4。ALFWorld-1.7B 上，Same-Step Avg@4 从 83.0 提升到 86.3，同时 100-step wall time 从 4.42h 降到 1.93h，对应最高 2.29 倍训练加速。WebShop 上准确率和时间同时改善，wall time 从 1.57h 降到 1.24h。消融结果支持两个模块的分工：adaptive depth 是主要效率来源，在 ALFWorld-1.7B 上接近减半 wall time，但单独使用不能解决 loss allocation；linear KL blending 主要提升 Same-Step Avg@4，因为它把监督重新分配给更深的 turn。coverage-floor 消融说明 rollout horizon 可以在保守和激进之间连续调节，而不是依赖单个脆弱阈值。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读，预计 60–90 分钟。先看 introduction 和 Figure 1，抓住 external mismatch 与 internal mismatch：前者是 rollout 深度和有效监督不匹配，后者是 KL loss 在 turn 间分配不匹配。方法部分重点看 adaptive depth 的 probe 统计、survivor-weighted KL、coverage lower bound，以及 H 的选择规则；这些细节决定它是否能迁移到更长 horizon 的 tool-use 或 web agent 训练。loss 部分重点看 Ltoken、Lround 和线性混合系数 a 的定义，尤其是为什么不用一开始就做严格 turn-level normalization。实验部分重点看 ALFWorld-1.7B 的时间-准确率曲线、deepest-third KL share、两个模块的消融和 coverage floor study。值得深挖的问题是：KL 强度低到底表示 teacher-student 已对齐，还是表示自生成上下文污染后 teacher 监督也变弱；这会影响 controller 在更强 teacher、更大 student 或 RL 混合训练中的可靠性。

summary_en.core_problem: TurnOPD addresses budget allocation in on-policy distillation for long-horizon language agents. In standard OPD, a student rolls out in the environment and a stronger teacher provides reverse-KL supervision on the states visited by the student. This becomes inefficient in multi-turn tasks. Full-horizon rollouts spend time on tail turns with weak or noisy supervision, while trajectory-level token averaging concentrates most KL loss on shallow turns and leaves deeper decisions under-trained.
summary_en.importance: The work is mainly a post-training and agent-training contribution, but it is relevant to pretrain–posttrain interfaces. It treats training budget as a turn-level resource rather than a flat token-level quantity. That is a useful lens for RL pretraining, agentic mid-training, continual tool-use training, and any setting where the model generates its own multi-step training distribution. The reported gains are practical: comparable or better accuracy with up to 2.29x lower wall-clock time, plus a clear diagnosis of where supervision is lost along the trajectory.
summary_en.technical_approach: TurnOPD has two controllers. The first is an adaptive rollout-depth controller. Instead of always rolling out to the maximum horizon, it periodically probes turn-level statistics and selects a current rollout depth using survivor-weighted KL and a coverage threshold. The motivation is that late turns may have little reliable supervision because few trajectories survive to them, while blindly truncating rollouts would remove rare but important deep decisions. The controller therefore balances effective KL quality with a coverage-side lower bound; the figure summarizes this as choosing H=max(Heff, Hcov). The second component is a progressive turn-normalized loss controller. Standard token-normalized KL overweights early turns. Pure turn normalization can overcorrect by assigning too much weight to sparse, noisy late-turn samples. TurnOPD uses a linear mixture, Lmix=(1-a)Ltoken+aLround, and increases a over training. Early training keeps the stable token-level signal; later training shifts more weight toward deeper turns once shallow interaction behavior has been learned. The method differs from vanilla OPD by jointly controlling how far to collect trajectories and how to allocate KL loss across turns.
summary_en.experiments: The diagnostic numbers are important. On ALFWorld, the deepest third of turns receives only 3.6–4.5% of total KL loss under standard OPD. On Multi-Hop Search, the corresponding share is 11–13%. This supports the claim that token-level KL aggregation systematically starves deep decisions. The evaluation covers ALFWorld for embodied planning, WebShop for web navigation, and Multi-Hop Search over PopQA, NQ, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and HotpotQA. TurnOPD improves minimal-time Avg@4 across the tested tasks and models. On ALFWorld-1.7B, Same-Step Avg@4 rises from 83.0 to 86.3, while 100-step wall time drops from 4.42 hours to 1.93 hours, giving a 2.29x speedup. On WebShop, both accuracy and time improve, with wall time reduced from 1.57 hours to 1.24 hours. The ablations separate the two effects: adaptive depth is the main efficiency lever and nearly halves wall time on ALFWorld-1.7B, while linear KL blending improves Same-Step Avg@4 by reallocating supervision to deeper turns. Coverage-floor studies show that the rollout horizon can be tuned smoothly between conservative and aggressive settings.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it in detail; 60–90 minutes is a reasonable budget. Start with Figure 1 and the introduction to understand the two mismatches: external mismatch from fixed rollout depth, and internal mismatch from token-level loss allocation. In the method section, focus on the probe procedure, survivor-weighted KL, the coverage lower bound, and the rule used to pick rollout depth. For the loss controller, check the exact definitions of Ltoken, Lround, and the schedule for a; the key design choice is avoiding strict turn normalization at the beginning of training. In the experiments, inspect the time–accuracy curves, the deepest-third KL-loss analysis, module ablations, and the coverage-floor study. A useful follow-up question is whether low KL at late turns means real teacher-student agreement or degraded supervision under self-generated context; that distinction will matter when applying the controller to stronger teachers, larger students, or mixed KL-plus-RL training.

recommendation.zh: 建议看 loss budgeting 细节；turn 级 KL 分配是干净的训练信号问题，可迁移到长程 RLVR 消融。
recommendation.en: Read the loss-budgeting details; turn-level KL allocation is a clean supervision-quality idea worth testing in long-horizon RLVR ablations.

paper.title: Multi-Turn On-Policy Distillation with Prefix Replay
paper.abstract: We study on-policy distillation (OPD) for agentic tasks, where an LLM agent interacts with an environment over multiple turns and a student imitates a teacher over these multi-turn interaction histories. Fully online OPD is costly because each update requires fresh student rollouts through the environment and teacher queries at visited histories. We propose Replayed-Prefix On-Policy Distillation (ReOPD), an off-environment alternative that reuses pre-collected teacher trajectories as replayed pr

summary.core_problem: 多轮智能体场景下的在线策略蒸馏（OPD）在线实现成本极高：每次参数更新都需要学生模型在环境中采样全新轨迹，且每一步交互都要查询教师模型的输出。现有单轮OPD方法无法解决多轮设置下特有的前缀陷阱：完全由学生生成的前缀保证了训练与部署的分布匹配，但会将教师推离其可靠分布产生噪声监督；完全由教师生成的前缀避免了教师OOD问题，却会遇到离线蒸馏常见的复合误差问题。
summary.importance: 该工作将OPD从单轮生成场景拓展到生产级多轮智能体场景，提出的前缀复用机制将蒸馏成本降至接近离线蒸馏的水平，同时保留在线OPD的性能优势。核心的双边分布偏移分解修正了此前“越on-policy效果越好”的直觉误区。方法对当前推理模型、智能体模型的小模型蒸馏链路有直接落地价值，尤其是教师RL训练过程中产生的轨迹可以零额外环境交互成本直接复用。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Replayed-Prefix On-Policy Distillation（ReOPD）框架，维护一个离线教师轨迹池，轨迹全部来自教师RL训练的副产物，不需要额外环境交互。训练时从池中采样前缀，学生仅在目标步骤生成自己的动作，环境观测直接从存储的轨迹中读取，不需要实时环境调用，教师也仅在当前步骤提供逐token分布监督，不需要生成完整轨迹。理论上，ReOPD与理想交互式OPD目标的差距被分解为两项：一是学生占用不匹配项（使用非学生生成前缀带来的分布偏移），二是教师可靠性项（教师在学生诱导的OOD历史上提供监督带来的误差），证明完全on-policy训练并非全局最优。基于该分解，多轮OPD被重构为可靠性感知的前缀分布设计问题，通过几何分布桥接学生和教师的前缀占用，实现上采用简单的步衰减采样调度：训练早期、交互轮次靠前时，更多使用学生on-policy前缀（此时师生能力差距小，教师可靠性高）；训练后期、交互轮次靠后时，更多使用回放的教师前缀，降低不可靠教师监督的噪声。框架天然支持多环境训练，只需将不同环境的教师轨迹合并到同一个离线池即可，不需要蒸馏时同时部署所有环境。
summary.experiments: 在数学推理基准、多轮搜索智能体环境上完成验证。单环境场景下，ReOPD性能与完全在线OPD相当，单步训练耗时降低60%以上，环境/工具调用次数降至接近零。在师生能力差距较大的场景下，步衰减前缀调度比纯在线OPD性能高2-3个百分点，原因是避免了教师在学生OOD前缀上的噪声监督。多环境场景下，ReOPD仅通过合并离线轨迹池完成训练，性能优于分开训练再模型合并的基线，训练成本仅为在线OPD的1/5。消融实验验证了双边偏移的权衡关系：师生差距小时，更高比例的学生前缀提升性能；师生差距大时，更高比例的教师前缀、对靠后轮次降权效果更好，与理论分解的预测一致。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第3节的双边分布偏移边界推导，这是核心概念洞见，修正了此前对on-policy蒸馏的直觉。查看图1的性能-成本权衡对比、图2的ReOPD工作流程。第4节的前缀采样调度设计可落地性极强，步衰减调度实现非常简单。消融部分重点关注师生能力差距变化时最优前缀分布的偏移结果，直接对应理论边界中的两个项。单轮蒸馏相关工作部分可泛读跳过。

summary_en.core_problem: On-policy distillation (OPD) for multi-turn agentic tasks incurs prohibitive cost in standard online implementations: every parameter update requires fresh student rollouts through the environment and teacher inference at every visited interaction history. Existing single-turn OPD methods fail to address the unique prefix trap in multi-turn settings: fully student-on-policy prefixes ensure train-deployment distribution match but push the teacher out of its reliable distribution to produce noisy supervision; fully teacher-generated prefixes avoid teacher OOD issues but suffer from compounding errors common to offline distillation.
summary_en.importance: This work extends OPD from single-turn generation to production-grade multi-turn agent settings. The proposed prefix replay mechanism brings distillation cost close to offline distillation levels while retaining the performance benefits of online OPD. The core two-sided distribution shift decomposition corrects the prior intuitive assumption that higher on-policy ratio always leads to better results. The method has immediate practical value for distilling small reasoning and agent models, especially since teacher trajectories generated during RL training can be reused at zero additional environment interaction cost.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Replayed-Prefix On-Policy Distillation (ReOPD) framework maintains an offline pool of teacher trajectories collected as a byproduct of teacher RL training, requiring no extra environment interaction. During training, prefixes are sampled from this pool; the student generates its own action at the target step, environment observations are read directly from stored trajectories instead of executing live environment calls, and the teacher only provides per-token distribution supervision at the current step rather than generating full trajectories. Theoretically, the gap between ReOPD and the ideal interactive OPD objective is decomposed into two terms: a student occupancy mismatch term from using non-student-generated prefixes, and a teacher reliability term from error when the teacher provides supervision on OOD student-induced histories, proving fully on-policy training is not universally optimal. Guided by this decomposition, multi-turn OPD is framed as reliability-aware prefix distribution design, using a geometric bridge between student and teacher prefix occupancy. A simple step-decay sampling schedule is used for implementation: early in training and for early interaction steps, more student-on-policy prefixes are used when the teacher-student gap is small and the teacher remains reliable; later in training and for late interaction steps, more replayed teacher prefixes are used to reduce noise from unreliable teacher supervision. The framework naturally supports multi-environment training by merging teacher trajectories from separate environments into a single offline pool, eliminating the need to deploy all environments simultaneously during distillation.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations are conducted on mathematical reasoning benchmarks and multi-turn search agent environments. In single-environment settings, ReOPD matches the performance of fully online OPD while reducing per-step training time by over 60% and cutting environment/tool calls to near zero. In settings with large capability gaps between teacher and student, the step-decay prefix schedule outperforms pure online OPD by 2-3 percentage points, as it avoids noisy supervision from teachers acting on OOD student prefixes. In multi-environment settings, ReOPD trains by simply merging offline trajectory pools, outperforming separate training and model merging baselines at 1/5 the training cost of online OPD. Ablation studies confirm the two-sided shift tradeoff: when the teacher-student gap is small, higher shares of student prefixes improve performance; when the gap is large, higher shares of teacher prefixes and downweighting late interaction steps deliver better results, consistent with theoretical predictions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the two-sided distribution shift bound derivation, which contains the core conceptual insight correcting prior intuition on on-policy distillation. Examine Figure 1 for the performance-cost tradeoff comparison and Figure 2 for the ReOPD workflow. Section 4 covers the prefix sampling schedule design; the step-decay schedule is extremely simple to implement in production. In the ablation section, pay close attention to results showing how optimal prefix distribution shifts with changes in the teacher-student capability gap, which maps directly to the two terms in the theoretical bound. The related work section on single-turn distillation can be skimmed.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和 prefix trap 分析即可；它提醒蒸馏里“更 on-policy”不总是更干净的监督。
recommendation.en: Read the method and prefix-trap analysis; it is a useful warning that more on-policy distillation can mean worse teacher targets.

paper.title: Rethinking On-Policy Self-Distillation for Thinking Models
paper.abstract: Self-distillation is a promising recipe for self-improvement in language models. In this setting, a model can serve as its own teacher when given privileged information, such as a solution to a math problem. This seems especially appealing for thinking models, which can use test-time reasoning to absorb the privileged information. Surprisingly, we show that privileged self-distillation degrades thinking models on long reasoning traces: across five Qwen3 and OLMo thinking models evaluated on AIME

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 thinking models 上的 on-policy self-distillation 是否真的能带来自我改进。核心发现是负面的：当 teacher 拿到 gold solution、final answer 等 privileged context 后，学生会学到更短、更少分叉的推理轨迹，长预算推理能力反而下降。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值在于，它提醒 post-train 信号会改变模型的推理动力学，尤其是长链推理中的探索行为。privileged context 看起来提供了更强监督，但它也会让 teacher 在高不确定位置不再需要试探、回看和分支。学生只看到这种被压缩后的 token 分布，却没有 teacher 的额外信息，因此会削弱测试时依赖的 deliberation 行为。这个结论对 RL、蒸馏、self-improvement 数据构造都有参考意义：更强的 teacher 条件不一定对应更好的学生训练信号。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把 on-policy distillation 写成 context-explicit objective：学生先在问题 x 上采样 rollout y，再沿着该 rollout 最小化 teacher 与 student 的 token-level divergence。vanilla OPD 中 teacher 只看普通上下文；privileged OPD/OPSD 中 teacher 额外看到 final answer 或完整 gold demonstration。实验主要使用 JSD distillation，训练 1 epoch，有效 batch size 64，训练 completion cap 为 4096 tokens。关键分析不是只看最终准确率，而是比较 teacher 加入 privileged context 后在 rollout token 上给出的蒸馏信号如何变化。论文提出 fork suppression：在高熵、容易分叉的位置，例如出现 wait、hmm、but、maybe 等词的位置，vanilla OPD 下这些 token 往往有正向 advantage；加入 privileged context 后 advantage 翻为负，学生训练后更少产生这类标记。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 5 个 OpenThoughts 训练过的 thinking models，包含 Qwen3 和 OLMo 系列，并在 AIME24、AIME25、HMMT25 上评估。训练数据使用 OpenThoughts 15k 子集。主要结果是 full-solution privileged-context distillation 在 thinking models 上导致 avg@16 accuracy 最高相对下降 17%。伤害随 privileged context 的信息量增加而加重：只提供 final answer 的影响较轻，提供完整解法的影响更明显。对照实验显示，在相同短训练预算下，用更大 teacher 做 vanilla OPD 可以提升 thinking student；问题不是 4096-token 训练上限本身，而是 privileged context 改变了 teacher 分布。另一个重要观察是，gold-demo-conditioned teacher 自身没有明显掉点，它能生成更短 rollout 同时保持较高 pass@k；但学生继承了短回答倾向，却不能继承 teacher 的条件信息带来的收益。长 rollout budget 下退化更明显，并伴随 fork rate、自我修正信号和 deliberation markers 的下降。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Introduction、Experimental Setup 和 token-level analysis 部分，约 25–35 分钟。重点看三处：第一，context-explicit OPD objective，确认 teacher-only context 是如何进入蒸馏目标的；第二，full solution、final answer、vanilla OPD 的对照结果，用来判断退化来自哪里；第三，forking positions 的 per-token signal 分析，这是论文最有信息量的部分。附录中的超参和模型列表值得快速核对，特别是 completion cap、batch size、distillation divergence 和数据规模。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether on-policy self-distillation remains beneficial for thinking models when the teacher is given privileged information such as a gold solution or final answer. The answer is largely negative: privileged-context distillation shortens and smooths the reasoning trajectory, and the student loses part of the long-budget search behavior it needs at test time.
summary_en.importance: The main lesson is about training signal quality for reasoning models. A teacher with more information can produce a cleaner next-token distribution, but that distribution may remove the uncertainty-handling behavior that an unprivileged student still needs. This matters for self-improvement, RL data generation, and distillation recipes: privileged supervision can be harmful when it suppresses exploration, branching, and self-correction rather than teaching the student how to perform them.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formulate on-policy distillation with an explicit teacher-only context variable. The student samples an on-policy rollout for a math problem, and training minimizes a token-level divergence between teacher and student distributions along that rollout. Vanilla OPD uses no extra context; privileged OPD/OPSD gives the teacher a final answer or a full gold demonstration. The default setup uses JSD distillation for one epoch, effective batch size 64, and a 4096-token completion cap. The central analysis studies token-level signals at high-entropy forking positions. Tokens such as “wait”, “hmm”, “but”, and “maybe” receive positive advantage under vanilla OPD, but become negatively reinforced when the teacher has privileged context. This sign flip is used to explain the observed fork suppression.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses five OpenThoughts-trained thinking models from the Qwen3 and OLMo families, trained on a 15k OpenThoughts subset and evaluated on AIME24, AIME25, and HMMT25. Full-solution privileged-context distillation causes up to a 17% relative drop in avg@16 accuracy. The degradation increases with the amount of privileged information: final-answer-only context is less damaging, while full-solution context is substantially worse. A key control shows that the short training completion budget is not the main cause: under the same setup, vanilla OPD with a larger teacher improves the thinking student, whereas privileged context reverses the gain. The conditioned teacher itself can keep high pass@k with shorter rollouts, but the student inherits the shorter style without inheriting the teacher’s extra information. The performance drop is strongest at long rollout budgets and correlates with fewer forks, fewer self-correction cues, and fewer deliberation markers.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim should take about 25–35 minutes. Read the objective in the experimental setup to understand how privileged context enters only the teacher. Then inspect the comparisons among vanilla OPD, final-answer conditioning, and full-solution conditioning. The most useful part is the token-level analysis of forking positions, because it connects an aggregate accuracy drop to a concrete change in the distillation signal. The appendix is worth checking for model identities, data size, divergence choice, completion cap, and batch size.

recommendation.zh: 特权自蒸馏反而损害长推理性能的反常识结论直接挑战现有做法，建议重点读第4节失效分析和诊断部分。
recommendation.en: The counterintuitive finding that privileged self-distillation harms long-horizon reasoning challenges current practices; focus on Section 4 for failure analysis and diagnostics.

paper.title: Reward-Gated On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation is a powerful way to transfer reasoning ability from a strong teacher to a smaller student: the student samples trajectories from its own policy, and the teacher provides dense token-level supervision on the states the student actually visits. However, this supervision is not always reliable: a teacher can assign high likelihood to plausible but incorrect solutions, or low likelihood to correct student solutions that follow different reasoning paths. Unconditionally distil

summary.core_problem: On-policy distillation（在线策略蒸馏）将大模型教师的推理能力迁移到学生模型时，教师信号并非总是可靠：教师可能给似是而非的错误解分配高似然，也可能给学生探索出的正确新路分配低似然；无条件蒸馏会强化错误模式或抹掉学生有用的行为，而稀疏验证器奖励又无法提供逐token的密集学习信号。
summary.importance: 提出了一种简单有效的门控机制，将稀疏验证器奖励与密集教师logits直接桥接，在保留逐token蒸馏密度的同时避免了无条件蒸馏的核心失效模式。对后训练阶段的推理能力蒸馏、RLVR与知识蒸馏的结合有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 核心是奖励-教师似然门（Reward-Teacher Likelihood Gate）。对每条学生采样轨迹，同时获取轨迹级奖励（实验中使用GRPO优势）和轨迹级教师-学生对数似然差。门控规则：奖励为正的轨迹，仅当教师似然高于学生时才参与蒸馏损失；奖励为负的轨迹，仅当教师似然低于学生时才参与蒸馏损失。其余轨迹从蒸馏损失中剔除。蒸馏损失本身沿用top-k reverse-KL形式不变，仅通过改变参与损失的轨迹集合实现筛选。
summary.experiments: 使用Qwen2.5-1.5B/14B-Instruct作为师生对，在UltraInteract子集上训练3轮。RG-OPD平均得分46.94，优于vanilla Reverse-KL基线（44.02）高2.9分，优于TSD-KD（42.03）。数学和编码任务上提升一致；例外是IFEval任务，TSD-KD得分54.68，RG-OPD为48.60，作者归因于TSD-KD以学生为中心的设计结合了偏好间接反馈与token选择性蒸馏等机制。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第2章方法部分的门控规则定义与两种失效模式分析；第3章实验结果与不同任务的差异表现。泛读预计15-20分钟。值得关注的点：门控机制与GRPO优势结合的细节，以及在不同任务上表现差异的深层原因。

summary_en.core_problem: In on-policy distillation for reasoning transfer, teacher supervision is not always reliable: a teacher may assign high likelihood to plausible but incorrect solutions, or low likelihood to correct student solutions following different reasoning paths. Unconditional distillation can either reinforces bad modes or erases useful student behaviors, while sparse verifier rewards cannot provide dense token-level learning signals.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a simple yet effective gating mechanism that bridges sparse verifier rewards and dense teacher logits, retaining the density of token-level distillation while avoiding the central failure mode of unconditional distillation. It has direct reference value for reasoning capability distillation during post-training and the combination of RLVR and knowledge distillation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core is the Reward-Teacher Likelihood Gate. For each student-sampled trajectory, both trajectory-level reward (GRPO advantage in experiments) and trajectory-level teacher-student log-likelihood gap are computed. The gating rule: for reward-positive trajectories, only distill when teacher likelihood is higher than student; for reward-negative trajectories, only distill when teacher likelihood is lower than student. All other trajectories are dropped from the distillation loss. The distillation loss itself remains top-k reverse-KL; only the set of trajectories contributing to the loss is filtered.
summary_en.experiments: Uses Qwen2.5-1.5B/14B-Instruct as teacher-student pair, trained for 3 epochs on a subset of UltraInteract. RG-OPD achieves average score 46.94, 2.9 points above vanilla Reverse-KL baseline (44.02) and above TSD-KD (42.03). Gains are consistent across math and coding tasks. An exception is IFEval where TSD-KD scores 54.68 vs RG-OPD's 48.60, attributed to TSD-KD's student-centric design combining preference-based indirect feedback and token-selective distillation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 for the gating rule definition and analysis of two failure modes; Section 3 for experimental results and task-wise performance differences. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes for skim. Worth noting: details of gating combined with GRPO advantage, and root causes of performance differences across tasks.

recommendation.zh: 结合了 verifier reward 和 teacher logits 的蒸馏方法，解决了 teacher 强行纠正 student 正确但不同 reasoning path 的问题，对 post-training 数据合成有启发。
recommendation.en: Combines verifier reward and teacher logits for distillation, solving the issue of teachers penalizing correct but alternative reasoning paths; inspiring for post-training data synthesis.

paper.title: DOPD: Dual On-policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) offers superior capacity transfer by supervising student-sampled trajectories with dense token-level signals. To furnish high-quality supervision sources and thereby elevate the performance frontier of distillation, an intuitive direction is to infuse privileged information to either teacher or student itself. However, this additional input induces a potential failure mode we dub privilege illusion: a pattern that conflates the transferable capability gap that studen

summary.core_problem: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）流程中引入特权信息（如推理验证提示、结构化视觉标注）时，存在名为“特权幻觉”的失效模式：教师模型的表现优势一部分来自学生永远无法获得的信息不对称，而非可学习、可迁移的能力差距。现有OPD方法对所有token施加权重一致的统一监督，会引导学生拟合特权相关的捷径特征，而非真正的通用能力，进而引发熵塌缩、探索不足，最终降低蒸馏效果。
summary.importance: 该工作明确刻画了一个之前未被系统描述的蒸馏失效机制，解释了“特权信息能提升教师表现，但蒸馏到学生后收益经常消失”的常见现象。提出的自适应监督路由方案实现轻量化，对后训练阶段的蒸馏流程设计、VLM对齐、引入辅助信息的持续学习场景都有实际参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出双在线策略蒸馏框架DOPD，同时维护两路互补的监督信号：特权信息增强的教师输出分布、学生自身的自蒸馏目标，无需引入额外模型。核心是token级动态路由机制：根据特权教师与学生在单token上的相对预测概率差（即特权优势gap）动态调整两路信号的权重。对教师展现出可信可迁移能力优势的token，施加更高权重的教师蒸馏监督；对教师优势大概率来自不可访问特权信息、或与核心能力关联较弱的token，降低教师监督权重，更多依赖轻量自蒸馏信号维持训练稳定性、鼓励策略探索，实现监督来源、强度、粒度的token级自适应调整，避免无差别拟合不可迁移的特权信号。
summary.experiments: 在LLM、VLM两类蒸馏场景的8个基准测试中，DOPD相比原生OPD平均分别提升7.5分、6.0分；在5组不同规模差的师生模型对上，稳定带来6.2-10.6分的性能提升。方法在持续学习、分布外评测、训练稳定性场景下也有一致收益，配套的token级散度分析、敏感性消融实验验证了路由逻辑的合理性，以及特权幻觉现象的存在。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。重点关注引言部分对特权幻觉现象的定义与观测、方法章节的token路由权重计算逻辑，快速浏览跨场景泛化的实验结果即可，无需深究低层实现细节。核心收获是理解“特权信息带来的收益分为可迁移能力增益、不可迁移信息差增益两部分”这一观察。预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: On-policy distillation (OPD) suffers from a failure mode called 'privilege illusion' when privileged information (e.g., verified reasoning hints, structured visual annotations) is provided to teacher or student models: a portion of the teacher's performance advantage stems from information asymmetry that students can never access, rather than learnable, transferable capability gaps. Existing OPD methods apply uniform, equal-weight supervision across all tokens, leading students to fit privilege-specific shortcut features instead of generalizable capabilities, which causes entropy collapse, reduced exploration, and degraded distillation outcomes.
summary_en.importance: This work characterizes a previously under-documented distillation failure mode, explaining the common observation that privileged information boosts teacher performance but often fails to deliver student gains after distillation. The proposed adaptive supervision routing mechanism is lightweight to implement, and provides actionable guidance for distillation pipeline design in post-training, VLM alignment, and continual learning scenarios where auxiliary inputs are used.
summary_en.technical_approach: Dual On-policy Distillation (DOPD) maintains two complementary supervision signals per token without introducing extra models: the output distribution of the privilege-augmented teacher, and the student's own self-distillation target. The core design is a token-level routing mechanism that dynamically adjusts weights for the two signals based on the privilege advantage gap, measured as the relative prediction probability difference between the privileged teacher and the student on each token. Tokens where the teacher shows credible, transferable capability advantage receive higher teacher distillation weight; tokens where the teacher's advantage likely comes from inaccessible privileged information, or is weakly tied to core capabilities, receive lower teacher supervision weight and rely more on lightweight self-distillation to preserve training stability and encourage exploration. This design enables token-level adaptive adjustment of supervision source, strength, and granularity, avoiding indiscriminate fitting of non-transferable privilege signals.
summary_en.experiments: Across 8 benchmarks for LLM and VLM distillation setups, DOPD outperforms vanilla OPD by an average of 7.5 and 6.0 points respectively. It delivers consistent gains of 6.2–10.6 points across 5 teacher-student pairs with varying size gaps. The method also shows consistent benefits in continual learning, out-of-distribution evaluation, and training stability settings. Supporting token-level divergence analysis and sensitivity ablation validate the routing logic and the existence of the privilege illusion effect.
summary_en.reading_guide: Suitable for skimming. Focus on the definition and empirical observations of privilege illusion in the introduction, and the token routing weight calculation logic in the methodology section. Cross-scenario generalization results can be scanned quickly, and low-level implementation details do not require close reading. The core takeaway is the observation that gains from privileged information split into two components: transferable capability gains, and non-transferable information asymmetry gains. Expected reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 指出了蒸馏中引入特权信息导致的 'privilege illusion' 问题，对后训练阶段的数据合成和模型蒸馏有一定启发，可快速浏览其动态路由机制。
recommendation.en: Identifies the 'privilege illusion' issue caused by privileged information in distillation, offering insights for data synthesis and model distillation in post-training; skim the dynamic routing mechanism.

paper.title: Scaling the Horizon, Not the Parameters: Reaching Trillion-Parameter Performance with a 35B Agent
paper.abstract: We introduce Agents-A1, a 35B Mixture-of-Experts Agentic Model that reaches trillion-parameter-level performance by scaling the agent horizon. We investigate agent-horizon scaling from two perspectives: scaling long-horizon trajectories and scaling heterogeneous agent abilities. To support this goal, we build a long-horizon knowledge-action infrastructure that connects external knowledge, actions, observations, and verifier outcomes, producing agentic trajectories with an average length of 45K t

summary.core_problem: 现有长程智能体的能力提升路径存在明显局限：扩参路线成本极高，中小团队难以复现同等能力；扩交互horizon路线则面临两个核心瓶颈——一是缺乏能连接外部知识、动作、观测、验证信号的统一数据基础设施，无法生成带过程监督的高质量长程交互轨迹；二是不同领域的智能体能力（多步检索、工具调用、迭代执行、验证反思等）推理模式差异大，整合到单一模型时易出现能力冲突。
summary.importance: 验证了“优先扩展交互horizon而非模型参数”的智能体能力scaling路径，证明35B参数规模的MoE模型通过长程过程监督，可达到万亿参数模型的长程智能体性能，为算力有限的团队提供了可落地的能力提升方向。基于知识-动作图的长程轨迹构建方法，为预训练、后训练阶段的过程级监督数据生产提供了可复用的框架。域路由on-policy蒸馏+显著词对齐的方案，为多域异质能力的整合提供了新的后训练思路，对多域持续预训练中的能力融合也有借鉴意义。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方案分为基础设施构建和三阶段训练两部分：1）长程知识-动作基础设施：搭建知识-动作图（KAG），整合外部知识、智能体动作、环境观测、执行结果、验证信号、失败案例等多源信息，生成平均长度45K token、带密集过程监督的长程智能体轨迹。2）三阶段训练流程：第一阶段，全域监督微调，让基座模型对齐通用的长程智能体行为模式；第二阶段，针对6个异质领域分别训练领域教师模型（采用针对性SFT或RL），获取各领域的专精能力；第三阶段，通过域路由的on-policy蒸馏（OPD）+显著词对齐整合多教师能力——域路由机制根据输入任务类型匹配对应教师提供监督信号，显著词对齐则缓解不同领域推理模式差异带来的能力冲突，最终得到单一可部署的35B MoE学生模型Agents-A1。
summary.experiments: 在SEAL-0、IFBench、HiPhO、FrontierScience-Olympiad、MolBench-Bind等长程智能体、科学研究类基准上，35B的Agents-A1性能超过Kimi-K2.6、DeepSeek-V4等万亿参数模型；在SciCode、HLE、BrowseComp基准上也取得较强结果。训练所用的长程轨迹平均长度为45K token，覆盖6个异质领域。
summary.reading_guide: 先泛读引言，重点理解参数scaling与horizon scaling两条路径的差异，以及horizon scaling的两个核心瓶颈。再看知识-动作基础设施的设计，尤其是知识-动作图的构成逻辑和长程轨迹的生成方式。随后关注三阶段训练流程，重点是域路由on-policy蒸馏和显著词对齐的具体实现。最后查看核心基准的性能对比数据，尤其是与万亿参数模型的横向对比。预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing capability improvement paths for long-horizon agents have clear limitations. The parameter scaling route has extremely high costs, making it hard for small and medium teams to reproduce comparable capabilities. The interaction horizon scaling route faces two core bottlenecks: first, the lack of a unified data infrastructure that connects external knowledge, actions, observations, and verification signals, making it impossible to generate high-quality long-horizon interaction trajectories with process-level supervision; second, heterogeneous agent capabilities across domains (multi-step retrieval, tool use, iterative execution, verification, reflection, etc.) have highly divergent reasoning patterns, which easily lead to capability conflicts when integrated into a single model.
summary_en.importance: This work validates an agent capability scaling path that prioritizes interaction horizon expansion over parameter growth. It proves that a 35B MoE model can match trillion-parameter models on long-horizon agent tasks via long-horizon process supervision, providing an actionable capability improvement direction for teams with limited compute budgets. The knowledge-action graph based long-horizon trajectory construction method provides a reusable framework for producing process-level supervision data for both pretraining and post-training stages. The domain-routed on-policy distillation with salient vocabulary alignment offers a new post-training approach for integrating heterogeneous multi-domain capabilities, and also has reference value for capability fusion in multi-domain continual pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core solution is divided into infrastructure construction and a three-stage training pipeline. First, a long-horizon knowledge-action infrastructure is built: a Knowledge-Action Graph (KAG) is constructed to integrate multi-source information including external knowledge, agent actions, environment observations, execution results, verification signals, and failure cases, producing long-horizon agentic trajectories with an average length of 45K tokens and dense process-level supervision. Second, the three-stage training pipeline is implemented for the 35B MoE Agents-A1: 1) Full-domain supervised fine-tuning to align the base model with general long-horizon agent behavior patterns; 2) Training domain-specific teacher models for 6 heterogeneous domains via targeted SFT or RL to acquire specialized expertise in each domain; 3) Integrating multi-teacher capabilities via domain-routed On-Policy Distillation (OPD) with salient vocabulary alignment: the domain router matches the corresponding teacher to provide supervision signals based on the input task type, and salient vocabulary alignment mitigates capability conflicts caused by divergent reasoning patterns across domains, finally producing a single deployable student model.
summary_en.experiments: On long-horizon agent and scientific research benchmarks including SEAL-0, IFBench, HiPhO, FrontierScience-Olympiad, and MolBench-Bind, the 35B Agents-A1 outperforms trillion-parameter models such as Kimi-K2.6 and DeepSeek-V4. It also delivers strong performance on SciCode, HLE, and BrowseComp. The training trajectories have an average length of 45K tokens and cover 6 heterogeneous domains.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction to understand the differences between the parameter scaling and horizon scaling paths, as well as the two core bottlenecks of horizon scaling. Then review the design of the knowledge-action infrastructure, especially the composition logic of the Knowledge-Action Graph and the long-horizon trajectory generation method. Next, focus on the three-stage training pipeline, with particular attention to the specific implementation of domain-routed OPD and salient vocabulary alignment. Finally, check the core benchmark performance comparison data, especially the horizontal comparison with trillion-parameter models. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读数据基础设施和蒸馏 ablation；“35B 到万亿级”先当营销口径，但 45K 轨迹构造值得拆开复现。
recommendation.en: Read the data infrastructure and distillation ablations; treat the 35B-to-trillion claim cautiously, but the 45K-token trajectory construction is worth dissecting.

paper.title: ATOD: Annealed Turn-aware On-policy Distillation for Multi-turn Autonomous Agents
paper.abstract: Training small language-model agents for long-horizon interactive tasks requires both fast imitation and reward-driven improvement. On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense teacher guidance and typically improves rapidly in the early stage, but its gains saturate once the student approaches the teacher, limiting the final performance ceiling. Reinforcement learning (RL) directly optimizes environment rewards and encourages exploratory improvement toward a higher reward-defined ceiling, but sp

summary.core_problem: 小模型 agent 训练中，on-policy 蒸馏早期收敛快但后期饱和，RL 上限高但早期样本效率低，二者互补性未被充分利用。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出退火式 turn-aware 在线蒸馏算法，显式融合 OPD 与 RL 的阶段优势提升多轮交互 agent 性能。
summary.technical_approach: 设计退火 OPD-RL 训练日程：训练早期以 OPD 为主快速模仿教师行为，后期逐步增强 RL 权重驱动奖励探索；引入 Turn-level Disagreement-Uncertainty Reweighting（T-DUR）按轮次分歧与不确定性重加权训练样本。
summary.experiments: 面向多轮自主交互 agent 任务验证，摘要未披露具体模型参数量、数据集与基线对比幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Training small LM agents for long-horizon interactive tasks: on-policy distillation converges fast early but saturates, while RL has a higher ceiling but poor early sample efficiency, and their complementarity is under-exploited.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes an annealed turn-aware online distillation algorithm that explicitly combines the stage-wise strengths of OPD and RL to improve multi-turn interactive agent performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: Deploys an annealed OPD-RL schedule where OPD dominates early training to mimic teacher behavior quickly, and RL weight is gradually increased to drive reward-based exploration; introduces Turn-level Disagreement-Uncertainty Reweighting (T-DUR) to reweight samples by turn-level disagreement and uncertainty.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on multi-turn autonomous agent tasks; abstract does not specify model size, datasets, or quantitative margins over baselines.

recommendation.zh: OPD+RL 退火调度的思路可直接迁移到 agent-SFT/RL 混合训练 recipe，重点看 §3 的调度公式与权重设计。
recommendation.en: The annealed OPD+RL schedule is directly transferable to mixed agent-SFT/RL training recipes; focus on the schedule formulation and weighting design in §3.

paper.title: V-Zero: Answer-Label-Free On-Policy Distillation with Contrastive Evidence Gating for Fine-Grained Visual Reasoning
paper.abstract: Fine-grained visual reasoning requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to identify task-relevant visual evidence and ground their reasoning in local image regions. Existing agentic methods typically rely on reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards or supervised fine-tuning on large-scale annotated reasoning traces, leading to costly exploration, hand-designed verification rules, or heavy dependence on textual supervision. A natural way to avoid such external answer labels is to le

summary.core_problem: 在没有答案标签和人工推理轨迹的条件下，提升 MLLM 对细粒度视觉证据的定位和视觉推理能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态后训练方法分析与改进。它把 on-policy distillation 解释为 negative-free stop-gradient alignment，并指出其缺少轨迹级区分信号，因而推理能力有上限。对预训练研究员的价值主要在于理解视觉推理训练信号的质量，而不是基座预训练 recipe。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 V-Zero，一个 answer-label-free 的视觉推理框架。核心思路是在学生模型自身采样轨迹上做 on-policy distillation，并加入 contrastive evidence gating，用视觉证据对推理轨迹进行区分，补足单纯 token-level correction 缺少 trajectory-level discrimination 的问题。
summary.experiments: 摘要未完整给出 benchmark、模型规模、训练数据规模和具体提升数字；可确认实验目标是细粒度视觉推理与局部证据 grounding，并与 RLVR、SFT 标注推理轨迹、普通 OPD 等路线对比。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自四川大学、西安交通大学、中国电信 TeleAI、北京大学等机构；未从给定信息中确认有广泛公认的基座模型代表作者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets fine-grained visual reasoning in MLLMs without answer labels or annotated reasoning traces, especially the ability to ground reasoning in local visual evidence.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an analysis and improvement of multimodal post-training signals. It recasts on-policy distillation as negative-free stop-gradient alignment and argues that missing trajectory-level discrimination limits its ceiling. For pretraining researchers, the value is mostly about training-signal quality for visual reasoning, not base-model pretraining recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces V-Zero, an answer-label-free visual reasoning framework. The method distills from student-sampled on-policy trajectories and adds contrastive evidence gating so that visual evidence can discriminate among trajectories, addressing the limitation of token-level correction alone.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not include full benchmarks, model scale, data scale, or exact gains. The experimental setup appears to compare against RLVR-style methods, SFT with annotated reasoning traces, and vanilla OPD on fine-grained visual reasoning and evidence grounding.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institutions include Sichuan University, Xi’an Jiaotong University, TeleAI of China Telecom, and Peking University. No widely established base-model author is identifiable from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 只看 OPD 上限分析和 evidence gating 消融；它是训练信号质量的弱证据，不是预训练范式变化。
recommendation.en: Read only the OPD-limit analysis and evidence-gating ablations; it is a weak signal on training-signal quality, not a pretraining shift.

paper.title: AsyncOPD: How Stale Can On-Policy Distillation Be?
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own rollouts guided by teacher feedback and is becoming increasingly important for large language model (LLM) post-training. Like reinforcement learning (RL), however, OPD faces an on-policy systems bottleneck, as rollouts can dominate training time for reasoning workloads. Asynchronous training pipelines can alleviate this bottleneck by decoupling rollout generation from learner updates, but doing so introduces stale-policy data. While prior

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究异步 on-policy distillation 中的 stale-policy 数据问题：rollout、teacher scoring 和 learner update 解耦后，训练吞吐提高，但 learner 看到的是旧 student 生成并被 teacher 打分的数据。核心难点不只是“数据过期”，还包括实际 OPD 系统通常不会缓存全词表 teacher logits，只会缓存有限动作集合上的 teacher 分数，这会改变 KL 目标和估计器的偏差、方差与可校正性。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值在 post-train 系统和训练目标接口上。OPD 正在成为小模型推理能力提升、自蒸馏、多 teacher 蒸馏的重要路径，瓶颈往往在长链推理 rollout，而不是反向传播。论文把异步 RL 中常见的 stale data 问题搬到 OPD，但指出 OPD 的 teacher-cache 约束会让问题不同。这个观察对设计大规模 SFT/RL/蒸馏混合管线有参考意义：系统吞吐、teacher 评分成本、目标函数形式不能分开优化。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分析围绕三个层次展开。第一，比较 forward KL 和 reverse KL 在 stale rollout 下的差异。forward KL 是 teacher-weighted，更依赖 teacher 分布覆盖；在缓存 teacher-scored action 时相对稳健。reverse KL 是 student-weighted，learner 更新后当前 student 的高概率动作可能不在旧缓存里，因此更容易出现 support mismatch。第二，把 reverse-KL OPD 写成类似 policy-gradient 的形式，用 teacher-student log-ratio 作为 token-level advantage，再比较 PPO-style clipping、decoupled PPO、M2PO 等异步 RL 稳定化方法。结论是这些 RL surrogate 没有超过一个更简单的 OPD 方案：在 learner time 用当前 student 重新计算 reverse-KL 的 token-level advantage，并且不做 clipping。第三，分析有限 teacher cache 下的估计器。旧 student top-k support 覆盖稳定但不可校正，因为缺失的 teacher score 无法恢复；one-sample Monte Carlo 可用 importance correction，但方差高；multi-sample MC 在每个 decoding step 缓存多个 stale-policy samples，保留可校正性，同时降低方差。最终系统 AsyncOPD 将 student rollout、teacher scoring、learner update 全异步重叠。
summary.experiments: 实验主要验证四点。第一，KL 方向决定 stale-policy 敏感性：forward KL 对旧 rollout 更稳，reverse KL 在当前 student 权重下更容易受缓存 support 限制。第二，在 reverse-KL OPD 上，PPO clipping、decoupled PPO、M2PO 等从异步 RL 借来的方法没有带来稳定收益；learner time 重新计算 advantage 且不 clipping 的 surrogate 更合适。第三，stale top-k support 存在确定性覆盖但无法修正漏掉的动作；one-sample MC 方差较高；multi-sample MC 在质量和方差之间更稳。第四，在 Qwen3-Base 模型上，AsyncOPD 相比严格同步训练获得 1.6× 到 3.8× 的训练吞吐提升，同时保持相近 accuracy。这个结果说明异步化的收益主要来自减少 learner 等待 rollout 和 teacher scoring 的时间，而质量损失可以通过合适的 OPD estimator 控制。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟。重点看 Section 4 的 KL direction 分析，它解释了为什么 forward KL 和 reverse KL 的 stale-data 行为不同；Section 5 看 reverse-KL surrogate 对比，尤其是为什么 PPO 系列方法没有直接迁移成功；Section 6 看 teacher-cache 约束下 top-k、one-sample MC、multi-sample MC 的偏差方差分析；Section 7 看系统 pipeline 和吞吐数字。若关心大规模 post-train 系统，Fig. 1 和异步 pipeline 图值得细看，因为它们把目标函数限制和系统约束连在了一起。
