summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies policy staleness in asynchronous on-policy distillation. In OPD, the student generates rollouts and learns from dense teacher feedback. A synchronous pipeline wastes learner time on long reasoning rollouts, while an asynchronous pipeline improves utilization but trains on data produced by older student policies. The key complication is practical: full-vocabulary teacher logits are too expensive to cache, so the learner only receives teacher scores on a finite action set.
summary_en.importance: The work is useful for LLM post-training systems where OPD, self-distillation, and multi-teacher distillation are used to improve reasoning models. It shows that OPD staleness is not the same problem as asynchronous RL staleness. The teacher-score cache changes which objectives are safe and which estimators are biased. This matters for any large-scale pipeline that tries to overlap generation, teacher scoring, and optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis first separates forward-KL and reverse-KL OPD. Forward KL is teacher-weighted and is less sensitive to stale student rollouts under a finite teacher cache. Reverse KL is student-weighted and becomes fragile when the current student assigns probability to actions that were not scored by the teacher in the stale cache. The paper then treats reverse-KL OPD through a policy-gradient-style surrogate, where the teacher-student log-ratio acts as a token-level advantage. It evaluates PPO-style clipping, decoupled PPO, and M2PO, but finds that a simpler OPD-specific surrogate works better: recompute the reverse-KL token advantage at learner time under the current student, without clipping. Finally, it studies cache-induced estimator choices. Stale top-k supports are deterministic but suffer support mismatch. One-sample Monte Carlo remains importance-correctable but has high variance. Multi-sample Monte Carlo caches multiple stale-policy samples per step, reducing variance while preserving correctability.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments support the main design choices. Forward KL is empirically more robust to stale rollouts, while reverse KL is more exposed to missing teacher scores under finite caches. For reverse-KL OPD, asynchronous RL stabilizers such as PPO clipping, decoupled PPO, and M2PO do not improve over learner-time advantage recomputation without clipping. The estimator study shows the limitation of stale top-k supports, the high variance of one-sample MC, and the more favorable tradeoff of multi-sample MC. In the full AsyncOPD system, student rollout, teacher scoring, and learner updates are overlapped. On Qwen3-Base models, the system reports a 1.6× to 3.8× throughput improvement over strictly synchronous training while maintaining comparable accuracy.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 30–45 minutes. Read the KL-direction analysis first, because it explains why forward and reverse KL behave differently under stale caches. Then read the reverse-KL surrogate comparison, especially the negative result on PPO-family methods. The estimator section is the most practically useful part for implementation: it clarifies when top-k caches are biased and why multi-sample MC is preferable. The system section is worth reading for the pipeline design and the 1.6×–3.8× throughput result.

recommendation.zh: 只看 stale rollout 与 KL 方向的 ablation；若结论稳，异步 OPD 的 learner/rollout 比例需要重调。
recommendation.en: Read the staleness-by-KL-direction ablations; if stable, this changes how to set learner/rollout ratios for async OPD.

paper.title: Blockwise Policy-Drift Gating for On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student policy using teacher signals computed on trajectories sampled by the student itself. Recent work shows that sampled-token OPD can be fragile on long-horizon reasoning tasks and that local teacher-support matching is a simple and effective repair. This paper introduces blockwise policy-drift gating, a lightweight student-only old-current drift controller for OPD under rollout reuse. The method computes log-probability shifts between the behavior stude

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是 on-policy distillation 在长链推理训练中的一个稳定性问题：当 student rollout 被重复用于多个优化 epoch 时，当前 student 与生成这些 rollout 的旧 student 之间会发生 policy drift，导致同一条 sampled path 对当前更新来说“新鲜度”不同。已有工作更多关注 teacher 监督是否足够可靠，比如 sampled-token OPD 的脆弱性以及 Teacher-TopK/LSM 对局部 teacher support 的修复；这篇文章补的是另一块：即使 teacher target 不变，reused rollout 本身也会因为 old-current mismatch 变得不均匀可信，尤其在长响应里这种失配会沿序列累积。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 pretrain 到 post-train 的接口有现实意义。原因在于，很多后训练配方已经越来越像“继续训练一个会推理的语言模型”，而不是简单 SFT。OPD、RL、蒸馏这类方法的稳定性，会反过来影响大家如何理解 teacher-student compatibility、rollout reuse、以及长链 reasoning 数据的有效训练信号密度。论文的价值不在提出一个新目标，而在给出一个很轻量的 loss reweighting 规则：不改 teacher、不改 rollout policy、不改 support matching，只根据 student 自身 old/current log-prob shift 来调节哪些位置更该被当前更新重视。这个思路比较务实，也容易嵌入现有 PPO-style 训练框架。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 blockwise policy-drift gating。作者先定义 sampled token 路径上的 old-current log-probability shift，也就是当前 student 对某个已采样 token 的对数概率，与生成该 token 的 behavior student 的对数概率之差。这个量不是完整 KL，只是沿 sampled path 的局部漂移信号。直接用 token-level importance ratio exp(d_t) 做权重会很噪，因此作者选择中间粒度聚合：一类是固定 64 token 的 Block64-Gate，另一类是按换行切分并做长度修正的 NewlineSpan-Gate。对每个 block/span，把 shift 求平均，经过 detached soft gate 和 mean normalization 后，广播回该区域内所有 token，作为已有 OPD position loss 的乘子。关键点有三个。第一，gate 是 detached 的，不让模型为了操纵 gate 而学习；它只改变损失权重，不引入额外优化目标。第二，teacher target 完全不变，因此该方法既可加在 sampled-token OPD 上，也可叠加到 Teacher-TopK/LSM 上。第三，分块而不是逐 token，是为了在长 reasoning trace 中平衡方差和局部性：sequence-level 太粗，token-level 太抖，block-level 是折中。
summary.experiments: 实验设置比较克制。student 是 Qwen3-1.7B-Base，teacher 是 Qwen3-4B-Base-GRPO；训练数据来自 DAPO-Math-17k 处理后的 1,791,700 行数学样本；统一采用 200 step 训练预算、最大 response 长度 16384、rollout group size 8、两轮 PPO epoch。评测用外部 vLLM，主指标是四个数学 benchmark 上的 pass@8。论文主结论是：固定 64-token block 的 drift gate 能稳定提升 sampled-token OPD 的 solve rate；而在 Teacher-TopK/LSM 上继续叠加该 gate，也能得到最强的 aggregate pass@8。摘要没有给出完整数字表，但从全文描述看，作者更强调趋势一致性而不是单点大幅跃升：token-level importance weighting 噪声较大，sequence-level weighting 过于粗糙，blockwise aggregation 在六个方法变体里表现最稳。这个结果与方法设计是对齐的，因为它本来就是为 rollout reuse 下的 stale-data 问题服务，而不是试图替代 teacher support matching。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时建议先看引言里对 OPD 两类失配的区分：一类是 teacher support 不足，另一类是 old-current student drift。把这两件事分开理解，后面的方法就很清楚。然后看 policy-drift gating 章节，重点抓住 gate 的定义、detached 设计、mean normalization，以及为什么选 block64 和 newline span 这两种粒度。最后看主实验矩阵，关注六个变体在四个数学 benchmark 上的相对排序，而不是只盯单个分数。若只想判断是否值得跟进，读方法部分加主结果表大约 20 到 30 分钟即可。更值得深挖的问题是：这种 drift-aware weighting 是否能推广到更长训练预算、更强 teacher、以及 RL-only setting；另外，它和 PPO 里的 importance sampling / clipping 之间是否存在更系统的统一视角。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a stability issue in on-policy distillation for long-horizon reasoning. When student rollouts are reused across multiple optimization epochs, the current student can drift away from the behavior student that generated those trajectories. This creates a mismatch even if teacher supervision is unchanged: some sampled positions become stale for the current update. Prior work has mostly focused on teacher-side reliability, such as the fragility of sampled-token OPD and the repair provided by Teacher-TopK or local support matching. This paper targets a different failure mode: old-current student drift under rollout reuse.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is not directly about pretraining, but it matters for the pretrain-to-post-train interface. Modern post-training increasingly resembles continued language-model training with stronger reasoning behavior, so the stability of OPD, RL, and distillation affects how researchers think about teacher-student compatibility, rollout reuse, and the density of useful training signal in long reasoning traces. The paper’s value is its restraint: it does not introduce a new teacher objective or a new rollout policy. Instead, it adds a lightweight loss reweighting rule based only on the student’s own old-versus-current log-probability shift. That makes it easy to plug into existing PPO-style pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is called blockwise policy-drift gating. For each sampled response token, the paper computes the old-current log-probability shift: the difference between the current student’s log-probability and the behavior student’s log-probability on the same sampled token. This is not a full KL estimate; it is a sampled-path drift signal. Using token-level importance ratios such as exp(d_t) is a natural baseline, but the paper argues that it is too noisy. Instead, it aggregates drift at an intermediate granularity. Two variants are used: Block64-Gate, which averages shifts over fixed 64-token blocks, and NewlineSpan-Gate, which aggregates over newline-delimited spans with heuristics for merging or splitting spans by length. The aggregated score is passed through a detached soft gate and mean-normalized over valid response tokens, then broadcast back to all positions in the region as a multiplicative weight on the existing OPD position loss. Three design choices matter. First, the gate is detached, so the model cannot optimize the gate itself; it only changes how much each position contributes to the base loss. Second, teacher targets are unchanged, so the same gating family can be applied both to sampled-token OPD and to Teacher-TopK/LSM. Third, blockwise aggregation is a variance-locality trade-off: sequence-level weighting is too coarse for long traces, while token-level weighting is too unstable.
summary_en.experiments: The setup is controlled rather than large-scale. The student is Qwen3-1.7B-Base and the teacher is Qwen3-4B-Base-GRPO. Training uses 1,791,700 processed math rows from DAPO-Math-17k, with a fixed 200-step budget, maximum response length 16384, rollout group size 8, and two PPO epochs. Evaluation is done externally with vLLM, and pass@8 on four math benchmarks is the main metric. The main finding is that fixed 64-token drift gating consistently improves sampled-token OPD solve rate, and that adding the same gate on top of Teacher-TopK/LSM yields the strongest aggregate pass@8 among the tested variants. The abstract does not expose the full numeric table, and the paper’s emphasis is more on consistent ranking than on a single dramatic gain. That is aligned with the method’s role: it is meant to mitigate stale-data effects under rollout reuse, not to replace teacher-support matching.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction and pay attention to the distinction between two kinds of mismatch: insufficient teacher support versus old-current student drift. Once that separation is clear, the method section becomes straightforward. In the policy-drift gating section, focus on the gate definition, the detached design, the mean normalization, and why the paper chooses Block64 and newline spans as the two aggregation granularities. Then look at the main experiment matrix and compare the relative ordering of the six variants across the four math benchmarks rather than over-reading any single score. If the goal is just to judge whether the idea is worth following up, the method section plus the main result table should take about 20 to 30 minutes. The more interesting follow-up questions are whether this drift-aware weighting scales to longer training budgets, stronger teachers, or RL-only settings, and how it relates more systematically to importance sampling and clipping in PPO.

recommendation.zh: OPD是推理能力轻量化落地的核心路径，重点看§3的块级漂移聚合方式，可作为内部推理蒸馏ablation的 baseline 参考。
recommendation.en: On-policy distillation is a core path for lightweight reasoning deployment; focus on §3's block-wise drift aggregation as a baseline for internal reasoning distillation ablations.

paper.title: ReNIO: Reweighting Negative Trajectory Importance for LLM On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves LLM reasoning by training a student model on its own generated outputs, but standard OPD treats all student-generated outputs (SGOs) equally regardless of their informativeness. We observe a consistent asymmetry in controlled filtering experiments: in both OPD and on-policy self distillation (OPSD), training only on incorrect SGOs outperforms training only on correct ones. Our further analysis suggests that models trained on correct-only SGOs tend to generat

summary.core_problem: On-policy distillation（OPD）及其自蒸馏变体 OPSD 在推理后训练中默认对学生自己生成的轨迹等权训练，但不同轨迹的信息量不对称：错误轨迹比正确轨迹更能提供靠近模型能力边界的纠错信号，而现有方法缺乏一种不依赖完整 rollout 到最终答案、可在 prefix 上计算的重加权方案。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对后训练（尤其是低成本 reasoning post-training）有直接价值，对预训练研究的启发在于两点：第一，它再次说明“正样本/高回报样本不一定是最有信息量的训练样本”，这和 pretrain 中 hard negative、near-miss、capability boundary 附近样本的数据选择问题相通；第二，它展示了用 student-teacher 概率比在局部 token 上定位错误分支的方法，这种 prefix-computable 信号有潜力迁移到 on-policy pretrain / continual pretrain 的样本筛选或课程设计。
summary.technical_approach: ReNIO 的核心发现来自控制实验：在 OPD 和 OPSD 下，只用错误 SGO（student-generated outputs）训练，一致好于只用正确 SGO 训练。行为分析显示，仅用正确样本训练会导致推理链更短、反思标记更少，而错误样本保留了更多探索和自我修正痕迹。为了在不等到最终答案的前提下强调这类负样本，ReNIO 利用 prefix 上的 student/teacher 概率比定位关键 token：学生给高概率但教师给低概率的 token，视为学生偏好但教师拒绝的分支决策。方法对这类 token 的 log ratio 做截断，按几何平均聚合到样本级别，并在 batch 内归一化作为样本权重，从而把训练重心重新分配到包含强纠错信号的轨迹，同时保留 OPD 使用短 prefix 训练的效率优势。
summary.experiments: 控制实验在 Qwen3-1.7B 上进行：OPD 下 incorrect-only 相比 correct-only 在 AIME24、AIME25、平均 benchmark 上分别高 3.60、3.89、2.59 个 Avg@12 点；OPSD 下对应增益为 1.94、3.34、2.50 点。完整 ReNIO 在数学推理和代码生成任务上同时提升 OPD 和 OPSD，代表性结果为 Qwen3-1.7B 数学推理相对提升最高 8.90%，R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 最高 10.00%。论文还记录了推理长度和反思类标记（如 wait/actually/however/check 等）的变化，说明负样本加权有助于维持探索性推理行为，而非简单压缩到短而“看起来正确”的答案。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点看前期控制实验和行为分析部分（figure 1 及相关文字），这是全文最有价值的观察；方法部分看清楚关键 token 判定、log ratio 截断和几何平均聚合即可。需要带着怀疑看的点是：这种信号是否真的足够接近“错误轨迹”，还是在强 teacher/弱 student 设定下更有效；以及这种重加权在长推理、长上下文和自蒸馏 teacher 不够强时是否稳定。预计阅读时间 15–25 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard on-policy distillation (OPD) and on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) weight all student-generated trajectories equally, ignoring substantial variation in informativeness. The paper identifies a clear asymmetry: incorrect student-generated outputs often provide stronger learning signal than correct ones, yet there was no efficient way to upweight them without rolling out trajectories to the final answer.
summary_en.importance: The paper is mainly a post-training method, but it carries two lessons relevant to pretrain research. First, it reinforces that high-reward or already-correct samples are not necessarily the most useful training data; samples near the model’s capability boundary, including failures, can drive more robust improvement. Second, its prefix-computable teacher-student disagreement signal offers a practical way to locate informative mistakes locally, which is conceptually close to hard-negative mining and adaptive data weighting in pretraining and continual pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReNIO starts from controlled filtering experiments showing that training only on incorrect student-generated outputs consistently outperforms training only on correct ones in both OPD and OPSD. Behavioral analysis suggests that correct-only training produces shorter traces with fewer reflection markers, while incorrect trajectories preserve exploratory and self-corrective reasoning near the model’s frontier. To exploit this without waiting for final-answer labels, ReNIO identifies pivotal tokens using the student-to-teacher probability ratio: tokens with high student probability but low teacher probability indicate student-preferred, teacher-rejected branch decisions. These clipped log ratios are aggregated by geometric mean to the sample level and normalized within each batch, producing a prefix-computable sample weight that emphasizes likely negative and highly informative trajectories while preserving the short-prefix efficiency advantage of OPD.
summary_en.experiments: Controlled studies on Qwen3-1.7B show that incorrect-only training beats correct-only training by 3.60, 3.89, and 2.59 Avg@12 points on AIME24, AIME25, and benchmark average under OPD, and by 1.94, 3.34, and 2.50 points under OPSD. Full ReNIO improves both OPD and OPSD on mathematical reasoning and code generation, with reported relative gains up to 8.90% for Qwen3-1.7B and 10.00% for R1-Distill-Qwen-7B on math reasoning. The paper also reports response-length and reflection-marker statistics, showing that emphasizing negative trajectories helps preserve exploratory reasoning rather than collapsing into short, overconfident answers.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the controlled filtering experiments and behavioral analysis in Figure 1, which contain the most transferable insight. Then read the ReNIO weighting formula to understand how pivotal tokens are detected from prefixes only. A useful point to scrutinize is whether the method mainly works when the teacher is already strong enough, and whether the same disagreement signal remains reliable in self-distillation or weaker-teacher regimes. Estimated reading time: 15–25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 负轨迹优于正轨迹这个结果值得复现实验；先看 filtering ablation，方法本身可作为 RL 数据加权弱基线。
recommendation.en: The negative-trajectory result is worth reproducing; read the filtering ablation first, and treat ReNIO as a weak baseline for RL data weighting.

paper.title: Prefix-Guided On-Policy Distillation: Mining Golden Trajectories from Rollouts
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves reasoning models by applying dense teacher supervision on student-sampled trajectories. However, scaling OPD to long-horizon mathematical reasoning exposes a reliability and efficiency problem: standard OPD assigns every sampled candidate the same long rollout budget, even though some trajectories may quickly become weakly aligned with the teacher and provide less useful supervision. Prior analyses suggest that successful OPD depends on local teacher-student

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决长链数学推理中 on-policy distillation 的 rollout 分配问题。标准 OPD 会让学生模型采样多个完整长答案，并在这些学生访问过的状态上用教师模型做密集监督。问题是所有候选轨迹都拿到同样的长生成预算，即使其中一些轨迹在早期 prefix 上已经和教师分布明显偏离，继续生成和训练的收益也可能很低。
summary.importance: 这是一篇 post-training 方法论文，但对预训练研究有两个具体启发。第一，训练信号质量不只取决于教师强度，也取决于学生当前策略访问到的局部状态是否适合被教师监督。第二，长程推理训练的数据生成成本可以按 prefix 级别的可学习性动态分配，而不是按 prompt 或 sample 均匀分配。这个思想可迁移到 reasoning mid-training、RL 数据采样、合成轨迹筛选和 dense supervision 的预算控制中。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Prefix-Guided On-Policy Distillation。流程是先让学生模型为每个 prompt 生成短 prefix，而不是直接生成完整长答案；随后在这些学生生成的 prefix 上同时评估学生和教师的 token 分布，计算 teacher–student top-k overlap。这个指标衡量两者高概率 token 集合的重合程度，作为局部兼容性的代理信号。高 overlap 表示教师的监督更可能落在学生可利用的动作空间附近，继续生成长 suffix 更有训练价值；低 overlap 则说明轨迹可能已经偏离教师的推理路径，继续 rollout 会消耗算力并引入弱监督。PG-OPD 据此只给高兼容轨迹分配长 continuation，同时保持原有 OPD 损失不变。方法的重点不是改变蒸馏目标，而是改变 rollout budget 的分配策略。论文还讨论了 prefix length、随机剪枝、每个 prompt 至少保留若干轨迹等设计，避免只按全局排序导致 prompt 覆盖不足。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖多个 teacher–student 组合，并在 AMC、AIME、HMMT 等数学推理 benchmark 上评估。主要结果是 PG-OPD 在减少 wall-clock 训练时间的同时，能保持或提升平均准确率。消融实验包括 prefix 长度、随机 pruning、prompt-minimum allocation、prefix-based ranking 等。关键结论是，基于 top-k overlap 的筛选优于随机丢弃，说明早期 prefix 的教师–学生兼容性确实能预测后续轨迹的蒸馏价值。可见正文没有给出完整数值表，因此具体加速比例、平均准确率提升和各 benchmark 分项结果需要看实验表格。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看 Method 中 top-k overlap 的定义、prefix 生成和长 continuation 分配算法；再看主结果表，确认不同 teacher–student 组合下的准确率和训练时间变化。消融部分值得看 prefix length 和 random pruning 对照，因为它们决定这个方法是来自兼容性信号，而不是简单减少 rollout 数量。如果要复现，需重点核对 overlap 计算频率、k 的选择、prefix token 数、每个 prompt 的最小保留轨迹数，以及教师前向带来的额外开销。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses rollout allocation in long-horizon on-policy distillation for mathematical reasoning. Standard OPD samples full student trajectories and applies dense teacher supervision on the states visited by the student. This treats all sampled candidates as equally worth continuing, even when some prefixes have already drifted far from the teacher distribution.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training paper, but it has useful implications for the pretraining-to-post-training interface. It argues that the value of dense supervision depends not only on teacher quality, but also on local teacher–student compatibility at the states produced by the current student policy. The same idea can inform reasoning mid-training, synthetic trajectory filtering, RL rollout allocation, and compute-aware supervision design: generation budget should follow learnability signals rather than be distributed uniformly.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, Prefix-Guided On-Policy Distillation, first asks the student to generate a short prefix for each candidate trajectory. The teacher and student are then evaluated on these student-visited prefixes, and a teacher–student top-k overlap score is computed. This score measures how much their high-probability token sets agree. High overlap suggests that the teacher’s dense signal lies near the student’s current action space and is therefore easier to exploit. Low overlap suggests that the trajectory has moved into a region where further rollout may add cost and noisy supervision. PG-OPD allocates long continuations only to high-compatibility prefixes while leaving the standard OPD objective unchanged. The novelty is in rollout budget allocation, not in a new distillation loss. The paper also studies practical variants such as prefix length, random pruning baselines, prefix-based ranking, and minimum allocation per prompt to preserve prompt coverage.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans several teacher–student combinations on math reasoning benchmarks including AMC, AIME, and HMMT. The reported pattern is that PG-OPD reduces wall-clock training time while preserving or improving average accuracy. The ablations compare prefix-guided selection against random pruning, vary prefix length, and test prompt-minimum allocation. The key empirical message is that top-k overlap on early prefixes is a better allocation signal than uniform or random continuation. The visible text does not include the full numerical result tables, so exact speedups, accuracy gains, and per-benchmark scores should be checked in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the algorithmic section defining top-k overlap, prefix sampling, and continuation allocation. Then read the main result tables for the accuracy-versus-time tradeoff across teacher–student pairs. The ablations on prefix length and random pruning are the most important sanity checks. For implementation, inspect the chosen k, prefix length, allocation ratio, minimum trajectories per prompt, and the additional teacher forward cost introduced by prefix scoring.

recommendation.zh: 推理后训练中蒸馏算力分配的务实优化，核心逻辑清晰，建议只看§3的前缀价值估计与rollout分配规则即可
recommendation.en: A practical optimization of distillation compute allocation in reasoning post-training with clear core logic; focus only on §3 for prefix value estimation and rollout allocation rules.

paper.title: PowerOPD: Stabilizing On-Policy Distillation with Bounded Power Transformation
paper.abstract: Standard on-policy distillation (OPD) for large language models estimates the reverse-KL objective using student-sampled tokens, yielding an unbiased single-sample Monte Carlo estimator that avoids vocabulary-wide computation. However, we show that this estimator suffers from severe training pathologies in practice: sample inefficiency, unstable generation dynamics, and a substantial performance gap compared to exact full-vocabulary OPD. Reward-level diagnosis traces these pathologies to the log

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是 on-policy distillation 的训练不稳定问题。标准 OPD 用 student 自己采样出的 token 来估计 reverse-KL，避免全词表计算，但单样本 Monte Carlo 估计会把每个 token 的更新权重变成 teacher-student 的 log-prob ratio。这个 reward 没有上下界，低概率 token 上的偶发事件会产生极大梯度，导致训练早期性能下降、生成长度震荡，以及收敛后仍明显落后于 full-vocabulary OPD。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值在于训练信号诊断，而不只是一个 post-training trick。它指出了一个常被忽略的问题：当语言模型训练目标从全分布 loss 变成采样轨迹上的 policy-gradient 形式后，目标的无偏性并不保证优化条件良好。对 RL pretrain、在线蒸馏、self-improvement 和 annealing 阶段都有参考意义。贡献量级主要体现在两点：一是把 vanilla OPD 的失败归因到 reward-level 的无界 log-ratio，而不是简单归因到学习率或 batch size；二是给出一个 bounded、sign-consistent 的替代 reward，在保持 sampled-token 低成本的同时接近甚至超过 full-vocabulary OPD。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 PowerOPD。核心做法是保留 OPD 中“teacher 分数减 student 分数”的结构，但把原来的 log p 换成 Box-Cox power transform。形式上使用 h(π_T) - h(π_θ)，其中 h 是严格单调函数，因此只要 teacher 对某个 token 的概率高于 student，reward 符号就仍然为正；反之为负。这保证了训练方向不反。标准 OPD 的 log-ratio 可以看作 α → 0 的极限；当 α > 0 时，reward 被限制在有限范围内，从源头上削掉低概率 token 造成的极端权重。这个设计和 reward clipping、tanh、z-score normalization 的区别在于：后处理方法是在 log-ratio 已经把信号扭曲之后再压缩，而 PowerOPD 直接改变 probability-to-reward mapping。代价是它不再是原始 reverse-KL 的简单单样本估计，而是一个更适合在线优化的有界 surrogate objective。论文也观察到 α 越大，越会压制 teacher 和 student 都认为低概率的 token，把学习信号集中到至少一方认为可能的 token 上。
summary.experiments: 实验集中在数学推理蒸馏。模型来自 Qwen3 family，包括 0.6B 和 1.7B student，以及 4B 和 8B teacher，共四组 teacher-student 配置，评测覆盖六个数学 benchmark。在 Qwen3-1.7B-Base student、Qwen3-4B teacher、MATH-500 的代表性设置中，vanilla OPD 收敛后只有 54.93% accuracy，比 full-vocabulary OPD 低 8.19 points；PowerOPD 相比 vanilla OPD 提升 9.6 points，并且用约 1/10 的训练步数达到相同 accuracy。完整评测中，PowerOPD 的 benchmark-averaged Avg@8 / Pass@8 相比 vanilla OPD 最高提升 +6.37 / +5.71；相比 clipping、tanh、z-score 等后处理稳定化方法最高提升 +3.01 / +3.54；相比 full-vocabulary OPD 最高提升 +2.59 / +8.90。单项 benchmark 的提升最高分别达到 +16.75 / +15.00、+8.43 / +7.50、+11.60 / +25.00。效率上，相比 full-vocabulary OPD，PowerOPD 每步 wall-clock time 降低 59.2%，peak GPU memory 降低 23.1%。训练动态分析显示，PowerOPD 的 gradient norm 比 vanilla OPD 初始 spike 低 3000 倍以上，response length 震荡也更小。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 30 到 45 分钟。重点看 reward-level diagnosis、Power transformation 的定义、α 的消融，以及 gradient/length dynamics 图。最值得注意的是它如何区分“无偏估计”和“可优化训练信号”：vanilla OPD 的 Monte Carlo 估计在目标上干净，但在 token-level reward 上病态。对做 RL pretrain 或在线蒸馏的人，α scaling 的实验比最终 accuracy 更有信息量，因为它说明低概率 token 的处理方式会直接改变生成分布的稳定性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why sampled-token on-policy distillation becomes unstable in LLM post-training. Vanilla OPD estimates a reverse-KL objective from student-sampled tokens, avoiding a full-vocabulary computation. The resulting policy-gradient weight is the teacher-student log-probability ratio. This reward is unbounded, so rare low-probability events can dominate the update, especially at early sequence positions. The observed symptoms are degraded validation accuracy at the beginning of training, large response-length oscillations, and a sizable gap to exact full-vocabulary OPD after convergence.
summary_en.importance: The useful part for pretraining and large-scale optimization is the training-signal diagnosis. The paper makes a concrete point: an unbiased sampled estimator of a distribution-level objective can still be a poor optimization signal once it is used on model-generated trajectories. This matters for online distillation, RL-style pretraining, self-improvement loops, and cooldown or annealing stages where the model trains on its own generations. The contribution is not just a stabilization heuristic. It identifies the unbounded log-ratio reward as the failure mode and replaces it with a bounded, direction-preserving reward that keeps the computational profile of sampled OPD.
summary_en.technical_approach: PowerOPD keeps the transform-then-subtract structure of OPD: h(π_T) - h(π_θ). If h is strictly increasing, the sign of the reward still matches the teacher-student probability gap. A token receives positive reward when the teacher assigns higher probability than the student, and negative reward in the opposite case. The paper instantiates h with a Box-Cox power transform. The usual log-ratio reward appears as the α → 0 limit; for any α > 0, the reward becomes bounded. This differs from clipping, tanh compression, or z-score normalization, which operate after the log-ratio has already produced extreme values. PowerOPD changes the probability-to-reward map itself. The tradeoff is that the method is better viewed as a bounded surrogate objective rather than a plain single-sample estimator of the original reverse-KL. Larger α suppresses tokens that both models assign low probability and concentrates learning on tokens considered plausible by either the teacher or the student.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use math-reasoning distillation with Qwen3-family teacher-student pairs: 0.6B and 1.7B students, and 4B and 8B teachers, evaluated on six math benchmarks. In the representative Qwen3-1.7B-Base student and Qwen3-4B teacher setting on MATH-500, vanilla OPD converges to 54.93% accuracy, 8.19 points below full-vocabulary OPD. PowerOPD improves over vanilla OPD by 9.6 points and reaches the same accuracy level with about 10× fewer training steps. Across the benchmark suite, the best averaged Avg@8 / Pass@8 gains are +6.37 / +5.71 over vanilla OPD, +3.01 / +3.54 over post-hoc reward stabilization, and +2.59 / +8.90 over full-vocabulary OPD. The largest single-benchmark gains reach +16.75 / +15.00, +8.43 / +7.50, and +11.60 / +25.00 under the corresponding comparisons. Compared with full-vocabulary OPD, PowerOPD reduces wall-clock time per step by 59.2% and peak GPU memory by 23.1%. Gradient tracking shows that its norms stay more than 3000× below the initial spike of vanilla OPD.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 30 to 45 minutes. Read the reward diagnosis first, then the Box-Cox transformation, the α ablations, and the gradient and response-length dynamics. The most transferable lesson is the separation between estimator correctness and optimization quality. For readers working on RL pretraining or online distillation, the α-scaling results are more informative than the headline benchmark numbers, because they show how probability-to-reward shaping changes the stability of generated trajectories.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看的是“失稳根因在 reward 形状，不在采样器细节”；先读 reward 分析和 ablation，若 setup 干净，内部 RL/蒸馏都该试有界目标。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the claim that OPD instability comes from reward geometry, not just sampling noise; read the reward analysis and ablations first, then test bounded objectives in your own RL/distillation stack.

paper.title: On-Policy Distillation with Curriculum Turn-level Guidance for Multi-turn Agents
paper.abstract: Multi-turn agents that plan, invoke tools, and interact with environments offer a promising paradigm for solving complex tasks, yet their capabilities typically rely on very large models whose inference cost is prohibitive in practice.On-Policy Distillation (OPD) is a natural recipe for transferring such capabilities to smaller students, but we find that it suffers a characteristic failure mode in this setting: small student errors compound across turns and push the trajectory out of the teacher

summary.core_problem: 在多轮 Agent 任务中，如何解决 On-Policy Distillation (OPD) 导致的小模型错误累积和偏离教师模型状态分布的问题？
summary.importance: 提出了一种针对多轮交互 Agent 的蒸馏方法，通过课程学习策略动态调整教师干预，有效缓解了长轨迹中的错误级联问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Guided-OPD 算法。在每次 rollout 中混合教师和学生生成的轮次，并设计一个干预概率逐渐衰减至零的课程（Curriculum）。早期强引导保持轨迹接近教师分布，后期逐渐撤回以恢复纯粹的 on-policy 探索。
summary.experiments: 在多轮 Agent 任务上验证，相比标准 OPD，Guided-OPD 能更有效地将大模型能力蒸馏到小模型，减少错误累积。

summary_en.core_problem: How to mitigate error compounding and deviation from the teacher's state distribution in On-Policy Distillation (OPD) for multi-turn agents?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a distillation method tailored for multi-turn interactive agents, effectively alleviating error cascading in long trajectories via a curriculum-based dynamic teacher intervention strategy.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces Guided-OPD. It mixes teacher- and student-generated turns within each rollout and schedules the teacher's intervention probability along a curriculum decaying to zero. Strong early guidance keeps trajectories near the teacher distribution, gradually withdrawn to recover pure on-policy exploration.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on multi-turn agent tasks, Guided-OPD transfers large model capabilities to smaller students more effectively than standard OPD, reducing error accumulation.

recommendation.zh: 多轮交互场景下的蒸馏策略，通过 curriculum 缓解 compounding errors，对合成数据和 RL 训练长序列任务有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Distillation strategy for multi-turn interactions using curriculum to mitigate compounding errors, relevant for synthetic data and RL on long-horizon tasks.

paper.title: Dense Supervision, Sparse Updates: On the Sparsity and Geometry of On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (\textsc{OPD}) has recently become a prominent post-training recipe as it combines two desirable ingredients: on-policy student trajectories and dense teacher supervision, yet how this hybrid changes a model's parameters remains unclear. Across several language and vision-language model pairs and use cases, our analysis yields two main findings. On sparsity, \textsc{OPD}-style updates are small and coordinate-sparse. They are distributed across layers and are usually FFN-h

summary.core_problem: 分析 on-policy distillation 在后训练中到底如何改变模型参数，尤其是更新的稀疏性、层分布、谱结构和优化器需求。
summary.importance: 贡献是后训练机制分析。它不提出新的预训练范式，但直接触及 LLM/VLM post-train 的参数更新结构，对理解 SFT、蒸馏、RL 前后的权重变化有参考价值，尤其是“dense supervision 但 sparse update”的现象。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在多个语言模型和视觉语言模型配对上研究 OPD-style training。方法上比较完整 OPD 更新与被发现的稀疏子网络更新，分析坐标稀疏性、层内分布、FFN/attention 占比、更新矩阵秩与谱集中性，并做 SGD 与 AdamW 的优化器消融。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模和数据量。报告的主要结果包括：OPD 更新幅度小且坐标稀疏，跨层分布但通常 FFN-heavy；只训练发现的子网络几乎恢复 full OPD 性能；更新数值上 full-rank 但谱集中；尽管更新稀疏，带稀疏诱导倾向的 SGD 低于 AdamW，作者将其归因于 dense teacher supervision 保留了异质的坐标级梯度尺度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how on-policy distillation changes model parameters, focusing on sparsity, layer distribution, spectral geometry, and optimizer behavior.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training analysis rather than a pretraining method. Its value for LLM researchers is that it characterizes the weight-update structure induced by dense teacher supervision on on-policy student trajectories, a setting close to modern distillation and RL-style post-training recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors analyze OPD-style training across several language and vision-language model pairs. They compare full OPD against training only a discovered sparse subnetwork, measure coordinate sparsity, layer and module allocation, FFN versus attention concentration, rank and spectrum of updates, and run optimizer ablations between SGD and AdamW.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes or dataset scale. The reported findings are that OPD updates are small and coordinate-sparse, distributed across layers and usually FFN-heavy; training only the discovered subnetwork nearly recovers full OPD performance; updates are numerically full-rank but spectrally concentrated; AdamW outperforms sparsity-inducing SGD because dense teacher supervision keeps heterogeneous coordinate-wise gradient scales.

recommendation.zh: 只看稀疏子网络实验和优化器消融；它给 post-train 更新结构一个可操作诊断。
recommendation.en: Skim the sparse-subnetwork and optimizer ablations; they give a practical diagnostic for post-training update structure.

paper.title: When Context Returns: Toward Robust Internalization in On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: Recent work has shown that on-policy distillation can internalize privileged context, such as system prompts or task hints, into a student model so that the context is no longer needed at inference time. Although this approach successfully improves the student's no-context performance, we identify an interesting and previously unstudied phenomenon: in many settings, reintroducing the original privileged context to the distilled student actually degrades its performance, even on instances it alre

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是 on-policy distillation 里一个很容易被忽略的问题：学生模型把特权上下文 internalize 之后，推理时去掉上下文确实能变强，但如果把原来的上下文重新加回来，性能反而常常下降。作者把这个现象叫 context-induced degradation。更准确地说，现有目标只优化“无上下文学生要模仿有上下文教师”，却没有约束学生在“有上下文视角”下的行为，因此 internalization 可能只是把一条路径训好了，而不是让上下文真正变成冗余信息。论文提出的核心要求是 context removability：如果知识真的被吸收到参数里，那么上下文重新出现时，模型行为不应被破坏。
summary.importance: 这项工作对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 pretrain 与 post-train 的接口很有启发，尤其是 context distillation、system prompt internalization、CoT 蒸馏和带 scaffold 的 on-policy 训练。它指出一个常见误区：把外部提示蒸馏进模型，不等于模型学会了“稳定地拥有这份能力”。如果训练目标只看 no-context 路径，模型可能学到一种脆弱的补偿机制，而不是形成真正可重入、可移除的内部表征。这个判断对后续做 reasoning distillation、tool-use scaffold distillation、甚至 RL 中的 privileged information training 都有参考价值。贡献量级属于训练目标层面的明确修正，方法很小，但问题定义很扎实。
summary.technical_approach:
作者先把问题形式化成两个 student view：q_x = gθ(y|x) 和 q_c = gθ(y|x,c)。标准 on-policy distillation with privileged context 只最小化无上下文学生 q_x 与有上下文教师 f(y|x,c) 之间的 KL，因此只保证 privileged fidelity，不保证 q_x 和 q_c 一致。

基于这个观察，论文提出 No-Context Anchoring, NCA。做法很简单：把学生在无上下文下的输出分布当作 stop-gradient anchor，再对学生有上下文视角的输出加一个 consistency KL，惩罚 q_c 偏离 q_x。直观上，这是在告诉模型：上下文可以帮助你学，但一旦你已经学会了，它重新出现时不该把你推到另一个行为模式里。

这个设计有几个值得注意的点。第一，anchor 选 no-context 而不是 context-conditioned teacher。原因是部署目标本来就是无上下文推理，作者希望把已经 internalized 的路径当成主路径，再把有上下文视角拉回这条路径，而不是反过来。第二，使用 stop-gradient 很关键，否则两个视角可能互相拖拽，削弱主目标。第三，它只增加一次额外 forward pass，训练代价相对温和。

论文还提出了一个概念区分：privileged fidelity 解决的是“学生无上下文时能否达到教师有上下文时的能力”，而 context removability 解决的是“上下文是否已经变成真正冗余的信息”。这两个目标并不等价。作者进一步用表示分析说明，NCA 不只是让输出更像，而是让有无上下文时的 hidden states 也更接近，说明它在一定程度上改变了内部表征，而不是只做表层校正。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 12 个配置，跨不同领域和模型家族。核心结果有三条。第一，context-induced degradation 很常见，多数设置里重新加入上下文会让准确率下降，并且生成长度膨胀。作者把设置分成三类，其中 Regime A 占 7/12：学生无上下文已经做得不错，但一加上下文就被扰动，出现明显 accuracy drop 和 harm rate。第二，NCA 在 11/12 个设置里降低了这种 harm，并在多数设置里提升了 context-conditioned accuracy。第三，它基本消除了 response-length inflation，而且在不少设置里连 no-context performance 也一起改善，这一点很关键，因为 no-context 才是原始训练目标。

论文还定义了 Harm = P(q_c wrong | q_x correct)，这个指标比单纯 accuracy drop 更有信息量，因为它直接衡量“原本答对的样本被上下文重新弄错”的概率。机制分析部分显示，加入 NCA 后，有无上下文两条路径的表示更接近，支持作者关于 context removability 的论点。

从可读到的内容看，这篇论文的亮点不在大规模数字，而在问题诊断和指标设计。它把“蒸馏成功”拆成了两个不同维度，并证明只优化其中一个会留下明显缺口。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Problem Formulation，把 privileged fidelity、context removability、harm 这几个概念吃透。然后直接看 Figure 1 和 Figure 2，理解 12 个设置里三种 regime 的分布，这会决定你是否认同作者的问题定义。方法部分重点看 NCA 的目标式，尤其是为什么用 no-context output 做 stop-gradient anchor。实验部分建议优先看 harm、accuracy、response length 三类结果，再看 mechanistic analysis，确认它不是单纯把输出校平。预计 30 分钟左右能抓住主线；如果你做 CoT distillation、system prompt internalization 或 privileged RL，值得再细看附录里的不同任务设置和失败案例。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a failure mode in on-policy distillation with privileged context. A student can learn to perform well without the context at inference time, yet when the original context is reintroduced, performance often gets worse rather than staying unchanged. The authors call this context-induced degradation. Their claim is that standard objectives only optimize one side of the problem: the no-context student should match the context-conditioned teacher. That does not guarantee that the student has truly internalized the privileged information in a stable way. For robust internalization, the context should become removable: adding it back should be behaviorally harmless.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is highly relevant to the pretrain-posttrain interface. The result matters for context distillation, system-prompt internalization, chain-of-thought distillation, and any training setup where privileged information is available during learning but absent at deployment. The main lesson is subtle and important: good no-context performance does not imply that the model has formed a stable internal representation of the privileged signal. It may instead have learned a brittle compensation path. The contribution is a clean correction to the training objective, with a small method and a well-motivated problem definition.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper formalizes two student views: q_x = g_theta(y|x) and q_c = g_theta(y|x,c). Standard on-policy distillation with privileged context minimizes a KL from the teacher f(y|x,c) to the no-context student q_x. This enforces what the paper calls privileged fidelity, but it leaves q_c unconstrained.

To address this, the authors propose No-Context Anchoring (NCA). The no-context student output is treated as a stop-gradient anchor, and an additional consistency KL penalizes deviation of the context-conditioned student view q_c from q_x. The intuition is simple: if the privileged information has already been absorbed into the parameters, then reintroducing the context should not push the model into a different behavioral mode.

A few design choices matter. The anchor is the no-context student, not the teacher, because the deployment target is the no-context pathway. Stop-gradient is also important; otherwise the two views could co-adapt and weaken the primary objective. The method only requires one extra forward pass per step, so the overhead is modest.

Conceptually, the paper separates two goals that are often conflated. Privileged fidelity asks whether the no-context student can match the teacher with context. Context removability asks whether the context has become genuinely redundant. The paper argues, and empirically shows, that the first does not imply the second. Representation-level analysis further suggests that NCA changes internal states, not just final-token behavior.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments span 12 configurations across different domains and model families. Three findings stand out. First, context-induced degradation is common. In most settings, adding the original context back hurts accuracy and inflates response length. The authors identify three regimes, with Regime A covering 7 of 12 settings: the no-context student already performs well, but the context acts as a perturbation and causes both accuracy loss and high harm.

Second, NCA reduces this harm in 11 of 12 settings and improves context-conditioned accuracy in the majority of cases. Third, it largely removes response-length inflation and, in many settings, even improves no-context performance, which is the main training objective.

The paper also introduces a useful metric, Harm = P(q_c wrong | q_x correct), which is more diagnostic than raw accuracy drop because it directly measures how often context flips a previously correct prediction into an incorrect one. The mechanistic analysis shows that NCA makes hidden representations more similar between the context and no-context views, supporting the claim that it improves removability at the representation level as well.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and problem formulation. The key concepts are privileged fidelity, context removability, and harm. Then look at Figure 1 and Figure 2 to understand how widespread the failure mode is and how the 12 settings fall into different regimes. In the method section, focus on the NCA objective and why the no-context output is used as a stop-gradient anchor. In the experiments, prioritize the tables or plots on harm, accuracy, and response length, then read the mechanistic analysis to see whether the effect is only output-level or also representational. A 30-minute skim should be enough for the main story. If you work on CoT distillation, system-prompt internalization, or privileged-information training, the appendix is worth reading for task-specific setups and edge cases.

recommendation.zh: 指出了蒸馏模型对 context 敏感的退化现象，提出的正则化 loss 对做 SFT/RL 蒸馏的同学有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Highlights context-induced degradation in distilled models; the proposed regularization loss is a useful reference for those working on SFT/RL distillation.

paper.title: Beyond Absolute Imitation: Anchored Residual Guidance for Privileged On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has demonstrated strong empirical gains in enhancing complex reasoning in LLMs by aligning a student model with a teacher's predictive distribution over the student's own trajectories. An emerging variant, Privileged OPD, further strengthens this paradigm by employing a self-teacher model augmented with privileged information, such as oracle traces, to mitigate teacher-student capacity gaps while providing dense, answer-directed supervision. However, current methods

summary.core_problem: Privileged On-Policy Distillation（特权 OPD，如 OPSD、SDFT）用带 oracle trace / 完整解答等特权信息的自教师模型，在学生自己采样的轨迹上做稠密蒸馏；但现有方法把全视角的特权教师分布当作绝对模仿目标，没有区分学生当前前缀下因果可达的推理步骤和依赖未来上下文的后见之明信号，导致学生被迫匹配超出其局部预测支撑集的分布，出现特权信息泄漏、推理走捷径、长程推理不稳定等问题。
summary.importance: 指出了当前工业界广泛采用的特权 OPD 范式中一个被忽视的优化病理——全视角模仿的后验偏差；提出的双视角拆解思路（可达锚点 + 可控残差）为特权蒸馏类后训练方法提供了更稳的目标构造方式，对数学/代码/长程推理的 SFT+RL 混合流水线有直接工程价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Anchored Residual On-Policy Distillation（AR-OPD）。核心是把特权监督拆成两个可控制分量：(1) Anchor：用仅含部分特权信息的教师（例如只看到到当前步为止的中间正确状态，而非完整解答），提供因果可达的局部模仿目标，把学生与后见之明的答案隔离开；(2) Residual：把全视角教师的前瞻信息以 λ 缩放的 log-probability 增量形式叠加到 Anchor 上，只注入方向级的目的地引导，不强求匹配完整分布。这样把原本的绝对模仿转化为「以可达分布为基点、以全视角前瞻为受控修正」的 log-space 残差更新，避免学生分布漂移到不可达的后验区域。
summary.experiments: 在多类推理基准上的平均得分：相对基座模型提升 12.1 分，相对全视角特权 OPD 基线提升 2.3 分。机制分析上，用 Top-k Disagreement 和 Support Gap 量化了全视角教师在 rollout 尾部与学生局部支撑的偏离，且偏离随特权上下文长度增加而加剧；AR-OPD 将 shortcut / 特权信息泄漏事件降低了 21.7%，并在长程推理场景下比全视角模仿更稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，预计 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对「后见之明偏差导致不可达目标」的问题定义，以及图 1 对特权信息泄漏的直观示意；Section 4 的诊断指标（Top-k Disagreement、Support Gap）是很好的分析工具，可以直接借用到自己的蒸馏实验排查中；AR-OPD 的目标函数构造和 λ 系数的消融是方法核心。对做后训练 recipe 的同学，重点关注 Anchor 信息粒度如何选取——这是该方法能否泛化到其他任务的关键。

summary_en.core_problem: Privileged On-Policy Distillation (e.g. OPSD, SDFT) uses a self-teacher augmented with privileged information such as oracle traces or full solutions to provide dense supervision on the student’s own sampled trajectories. Existing methods treat the full-view privileged teacher distribution as an absolute imitation target, failing to separate causally reachable reasoning steps at the current prefix from future-conditioned hindsight signals. This forces the student to match a distribution outside its local predictive support, leading to privileged-information leakage, reasoning shortcuts, and instability in long-horizon reasoning.
summary_en.importance: The work identifies a previously under-diagnosed optimization pathology in the privileged OPD paradigm now widely used in industry pipelines—hindsight bias from full-view imitation producing unreachable targets. The proposed two-view decomposition (reachable anchor + controlled residual) gives a more stable target construction for privileged distillation, and is directly useful for mixed SFT+RL post-training recipes targeting math, code, and long-horizon reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Anchored Residual On-Policy Distillation (AR-OPD) decomposes privileged supervision into two controllable components. (1) Anchor: a partially privileged teacher that only sees intermediate correct states up to the current step (not the full solution), providing a causally reachable local imitation target that shields the student from hindsight-biased answers. (2) Residual: the forward-looking signal from the full-view teacher, injected as a λ-scaled log-probability update on top of the Anchor. This transfers destination-directed foresight without forcing the student to match the full hindsight-biased distribution. Absolute imitation is thus replaced by a log-space residual update anchored to a reachable distribution, preventing the student policy from drifting into unreachable hindsight regions.
summary_en.experiments: Across a diverse set of reasoning benchmarks, AR-OPD improves the average score by 12.1 points over the base model and 2.3 points over full-view privileged OPD. Mechanistically, Top-k Disagreement and Support Gap diagnostics quantify that full-view teacher misalignment with the student’s local support grows toward the tail of rollouts and worsens as privileged-context length increases. AR-OPD reduces shortcut / privileged-information-leakage events by 21.7%, and exhibits better stability than full-view imitation on long-horizon tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read, roughly 30 minutes. Focus on the Introduction for the precise framing of unreachable targets caused by hindsight bias, and Figure 1 for a concrete illustration of privileged-information leakage. The diagnostic metrics in Section 4 (Top-k Disagreement, Support Gap) are useful analysis tools that can be borrowed directly to debug distillation runs. The core of the method lies in the AR-OPD objective construction and the λ-coefficient ablations. For engineers building post-training recipes, how to choose the information granularity of the Anchor is the key variable that determines whether the approach generalizes beyond the tested tasks.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫方法部分：它指出 privileged trace 蒸馏会制造局部不可达目标，这个坑应在内部 reasoning SFT/RL 数据里检查。
recommendation.en: Skim the method: the useful point is that privileged-trace distillation can create locally unreachable targets, a failure mode worth checking in internal reasoning SFT/RL data.

paper.title: Stabilizing On-Policy Distillation for MLLM Reasoning with Global Normalization
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has recently emerged as an important post-training paradigm. By using a stronger teacher model to provide dense, fine-grained supervision for sampled trajectories, OPD offers a clear advantage over reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), which typically depends on sparse binary or outcome-based environmental feedback. However, naive token-level distillation can suffer from gradient instability, due to magnitude misalignment in outlier states. To addres

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态推理模型 on-policy distillation 中，token 级蒸馏在异常状态上出现梯度幅值失配、训练不稳定的问题。
summary.importance: 这是后训练优化问题，但和 pretrain 研究员关心的训练稳定性、密集监督信号设计、KL 目标的数值行为直接相关。贡献类型属于训练方法改进，而不是新 benchmark 或纯工程调参。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GNDPO（Globally Normalized Distillation Policy Optimization）。核心做法是把原始 token-level KL 分数转成 batch 级相对 advantage，再进行全局归一化，以抑制 outlier state 导致的梯度爆炸，同时保留 teacher 提供的细粒度轨迹监督。方法属于对 OPD 的稳定化改造，而非替代 OPD 的全新范式。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明在多模态推理任务上，GNDPO 同时提升训练鲁棒性和下游性能，并与 RLVR 形成对照：OPD 依赖密集 teacher 信号，RLVR 依赖稀疏 outcome reward。未给出模型参数量、数据规模、具体 benchmark 和提升幅度，因此结论强度还需看正文中的 ablation 与梯度统计。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses instability in on-policy distillation for multimodal reasoning, where token-level distillation suffers from gradient magnitude mismatch on outlier states.
summary_en.importance: Although this is a post-training paper, it is directly relevant to pretraining-minded researchers because it studies training stability, dense supervision design, and the numerical behavior of KL-based objectives. The contribution is a training-method improvement rather than a benchmark or pure engineering tweak.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes GNDPO (Globally Normalized Distillation Policy Optimization), which transforms raw token-level KL scores into batch-level relative advantages with global normalization. This is meant to suppress gradient explosions from outlier states while preserving the fine-grained supervision benefits of teacher-guided on-policy distillation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims improved robustness and downstream performance on multimodal reasoning tasks, contrasting OPD's dense teacher supervision with RLVR's sparse outcome rewards. It does not report model sizes, data scale, benchmarks, or gain magnitudes, so the real strength of the result depends on the full paper's ablations and gradient diagnostics.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该从“目标函数数值稳定性”角度读，不是看多模态结果；若你在做 KL 蒸馏、RLOO 或 dense reward，先看归一化定义和梯度统计。
recommendation.en: Read this as an objective-stability paper, not a multimodal one; if you work on KL distillation, dense rewards, or RLOO-like updates, inspect the normalization rule and gradient diagnostics first.

paper.title: Trajectory-Refined Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become a central post-training tool for large language models (LLMs), providing dense per-token teacher supervision along the student's own rollouts. In this work, we identify a common structural cause underlying OPD, which we call prefix failure. Under prefix failure, dense per-token supervision induces a bimodal teacher mixture and fragmented gradients that token-level loss truncation or reweighting fail to address. This observation motivates us to move beyond

summary.core_problem: LLM on-policy蒸馏（OPD）普遍存在prefix failure问题，token级损失截断/重加权无法解决由此导致的双峰教师分布与碎片化梯度
summary.importance: 提出从token级损失干预转向轨迹级修正的蒸馏新范式，属于LLM后训练蒸馏的方法创新
summary.technical_approach: 提出轨迹精炼蒸馏（TRD），在蒸馏前先在教师指导下修正学生rollout的问题前缀，保持在on-policy支撑集内，同时通过暴露其他有效推导路径提升探索性
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型规模、训练数据集、基线方法及定量性能提升数据，仅阐述了prefix failure的成因与TRD的核心机制
summary.authors_note: 作者包含Amy Zhang（强化学习与LLM对齐领域知名研究者），其余作者所属机构未在摘要中明确披露

summary_en.core_problem: On-policy distillation (OPD) for LLMs suffers from a structural prefix failure issue, which causes bimodal teacher distributions and fragmented gradients that token-level loss interventions cannot resolve
summary_en.importance: Proposes a paradigm shift from token-level to trajectory-level correction for on-policy distillation, a methodological innovation in LLM post-training
summary_en.technical_approach: Trajectory-Refined Distillation (TRD) corrects problematic prefixes of student rollouts under teacher guidance before distillation, stays within the on-policy support set, and improves exploration by exposing students to alternative valid derivations
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose specific model sizes, training datasets, baselines, or quantitative gains, only articulating the root cause of prefix failure and TRD's core mechanism
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Amy Zhang, a well-known researcher in reinforcement learning and LLM alignment; other authors' affiliations are not specified in the abstract

recommendation.zh: 后训练蒸馏的新范式，轨迹级修正比token级调整更治本，可引入内部蒸馏实验做ablation，重点看§3的成因分析
recommendation.en: New post-training distillation paradigm; trajectory-level correction is more fundamental than token-level tweaks, worth ablating in internal pipelines, focus on §3 root cause analysis

paper.title: Breaking the Tokenizer Barrier: On-Policy Distillation across Model Families
paper.abstract: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) has become a core technique in the post-training of Large Language Models (LLMs) for transferring knowledge from domain experts to student models. However, existing OPD distillation methods require teacher and student models to share the same tokenizer, restricting the applicability of OPD within the model series. Current mainstream practice typically employs Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on teacher-generated responses for cross-tokenizer distillation, which fails to

summary.core_problem: 解决 on-policy distillation 依赖师生共享 tokenizer 的限制，使不同模型家族之间也能传递 token-level 教师分布信号。
summary.importance: 这项工作虽然属于后训练，但对基座研究员很有接口价值：它直接触及 tokenizer 作为知识迁移边界的问题，并给出跨 tokenizer 的 OPD 方案。若结论可靠，会影响 teacher-student 选择空间、蒸馏管线设计，以及未来统一 tokenizer/异构 tokenizer 的取舍。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出跨 tokenizer 的 on-policy distillation，通过精确 token mapping 算法把教师分布对齐到学生词表，从而保留标准 OPD 的 token-level 概率监督，而不是退化成 teacher-generated responses 上的 SFT。核心创新点在于跨词表概率信号传播，而非简单数据蒸馏。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多种 benchmark 上比较 cross-tokenizer OPD 与基于教师回答的 SFT 等基线，结论是前者更省算力且效果更好。未在摘要中给出具体模型规模和提升幅度，但实验主张是：跨家族蒸馏不必再受 tokenizer 绑定。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper removes the shared-tokenizer requirement in on-policy distillation, enabling token-level teacher supervision across different model families.
summary_en.importance: Although this is a post-training paper, it has a strong interface to foundation-model research: it directly treats the tokenizer as a bottleneck for knowledge transfer and proposes a way around it. If the result holds, it changes how we think about teacher-student pairing, distillation pipelines, and the trade-off between unified and heterogeneous tokenizers.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose cross-tokenizer on-policy distillation, using a precise token-mapping algorithm to align the teacher distribution to the student vocabulary so that standard OPD can still use token-level probability signals. This avoids collapsing cross-family distillation into plain SFT on teacher-generated responses. The key novelty is probability transfer across vocabularies, not just response-level data distillation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract says the method is compared against baselines such as SFT on teacher outputs across multiple benchmarks, and that cross-tokenizer OPD is both more compute-efficient and more effective. The abstract does not provide model sizes or exact gains, but the main empirical claim is that cross-family distillation need not be constrained by tokenizer compatibility.

recommendation.zh: 值得看，因为它把 tokenizer 从“蒸馏前提”改成“可跨越接口”；先查 token mapping 是否严格保概率质量，再决定要不要复现。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it turns tokenizer compatibility from a hard prerequisite into an interface problem; first inspect whether the token mapping really preserves probability mass before reproducing.

paper.title: SG-OPD: Sign-Gated On-Policy Distillation via Sign-Consistency Gating and Phased Teacher Sampling
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own trajectories with dense per-token supervision from a stronger teacher, and often outperforms off-policy distillation and standard reinforcement learning. However, we find that its effectiveness implicitly relies on two assumptions that frequently break in practice: trajectory-level alignment between the student and the teacher, and uniform token-level reliability of the teacher's preferences. We therefore propose Sign-Gated On-Policy Disti

summary.core_problem: On-policy distillation (OPD) 依赖两个在实践中经常不成立的隐含假设——学生与教师轨迹对齐、教师 token 级偏好可靠——导致效果下降。
summary.importance: 方法创新：首次系统分析 OPD 的隐含失效假设，并提出基于二分类验证器(verifier)作为教师可信度信号的双层门控机制，在数学推理 benchmark 上超越标准 OPD。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SG-OPD，用二分类验证器在两个互补粒度上做教师可信度门控：(1) phased teacher sampling 在冷启动阶段混入验证器认可的教师轨迹；(2) sign-consistency gate 在教师与验证器方向一致时外推 distillation 更新、不一致时内插。
summary.experiments: 在竞赛级数学推理 benchmark 上进行实验，SG-OPD 一致超越标准 OPD。（摘要未给出具体模型规模和提升幅度）
summary.authors_note: 作者来自国内高校/研究院，作者名单中未发现业内知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: On-policy distillation (OPD) implicitly relies on two frequently violated assumptions—trajectory-level student-teacher alignment and uniform token-level teacher reliability—leading to degraded performance.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: first systematic analysis of OPD's implicit failure assumptions, proposes a dual-gating mechanism using a binary verifier as teacher trust signal, outperforms standard OPD on math reasoning benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach: SG-OPD uses a binary verifier as trust signal at two granularities: (1) phased teacher sampling mixes verifier-endorsed teacher rollouts during cold-start; (2) sign-consistency gate extrapolates distillation updates where teacher agrees with verifier-correct direction and interpolates where it disagrees.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments on competition-level mathematical reasoning benchmarks show SG-OPD consistently outperforms standard OPD. (Specific model sizes and improvement margins not given in abstract.)
summary_en.authors_note: Authors from Chinese universities/research institutes; no widely recognized researchers identified in the author list.

recommendation.zh: OPD 是后训练的重要范式，这篇文章指出了其隐含失效假设并提出基于 verifier 的门控，核心 insight 值得关注，但实验规模不够大，读 §3 和 §4 即可。
recommendation.en: OPD is an important post-training paradigm; this paper identifies its implicit failure assumptions and proposes verifier-based gating. Core insight is worth noting, but experiment scale is modest—read §3 and §4 only.

paper.title: Data-Efficient Autoregressive-to-Diffusion Language Models via On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: We study the transformation of autoregressive models (ARLMs) into diffusion language models (DLMs). Rather than pretraining from scratch, prior work replaces the causal attention in ARLMs with bidirectional attention and then trains the resulting model using a DLM objective. However, these approaches incur two distribution shifts. First, transitioning from a next-token prediction objective to a DLM objective can discard knowledge acquired by the ARLM during training. Second, standard DLMs suffer

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 AR 语言模型向 diffusion 语言模型转换时的两个核心失配。第一是知识保留失配：把一个已经通过 next-token prediction 学到大量知识的 ARLM 改成双向注意力，再用 diffusion 目标继续训练，原有知识容易被冲淡。第二是训练-推理状态失配：标准 masked diffusion LM 训练时看到的是随机 mask 的状态，但推理时走的是由模型自身和置信度解码策略决定的逐步去噪轨迹，两者分布并不一致。作者的目标不是从零训练更强的 DLM，而是把“AR→DLM 转换”做成一种高数据效率、低算力的 post-training 过程，让已有 AR checkpoint 能以很小代价获得 DLM 的双向建模和多 token 解码能力。
summary.importance: 对新型语言建模范式研究，这篇工作很重要，因为它把讨论重点从“DLM 能不能和 AR 比”转到了“能不能低成本地从 AR 继承能力”。这改变了 diffusion LM 的工程入口。过去很多 DLM 工作即便不从零训，也仍需要数十亿到更多 token 的继续训练；这篇论文给出的结论是，若把训练目标改成 on-policy distillation，并直接在学生模型自己会访问到的去噪状态上蒸馏 AR teacher，转换成本可以降一个数量级以上。贡献类型上，它不是提出新的 diffusion parameterization，而是提出一种更像 post-training recipe 的转换框架。对 pretrain 研究员的意义在于：它把 AR 和非 AR 范式之间的边界变得更软，说明某些“替代范式”未必需要独立预训练栈，也可以作为已有基座模型的后续建模层来获得。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 OPDLM 和其中的 On-Policy Distillation。学生模型来自一个 ARLM checkpoint，但把 causal attention 改成 bidirectional attention，使其可以对被 mask 的任意位置做条件建模。教师模型则保留原始冻结 ARLM。关键难点在于，AR teacher 和 DLM student 的状态空间不同：teacher 习惯在完整左前缀上做 next-token prediction，student 则在部分已知、部分 mask 的序列状态上做去噪。作者的处理方式不是把 teacher 直接搬到随机 mask 状态上，而是让 student 先按自己的 diffusion 解码策略 rollout 出一条反向去噪轨迹，从中采样一个部分去噪状态 x_t，再对其中仍被 mask 的位置做蒸馏。

蒸馏目标的构造很讲究。对每个 masked 位置 i，student 输出该位置的 token 分布；teacher 则读取终态序列 x_0 中该位置之前的 causal prefix，给出 AR 条件分布，作为该位置的监督信号。也就是说，teacher 提供的是“如果按 AR 方式生成到这里，应该偏向哪些 token”，student 学的是“在当前部分去噪状态下，对这些尚未恢复的位置给出与 teacher 一致的分布”。这样做同时解决两件事：一是知识保留，因为监督直接来自原 AR 模型的 logits，而不是只靠 diffusion NELBO 重新学；二是 train-test mismatch，因为训练样本来自 student 自己的 on-policy rollout，而不是离线随机 mask。

论文还加入 rollout-length curriculum。直觉上，训练初期学生模型还不稳定，如果一开始就在很长的去噪轨迹上做 on-policy 学习，状态分布会太差，蒸馏信号也更噪。于是作者逐步增加 rollout 长度，让学生先在较短、较容易的轨迹上对齐，再扩展到更接近真实推理的状态。这个设计和序列决策里的 curriculum / DAGGER 风格很接近，但这里的监督源是冻结 AR teacher。另一个值得注意的点是，作者把 OPDLM 明确定位成 general-purpose DLM 和 task-specific DLM 两种用法：既可以把通用 AR 基座转成通用 DLM，也可以在特定任务上做更便宜的转换。
summary.experiments:
实验最有信息量的是效率和失配消除两条线。效率上，论文给出一个很醒目的数字：OPDLM-8B 只用 0.066B 训练 token、4.2×10^18 FLOPs，就在 AIME-24 上建立了新的已知 Pareto 前沿；相较 LLaDA-8B、Dream-7B、SDAR-8B、Fast-dLLM-v2-7B 等已有 AR→DLM 或 DLM 方案，训练 token 需求低 15× 到 7000×。这说明它不是小幅省一点继续训练成本，而是把转换从“接近再预训练”压到了“像一次重型 post-train”。

性能上，作者在多类任务上验证，包括通用语言任务、数学推理、代码，以及 task-specific 设置。摘要页和图 1 重点展示了 AIME-24；正文还包含 GPQA-Diamond、AIME-25 等结果，并在附录给出多 seed 评估。论文的主张不是单点最高分，而是在极低训练成本下保持强竞争力。方法消融方面，最关键的是 on-policy vs off-policy distillation：on-policy 明显更好，支持作者关于训练-推理状态匹配的论点。还有 teacher size 的影响、较小规模模型结果、以及与普通 supervised fine-tuning 的比较，这些都在附录展开。推理效率方面，作者展示了 multi-token decoding 的收益，说明转换成 DLM 后确实能利用并行去噪带来的步数优势，而不是只在训练目标上换壳。
summary.reading_guide: 建议按“问题设定→方法→效率证据→消融”这个顺序读。先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，明确作者要解决的不是一般蒸馏，而是 AR→DLM 转换中的两类失配。然后重点读第 4 节，尤其是 4.1 和 4.2：4.1 解释为什么标准 DLM 有 train-inference mismatch，4.2 解释 teacher supervision 如何定义在 on-policy states 上，这是整篇最关键的技术点。4.3 的 rollout-length curriculum 也值得看，因为它关系到训练是否稳定。实验部分优先看 5.2 和 5.3：前者看通用 DLM 转换是否成立，后者看 on-policy 相对 off-policy 的必要性。再看 5.4 理解 multi-token decoding 的实际收益，最后看 5.5 判断它作为 task-specific DLM 的性价比。附录里 A.2、A.4、A.5 信息密度很高，分别对应 teacher size、多 seed 稳定性、以及和 SFT 的边界。精读时要特别想清楚一个问题：teacher 给的是 AR 条件分布，student 学的是双向去噪分布，这种监督是否会限制 student 超越 teacher。论文给出的答案更偏工程：先把能力保住，再利用 DLM 的解码形态获益。
summary.authors_note: 机构可确认的是 University of Texas Health Science Center at Houston 与 Texas A&M University。全文首页只给出单位与共同一作标记，当前提供内容里未完整列出作者姓名。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles two mismatches in converting an autoregressive language model into a diffusion language model. The first is a knowledge-retention mismatch: once a pretrained ARLM is modified to use bidirectional attention and optimized with a diffusion objective, some of the knowledge learned through next-token prediction can be weakened or lost. The second is a train–inference state mismatch: standard masked diffusion LMs are trained on randomly masked sequences, but at inference they follow model-dependent reverse denoising trajectories induced by confidence-based decoding. The paper aims to turn AR-to-DLM conversion into a data-efficient post-training procedure rather than another expensive pretraining stage.
summary_en.importance: This is an important paper for alternative language modeling paradigms because it changes the practical entry point for diffusion LMs. Instead of asking whether DLMs can compete with AR models when trained at scale, it asks whether a strong AR checkpoint can be converted into a useful DLM at very low additional cost. That is a different and more actionable question. The contribution is not a new diffusion parameterization; it is a conversion recipe that treats DLM acquisition as post-training. For pretraining researchers, the broader implication is that AR and non-AR paradigms may not need fully separate training stacks. Some of the benefits of a non-AR model can be obtained by reusing an existing AR base and distilling into a new decoding geometry.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The central idea is OPDLM, trained with On-Policy Distillation. The student starts from an ARLM checkpoint whose causal attention is replaced with bidirectional attention, enabling denoising over arbitrary masked positions. The teacher is the original frozen ARLM. The main challenge is that the teacher and student do not share the same state space: the teacher predicts the next token from a causal prefix, while the student denoises partially observed sequences.

The paper resolves this by letting the student generate its own reverse denoising trajectories. At each training step, the student rolls out a trajectory under its own diffusion decoding policy, and one partially denoised state x_t is sampled from that trajectory. Distillation is then applied only to the still-masked positions in x_t. For each masked position i, the student predicts a token distribution conditioned on the partially denoised sequence, while the teacher provides target logits conditioned on the causal prefix of the terminal sequence x_0 up to position i. In effect, the teacher says what an AR model would prefer at that position, and the student learns to match that preference on the states it will actually encounter during inference.

This design addresses both mismatches at once. Knowledge retention improves because supervision comes directly from the original AR teacher rather than from relearning everything through a diffusion NELBO. Train–test mismatch is reduced because training states are on-policy student states, not uniformly random masks. The paper also introduces a rollout-length curriculum: early in training, the student is supervised on shorter and easier trajectories, and the rollout horizon is gradually increased as the model stabilizes. That choice is important for optimization, since long on-policy trajectories from an immature student would otherwise create noisy and low-quality supervision. The framework is presented both as a general-purpose AR-to-DLM conversion method and as a cheaper task-specific DLM adaptation method.
summary_en.experiments:
The most informative results are about efficiency and the necessity of on-policy training. On efficiency, the headline number is striking: OPDLM-8B uses only 0.066B training tokens and 4.2 × 10^18 FLOPs, while establishing a new known Pareto frontier on AIME-24. Relative to prior DLM or AR-to-DLM conversion systems such as LLaDA-8B, Dream-7B, SDAR-8B, and Fast-dLLM-v2-7B, the required training tokens are reduced by roughly 15× to 7,000×. That is not a marginal saving; it turns conversion into something much closer to heavy post-training than continued pretraining.

On task performance, the paper evaluates across general-purpose and reasoning-heavy settings, including math and coding, and also studies task-specific conversion. The emphasis is not on claiming the single best absolute score everywhere, but on maintaining strong performance under dramatically lower training cost. The key ablation compares on-policy and off-policy distillation, and on-policy consistently wins, directly supporting the train–inference mismatch argument. Additional appendices study smaller-scale settings, the effect of teacher size, multi-seed evaluation on GPQA-Diamond and AIME variants, and comparisons against standard supervised fine-tuning. The inference section also shows that the converted DLM can exploit multi-token decoding, so the method is not merely changing the training loss while keeping AR-like inference behavior.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it in the order of problem setup, method, efficiency evidence, and ablations. Start with the introduction and Figure 1 to understand that the paper is about two mismatches in AR-to-DLM conversion, not generic distillation. Then focus on Section 4. Sections 4.1 and 4.2 are the core: 4.1 explains why standard DLM training does not match inference-time states, and 4.2 defines how AR teacher supervision is projected onto those on-policy student states. Section 4.3 on rollout-length curriculum is also worth careful reading because it is likely important for stability. In the experiments, prioritize Sections 5.2 and 5.3: the former tests whether the method works as a general-purpose DLM conversion recipe, and the latter shows why on-policy distillation matters. Then read 5.4 for the practical value of multi-token decoding, and 5.5 for the task-specific setting. In the appendix, A.2, A.4, and A.5 are especially useful for understanding teacher-size dependence, variance across seeds, and the boundary between this method and ordinary SFT. A good question to keep in mind while reading is whether an AR teacher can cap the student’s ceiling. The paper’s answer is pragmatic: first preserve the AR model’s competence under the new bidirectional denoising regime, then benefit from the DLM decoding form.
summary_en.authors_note: The affiliations visible in the provided full text are the University of Texas Health Science Center at Houston and Texas A&M University. The author names are not fully visible in the supplied content.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在跟踪 DLM/MDLM/LLaDA 这条线，这篇值得先读：它抓住的不是小技巧，而是 AR→双向生成迁移里的分布错配；先看是否真做了 on-policy、baseline 是否算公平。
recommendation.en: If you track DLM/MDLM/LLaDA-style work, read this first: the real point is the distribution mismatch in AR-to-bidirectional transfer; verify that the on-policy setup is genuine and the baselines are fair.
