paper.title: Trust-Region Behavior Blending for On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on prefixes sampled from its own policy while matching a stronger teacher. This addresses the prefix mismatch of offline distillation, but early student rollouts can still be poor, placing teacher supervision on weak or low-quality prefixes. We propose Trust-Region behavior Blending (TRB), a warmup method that replaces the early rollout policy with the closest-to-teacher behavior policy inside a student-centered KL trust region, while keeping the per

summary.core_problem: OPD 用学生自己的 rollout 前缀做蒸馏，能缓解离线蒸馏的 prefix mismatch；但训练早期学生策略弱，采样前缀质量低，教师监督会落在无效或噪声较大的轨迹上。
summary.importance: 这项工作对预训练研究的直接价值不在基座预训练，而在 on-policy 训练接口：当训练数据由当前模型策略产生时，早期分布质量会影响后续优化。TRB 给出一个较干净的折中：只改 rollout 行为策略，不改每个前缀上的蒸馏 loss，并用 KL trust region 控制偏离学生策略的幅度。这个设计对 RL/SFT 后续训练、self-training、online distillation 都有启发。
summary.technical_approach: TRB 在每个生成前缀 h 上构造行为策略 μ，用它采样 rollout；但更新时仍使用原来的 reverse-KL OPD 目标。μ 的定义是：在以当前学生策略 πS 为中心、KL 半径为 ε 的 trust region 内，选择最接近教师策略 πT 的分布，即最小化 D_KL(μ||πT)，约束 D_KL(μ||πS)≤ε。这个问题有闭式解，形式上是学生和教师分布的几何插值：μβ(a|h) ∝ πS(a|h)^(1-β) πT(a|h)^β。β 越大越接近教师；实际取满足 KL 约束的最大 β，必要时二分搜索。ε 在 warmup 阶段线性退火到 0，所以训练开始时 rollout 更受教师引导，之后回到纯学生采样。它和 SKD 这类直接注入教师 token 的方法不同：TRB 不把单个 token 强行替换成教师输出，而是用 KL 约束控制整个采样分布的局部偏移。它也不同于 fixed-ε blending，因为后者一直保持 off-policy 偏移，容易破坏 OPD 最终想匹配的学生访问分布。
summary.experiments: 实验集中在两个数学推理蒸馏设置：Qwen3-1.7B-Base 从 Qwen3-8B 蒸馏，Qwen3-0.6B-Base 从 Qwen3-4B 蒸馏。评价指标是 pass@1，所有方法共享训练和评估协议；对 sweep 方法每 20 step 评估一次，并报告各自平均分最高的 checkpoint。比较对象包括 vanilla OPD、fixed-ε blending、Veto、SKD、temperature warmup 和 SFT warmup。结果显示，TRB 在两个模型对的平均分上都是最优；fixed-ε blending 使用同一个 per-prefix solver，但平均结果不如 TRB，说明 annealing 对回到目标 on-policy 分布是关键。部分 baseline 在个别列上更好，但整体平均不及 TRB。摘要和正文片段未给出 Table 1 的具体数值，因此不宜补写精确提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 15–25 分钟即可。重点看 Sec. 3 的 trust-region 问题定义和闭式解，确认它只是改 rollout policy，而不是改 OPD loss。再看 Table 1 和 Figure 2，关注 TRB、fixed-ε、SKD、vanilla OPD 的差异。若要复现，Appendix E 的解法推导、Appendix F 的局部行为分析、Appendix G 的 token-level 到 rollout-level 控制值得补看。可以跳过大部分背景叙述。

summary_en.core_problem: On-policy distillation reduces prefix-distribution mismatch by training on student-sampled prefixes, but early student rollouts are often poor. Teacher supervision is then applied on weak trajectories where the signal may be less useful.
summary_en.importance: The paper is most relevant as an online-training recipe rather than as a base pretraining method. It isolates a common issue in policy-generated data: the current model determines the data distribution, but the current model is weakest exactly when training begins. TRB offers a controlled way to improve early data collection while preserving the original per-prefix OPD objective. The same design pattern is relevant to online distillation, self-training, and RL-style post-training loops.
summary_en.technical_approach: TRB changes only the behavior policy used for rollout collection. At each prefix h, it chooses a sampling distribution μ that is as close as possible to the teacher πT under D_KL(μ||πT), while staying inside a student-centered trust region D_KL(μ||πS)≤ε. The solution is a geometric interpolation between student and teacher distributions, μβ(a|h) ∝ πS(a|h)^(1-β)πT(a|h)^β. The largest feasible β is selected, with binary search when the teacher itself is outside the KL budget. The per-prefix reverse-KL distillation loss is unchanged. The KL budget is linearly annealed to zero during warmup, so collection starts with bounded teacher guidance and eventually becomes pure student rollout. This separates TRB from direct token replacement methods and from persistent behavior blending.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses two math-reasoning distillation pairs: Qwen3-1.7B-Base distilled from Qwen3-8B, and Qwen3-0.6B-Base distilled from Qwen3-4B. The reported metric is pass@1. Checkpoints are evaluated every 20 steps, and each setup reports the best mean score under the shared selection protocol. Baselines include vanilla OPD, fixed-ε blending, Veto, SKD, temperature warmup, and SFT warmup. TRB achieves the best average score in both model-pair settings. Fixed-ε blending uses the same local solver but underperforms TRB, which supports the claim that annealing the off-policy deviation matters. The provided text does not include the exact Table 1 numbers, so precise deltas should be read from the paper.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim pass should take about 15–25 minutes. Read Section 3 for the constrained behavior-policy formulation and the closed-form interpolation family. Then inspect Table 1 and Figure 2 for the comparison against vanilla OPD, fixed-ε blending, and SKD. For implementation details, Appendix E, F, and G are the useful parts: they cover the solver, local behavior, and the relation between token-level KL control and rollout-level behavior.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法定义和数学实验表；它把 OPD warmup 的分布偏移问题讲得干净，适合内部蒸馏 ablation 复现。
recommendation.en: Read the method and math tables; the clean part is the OPD warmup distribution fix, worth reproducing in internal distillation ablations.

paper.title: ADWIN: Adaptive Windows for Horizon-Aware On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers reasoning behavior by training a student on teacher feedback along student-generated trajectories, but standard full-rollout training ties every update to a costly completion and can over-allocate supervision to late positions with low marginal value for the current student. We revisit this assumption through the useful supervision horizon: student-induced rollouts can drift from teacher-preferred continuations, while aligned prefixes may already preserve t

summary.core_problem: 标准同策略蒸馏（OPD）需要基于学生生成的完整轨迹执行参数更新，存在两个核心缺陷：一是每次更新都被完整轨迹的生成阻塞，训练效率低；二是学生自回归生成的轨迹后半段往往偏离教师偏好的合理分布，后半段的监督信号边际价值很低，甚至会引入噪声。
summary.importance: 为同策略蒸馏类后训练方法提供了可落地的效率优化思路，其核心观察——轨迹前缀的梯度方向已经能代表完整轨迹的优化方向——对所有需要生成完整轨迹的RL类后训练流程都有参考价值，可直接降低推理类蒸馏的计算成本。
summary.technical_approach: 提出ADWIN自适应窗口框架，将轨迹生成长度转化为在线可决策的前缀有效性问题：同步执行基于短前缀的参数更新，保证训练不被长轨迹生成阻塞；同时异步抽取少量前缀扩展为完整轨迹作为探针，校验前缀更新的梯度方向与完整轨迹更新的一致性，根据校验结果动态调整下一轮同步更新的前缀窗口长度，在保证优化效果的前提下选择最短的可用窗口。
summary.experiments: 在数学、代码基准的单任务、多任务、强到弱蒸馏场景下进行了测试，与标准完整轨迹OPD相比，端到端训练FLOPs最多降低4.1倍，同时精度持平或更优，效果优于固定前缀长度或外部调度的前缀基线。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读引言部分的问题分析和方法概述，以及核心算法流程图；不需要深究公式推导的细节，整体阅读时间约30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard on-policy distillation (OPD) requires parameter updates based on full student-generated trajectories, with two core drawbacks: first, each update is blocked by the generation of complete trajectories, leading to low training efficiency; second, the latter segments of student autoregressive trajectories often deviate from the reasonable distribution preferred by the teacher, resulting in low marginal value of supervision signals in later positions, and even introducing noise.
summary_en.importance: It provides a practical efficiency optimization idea for on-policy distillation post-training methods. Its core observation that the gradient direction of trajectory prefixes can already represent the optimization direction of full trajectories has reference value for all RL post-training processes that require generating complete trajectories, and can directly reduce the computational cost of reasoning distillation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The ADWIN adaptive window framework is proposed, which transforms trajectory generation length into an online decidable prefix admissibility problem: parameter updates based on short prefixes are executed synchronously to ensure training is not blocked by long trajectory generation; meanwhile, a small number of prefixes are asynchronously extended to complete trajectories as probes to verify the consistency between the gradient direction of prefix updates and full trajectory updates. The prefix window length for the next round of synchronous updates is dynamically adjusted according to the verification results, selecting the shortest available window while ensuring optimization effect.
summary_en.experiments: Tested in single-task, multi-task, and strong-to-weak distillation scenarios on math and code benchmarks. Compared with standard full-trajectory OPD, end-to-end training FLOPs are reduced by up to 4.1×, while accuracy is comparable or better, outperforming fixed prefix length or externally scheduled prefix baselines.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the problem analysis and method overview in the introduction, as well as the core algorithm flow chart; there is no need to delve into the details of formula derivation, and the total reading time is about 30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: ADWIN在OPD中引入自适应滚动窗口的思路对优化RL训练计算效率有实际启发，建议看核心方法§3和实验对比图表。
recommendation.en: ADWIN's adaptive rollout window approach for OPD offers practical insights for optimizing RL training compute efficiency; read §3 (core method) and experimental comparison figures.

paper.title: Not All Disagreement Is Learnable: Token Teachability in On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own rollouts with token-level teacher supervision. Recent selective OPD methods exploit the non-uniformity of OPD signals by prioritizing high-entropy or high-disagreement tokens. We revisit this principle and ask: which token-level teacher signals are actually learnable? Using a fixed-context diagnostic that measures same-context teacher-student KL reduction, we show that raw KL disagreement is a coarse proxy for learning value. It conflates

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是 on-policy distillation 里的一个细粒度问题：学生模型在自己生成的前缀上接受教师 token 分布监督，但高 teacher-student KL 并不一定意味着这个 token 位置真的能学到东西。作者要区分两类分歧：一种是教师把概率质量重新分配到学生已经认为可能的候选 token 上，更新容易被学生吸收；另一种是教师主要支持学生当前预测支撑集之外的 token，KL 很大，但局部更新效果弱。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响在于训练信号质量分析，尤其是蒸馏、SFT 数据选择和 RL 前后的 policy improvement。它提醒一个常见误区：token 级别的 loss 或 KL 大，不等于学习价值高。对小模型蒸馏大模型时，瓶颈不只是 token 数量，而是教师信号是否落在学生当前可表示、可调整的局部区域内。这对高效蒸馏、token budget 分配、以及训练动态诊断都有参考价值，但贡献主要在 post-train/distillation 的信号选择层面，不是新的基座预训练 recipe。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法有两步。第一步是 fixed-context diagnostic。作者收集学生 on-policy rollout 产生的前缀，把这些前缀固定成 context bank，然后用训练前后的学生模型在同一批上下文上重新打分，计算同一上下文下 teacher-student KL 的下降量。这样可以把 token 位置自身的可学习性从 rollout 噪声、后续上下文漂移和答案级评价中分离出来。第二步是定义 token teachability。作者用学生 top-K token 集合作为局部支撑集，考察教师概率质量是否主要落在这个支撑集或其附近。如果教师纠正信号与学生当前支撑集对齐，那么高 KL 更可能转化为 KL reduction；如果教师质量主要在学生支撑集之外，高 KL 往往只是不可兼容分歧。基于这个诊断，TA-OPD 用 support-aligned teacher-student disagreement 给 token 位置打分，只在高 teachability 的位置施加 OPD loss。它和高熵选择、原始 KL 选择的区别在于：不是选“不确定”或“分歧大”的 token，而是选学生当前状态下更可能被更新吸收的 token。实现上主要依赖 OPD 中已有的教师和学生 token 概率，可以用轻量 top-K 近似，不需要 reward model 或 verifier。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen3 和 Qwen2.5 系列的 teacher-student 配置，包含不同规模、推理能力和 backbone 的组合。诊断实验显示，低熵高 KL 区域并不均质；同样是 confident disagreement，support-aligned 的 token 更能预测固定上下文下的 KL 下降，而 off-support mismatch 的 token 学习收益弱。方法实验中，TA-OPD 在只保留 5% token 的设置下，经常可以匹配或超过 full-token OPD，并优于同 token budget 下的 entropy-based 和 divergence-based 选择方法。这个结果的重点不是单个 benchmark 的提升，而是说明 OPD 的有效性受 token teachability 约束，密集监督并不总是更好。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25 分钟。先看 Introduction 中 Fig. 1，对 learnable disagreement 和 incompatible disagreement 的例子建立直觉。然后看 Diagnosing Token Teachability，重点是 fixed-context token gain 的定义、为什么要固定上下文、以及 entropy-KL 平面里 Q3 区域被进一步拆开的分析。TA-OPD 的算法部分可以快速看公式和伪代码，关注 teachability score 如何用 top-K 支撑集近似。实验部分优先看 token retention ratio 的消融、和 entropy/KL selector 的对比、不同 K 值的敏感性。附录 C 和 I 如果有时间值得看，分别对应诊断协议和固定上下文收益的理论说明。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks which token-level teacher signals are actually learnable in on-policy distillation. In OPD, the student is supervised on its own rollouts, but a large teacher-student KL at a token does not necessarily imply a useful update. The key distinction is between support-aligned disagreement, where the teacher reallocates probability mass among tokens the student already considers plausible, and off-support disagreement, where the teacher mostly prefers tokens outside the student’s current predictive support.
summary_en.importance: The main value is a sharper view of training-signal quality in distillation. It is relevant to LLM post-training, small-model distillation, and the pretrain-posttrain interface because it shows that token loss magnitude is a weak proxy for improvement. The result suggests that token budget should be spent on locally compatible supervision rather than simply dense supervision or high-KL positions. The contribution is methodological and diagnostic rather than a new foundation-model pretraining recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper first introduces a fixed-context diagnostic. Student-generated on-policy prefixes are stored as a context bank. The initial and trained student are then rescored on exactly the same contexts against the same teacher distribution. For each token position, the diagnostic measures same-context teacher-student KL reduction, isolating local learnability from rollout variance and answer-level effects. The paper then formalizes token teachability using local support. The student’s top-K predictions define the tokens it currently treats as plausible. A teacher correction is more teachable when its probability mass is aligned with this support. Based on this idea, Teachability-Aware OPD scores response positions by support-aligned disagreement and applies the OPD loss only to high-teachability tokens. Unlike entropy-based or raw-KL selection, the criterion asks whether the teacher signal can be absorbed by the current student state. The method uses probabilities already available during OPD and can be approximated with top-K supports, without a reward model or verifier.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Qwen3 and Qwen2.5 teacher-student settings with variation in scale, reasoning strength, and model backbone. The diagnostic shows that the low-entropy, high-KL region is heterogeneous: support-aligned disagreements predict same-context KL reduction, while incompatible disagreements often remain hard to learn despite large KL. In training experiments, TA-OPD with only 5% retained tokens often matches or surpasses full-token OPD, and improves over entropy-based and divergence-based selectors under the same token budget. The important empirical message is that token quality can dominate token count in OPD.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25 minutes. Start with Fig. 1 and the diagnostic setup, since they contain the central idea. Then read the section defining fixed-context token gain and local support; this is where the paper separates salience from learnability. The TA-OPD algorithm can be read quickly, focusing on how the score is computed from top-K teacher and student probabilities. In the experiments, prioritize the retention-ratio ablations, comparisons with entropy and KL selectors, and sensitivity to K. The appendices on the diagnostic protocol and the smoothness/gradient-alignment argument are useful if the method is being considered for implementation.

recommendation.zh: 修正了蒸馏中“高分歧token优先训练”的常见误区，可教性指标设计精巧，做蒸馏或模型压缩的可直接复用其固定上下文诊断方法。
recommendation.en: Corrects the common misconception of prioritizing high-disagreement tokens in distillation; the teachability metric is well-designed, and its fixed-context diagnostic can be directly reused by distillation and model compression researchers.

paper.title: Reward-Weighted On-Policy Distillation with an Open Property-Equivalence Verifier for NL-to-SVA Generation
paper.abstract: LLM-based generation of SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) is often reported as nearing saturation, with the strongest specialized model reaching ${\sim}76\%$ accuracy on NL2SVA-Human. We show that this aggregate hides a temporal gap: models that appear strong overall still collapse to a few implication templates on bounded-delay and liveness specifications. The core issue is that the dominant recipe, supervised fine-tuning on NL/SVA pairs, optimizes token-level mimicry rather than the \emph{propert

summary.core_problem: 现有基于监督微调（SFT）的自然语言转SystemVerilog断言（SVA）方法存在模板坍塌问题：模型整体准确率看似接近饱和，但在有界延迟、活性等时序复杂场景下会退化为少数蕴含模板，核心原因是SFT优化token级与参考样本的匹配度，而非定义SVA正确性的属性语义等价性；同时商用闭源的属性等价验证器调用成本过高，无法直接用于强化学习训练的每步反馈。
summary.importance: 它验证了形式化验证信号与稠密蒸馏结合的训练范式，用验证器输出作为过滤和加权条件，解决了稀疏奖励信号不足的问题，为需要语义正确性而非表面token匹配的代码、形式化语言生成类任务的后训练优化提供了可复用的方法路径；开源的属性等价验证器降低了形式化验证与LLM训练结合的落地门槛。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法为奖励加权在策略蒸馏（RWOPD），流程分为三步：1）通过分层课程SFT训练7B参数量+LoRA的学生模型，使其覆盖不同时序复杂度的SVA类型；2）从学生模型采样输出，用开源的SymbiYosys+Z3属性等价检查器（PEC）过滤，仅保留通过验证的输出；3）对保留的输出按验证器给出的等价奖励加权，基于冻结的14B教师模型计算前向KL梯度更新学生模型。另外开源了针对有界模型检查片段的属性等价检查器，作为训练阶段的过滤信号，商用闭源验证器仅用于最终效果评测。
summary.experiments: 在NL2SVA-Human和NL2SVA-Machine基准上，7B+LoRA的RWOPD模型在pass@1、pass@5、pass@10指标上超过了此前最优的14B专用模型CodeV-SVA-14B和671B的通用基线模型；收益集中在时序复杂类别，其中C2类（有界时序）准确率提升7.5个百分点，C3类（活性）提升11.5个百分点，C1类（组合逻辑）已饱和无明显提升。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看第3章的模板坍塌问题分析、第4章的RWOPD方法设计和开源PEC的实现逻辑、第5章的消融实验结果；关注验证器信号与稠密蒸馏结合的核心设计思路，预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing SFT-based natural language to SystemVerilog Assertion (SVA) methods suffer from template collapse: while aggregate accuracy appears near saturation, models degrade to a small set of implication templates on temporally complex scenarios such as bounded delay and liveness specifications. The core cause is that SFT optimizes for token-level match with reference samples rather than the property semantic equivalence that defines SVA correctness. Additionally, closed-source commercial equivalence verifiers have too high invocation cost to provide per-step feedback for reinforcement learning training.
summary_en.importance: It validates a training paradigm that combines formal verifier signals with dense distillation, using verifier outputs as filtering and weighting conditions to address the sparse reward signal problem. This provides a reusable method path for post-training optimization of code and formal language generation tasks that require semantic correctness rather than surface token matching. The open-source property equivalence checker also lowers the implementation barrier for integrating formal verification with LLM training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core method is Reward-Weighted On-Policy Distillation (RWOPD), with a three-step workflow: 1) A 7B-parameter student model with LoRA is trained via stratified curriculum SFT to cover SVA types of different temporal complexity levels. 2) Rollouts are sampled from the student model and filtered by an open-source SymbiYosys+Z3 Property-Equivalence Checker (PEC), retaining only verifier-passed outputs. 3) The retained outputs are weighted by the equivalence reward from the verifier, and the student model is updated with forward-KL gradients computed from a frozen 14B teacher model. The open-source PEC for the bounded model checking fragment is used as a training-time filter, while the closed-source commercial verifier is only used for final performance evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: On NL2SVA-Human and NL2SVA-Machine benchmarks, the 7B+LoRA RWOPD model outperforms both the prior best 14B specialized model CodeV-SVA-14B and 671B general-purpose baselines on pass@1, pass@5, and pass@10 metrics. The accuracy gain is concentrated on temporally complex classes: +7.5 percentage points for C2 (bounded temporal) and +11.5 percentage points for C3 (liveness), while the C1 (combinational) class is already saturated with no significant improvement.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Chapter 3 for analysis of the template collapse problem, Chapter 4 for RWOPD method design and implementation logic of the open-source PEC, and Chapter 5 for ablation study results. Focus on the core design idea of combining verifier signals with dense distillation. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 用形式化验证器做 reward 进行 on-policy distillation，思路类似 R1-Zero 在代码领域的应用，证明了 token-level SFT 在逻辑任务上的局限性，值得关注其 loss 设计。
recommendation.en: Uses a formal verifier as a reward for on-policy distillation, similar to R1-Zero applied to code; proves the limitations of token-level SFT on logical tasks. The loss design is worth noting.

paper.title: Combining On-Policy Optimization and Distillation for Long-Context Reasoning in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Adapting large language models (LLMs) to long-context tasks requires post-training methods that remain accurate and coherent over thousands of tokens. Existing approaches are limited in several ways: 1) off-policy methods such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and knowledge distillation (KD) suffer from exposure bias and limited recovery from model-generated errors over long horizons; 2) on-policy reinforcement learning methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) better align trainin

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是长上下文 post-training 里的一个老问题：离线监督方法稳定，但一旦模型进入自己生成的轨迹，误差会沿着很长的生成链条累积；纯 on-policy RL 又能对齐真实 rollout 分布，但奖励稀疏、方差大、训练不稳，尤其在长上下文推理里更明显。作者要解决的不是单点算法改进，而是给出一个更完整的长上下文对齐配方：怎样把 on-policy 的分布匹配能力、token 级蒸馏的稠密监督、以及 reward-driven 优化结合起来，让模型在几千到上万 token 的推理和生成中既能保持正确性，也能保持结构和连贯性。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身，它不是新基座架构或新预训练目标，但对 pretrain↔post-train 接口有直接价值。原因有两点。第一，长上下文能力并不只由 RoPE 外推或继续预训练决定，后训练阶段是否在模型自己的长轨迹上学习，影响很大。第二，这篇工作把“稀疏奖励 RL”和“稠密 teacher guidance”放到同一个 on-policy 框架里，给出了一个比单独 GRPO 或单独蒸馏更实用的折中。这个思路对 reasoning model、continual post-train、甚至后续 mid-training 都有参考意义：如果训练目标需要覆盖长 horizon，单靠离线 imitation 往往不够，单靠 RL 又太贵且不稳，混合信号可能是更现实的路线。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 dGRPO，名字上看是把 GRPO 和 on-policy distillation 叠加，真正关键在于三件事如何配合。第一，训练数据不是固定 teacher traces，而是当前 student policy 在长上下文任务上的 on-policy rollout，因此训练分布与推理分布一致，能减轻 exposure bias。第二，在这些 rollout 上同时施加两类学习信号：一类是 GRPO 风格的组相对优势信号，用于直接优化任务奖励；另一类是 token-level 的 teacher distillation，用 teacher 在相同 prefix 下的分布给出稠密监督，帮助模型在长轨迹中维持局部决策质量。第三，作者在实现上去掉了常见 RLHF 里的 reference KL，设 β_ref=0，不再显式约束到初始策略，理由是 reasoning/long-context 场景下策略自然偏离初始模型未必有害，而且省显存和算力。

从方法定位看，SFT/KD 是 off-policy + dense signal，但没有 reward objective；GRPO 是 on-policy + reward objective，但 token 级监督稀疏；OPD 是 on-policy + dense signal，但不能直接优化任意 reward。dGRPO 试图同时拿到这三者的优点。文中还配套提出 LONG-BLOCKS 合成数据集，覆盖 multi-hop reasoning、contextual grounding、long-form generation，作用不是单纯扩充样本量，而是给长上下文 on-policy 对齐提供更丰富的任务分布。若从训练机制理解，dGRPO 的价值主要在 credit assignment：reward 负责全局方向，distillation 负责局部稳定，两者都发生在模型自己采样到的状态上，因此比离线 KD 更贴近真实误差传播链条。
summary.experiments:
从全文可见，作者做的重点不是追求单一 benchmark 的高分，而是系统比较几种长上下文后训练策略：SFT/KD、OPD、GRPO、dGRPO。实验结论很明确：单独的离线方法在短程结构学习上有效，但随着上下文和输出长度增加，恢复模型自生成错误的能力不足；单独 GRPO 能提升 reward 对齐，但训练波动更大，样本效率更差；dGRPO 在长上下文任务上更稳定，且通常能同时保住短上下文能力。文中反复强调“preserving short-context capabilities of the starting model”，说明他们把能力保持当作主要评估维度之一，而不是只看长上下文分数。

就可见内容而言，论文给出了方法比较表、训练 recipe 图，以及 LONG-BLOCKS 数据构成，但你提供的全文片段没有包含完整结果表、参数规模、训练 token 数、具体 benchmark 分数和提升幅度，因此没法负责任地填入精确数字。可以确认的是：实验设计围绕 Qwen3-based setup 展开，且比较对象覆盖 off-policy、on-policy RL、on-policy distillation 以及混合方法。若后续拿到完整附录，最该核对的是三类数字：一是不同 context length 下的性能曲线；二是训练稳定性指标，如 reward variance、loss/advantage 波动；三是短上下文通用能力是否出现回退，以及回退幅度。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Table 1 和方法总览图，先把四类训练范式的差别吃透：采样分布、学习信号稠密度、是否直接优化 reward、是否缓解 exposure bias。然后重点看方法章节里 dGRPO 的目标函数定义，确认蒸馏项和 GRPO 项是如何加权、在什么 rollout 上计算、teacher 是否只提供 logits 还是还参与筛选。接着看实验部分的主表和训练曲线，尤其关注三件事：长上下文收益是否随长度增加而扩大；dGRPO 相比纯 GRPO 的稳定性改善是否显著；短上下文能力保持是否真实而非口头描述。

如果时间有限，预计 25–35 分钟可以抓住主线。若要深挖，建议额外看 LONG-BLOCKS 的数据生成细节，因为这会影响你对方法收益来源的判断：提升到底来自更好的算法，还是来自更合适的长上下文训练任务分布。另外，作者把 β_ref 设为 0，这个决定值得单独审视，尤其要看是否在某些任务上带来风格漂移或安全性退化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a practical bottleneck in long-context post-training: off-policy methods such as SFT and KD are stable and dense, but they train on teacher trajectories rather than the model’s own long rollouts, so exposure bias compounds over long horizons; pure on-policy RL methods better match inference-time states, but become noisy, sparse, and sample-inefficient when rewards arrive late. The paper asks a recipe-level question rather than a narrow algorithmic one: how to combine on-policy learning, dense token supervision, and reward optimization so that an LLM can reason coherently over very long contexts without sacrificing its existing short-context behavior.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it matters for the pretrain-to-post-train interface. Long-context capability is not determined only by positional extrapolation or continued pretraining; the distribution on which the model is aligned after pretraining also matters. The paper is useful because it treats long-horizon alignment as a signal-design problem: sparse reward gives global direction, dense teacher guidance stabilizes local token decisions, and on-policy sampling makes both signals land on the states the model will actually visit. That framing is relevant to reasoning models, continual post-training, and possibly mid-training recipes where long-horizon behavior is a target.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The proposed method, dGRPO, combines Group Relative Policy Optimization with on-policy distillation. The key idea is not merely adding two losses together, but aligning them on the same on-policy trajectories. First, the student samples its own long-context rollouts, so training happens on the model-induced state distribution rather than on fixed expert traces. Second, each rollout receives two learning signals: a GRPO-style relative reward signal for direct task optimization, and a token-level teacher distillation signal that provides dense next-token guidance under the same prefixes. Third, the implementation removes the usual reference-policy KL term by setting beta_ref to zero, following recent reasoning-model practice, which reduces memory/compute overhead and allows the policy to move farther from initialization when that helps reasoning.

The paper positions the method against three alternatives. SFT/KD gives dense supervision but is off-policy and does not optimize arbitrary rewards. GRPO is on-policy and reward-driven but sparse. On-policy distillation is on-policy and dense but not reward-optimizing. dGRPO is meant to inherit all three desirable properties at once: on-policy sampling, dense token guidance, and direct reward optimization. The accompanying LONG-BLOCKS synthetic dataset is also part of the recipe. It covers multi-hop reasoning, contextual grounding, and long-form generation, so the method is evaluated and trained on a broader long-context task mix rather than a narrow retrieval-style setup.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental contribution is mainly comparative and recipe-oriented. The paper contrasts SFT/KD, OPD, GRPO, and dGRPO in a Qwen3-based setup for long-context reasoning. The qualitative conclusion is consistent throughout the text: off-policy methods help with structure and imitation but struggle to recover from self-generated errors over long horizons; pure GRPO can improve reward alignment but is less stable and less sample-efficient; dGRPO improves long-context performance more consistently while better preserving the base model’s short-context capability.

However, the provided full-text excerpt does not include the complete result tables, appendix numbers, model sizes, token budgets, or exact benchmark gains. So it would be unsafe to invent precise figures. What should be checked in the full paper is clear: performance as a function of context length, stability metrics during training, and retention of short-context general abilities after long-context alignment. Those three axes determine whether the gains come from a genuinely better training signal or simply from task/data specialization.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with Table 1 and the overview figure. They clarify the design space better than the prose: trajectory source, signal density, reward optimization, and exposure-bias behavior. Then read the method section closely to see how the GRPO term and the distillation term are combined, how trajectories are sampled, and what exactly the teacher provides. After that, go straight to the main comparison tables and training curves. The most important questions are: does the advantage of dGRPO grow with longer contexts, does it materially stabilize training relative to pure GRPO, and does short-context performance remain intact rather than merely degrade less.

For a quick pass, 25 to 35 minutes should be enough. For a deeper read, inspect the LONG-BLOCKS construction details and the decision to set beta_ref to zero. Those two choices are likely to explain a large fraction of the observed behavior.

recommendation.zh: Cohere提出的dGRPO结合RL和蒸馏提升长上下文能力，可参考其数据合成逻辑优化内部长上下文后训练流程
recommendation.en: dGRPO proposed by Cohere combines RL and distillation for long context improvement, reference its data synthesis logic to optimize internal long context post-training pipeline

paper.title: The Many Faces of On-Policy Distillation: Pitfalls, Mechanisms, and Fixes
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) and on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) have emerged as promising post-training methods for large language models, offering dense token-level supervision on trajectories sampled from the model's own policy. However, existing results on their effectiveness remain mixed: while OP(S)D has shown promise in system prompt and knowledge internalization, recent studies also report instability and degradation. In this work, we present a comprehensive empirical study of when OP

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM后训练中使用的on-policy蒸馏（OPD）和on-policy自蒸馏（OPSD）效果存在明显场景差异，部分场景下不稳定甚至导致性能退化，目前缺乏对其生效/失效机制的系统分析，也没有针对性的稳定化方案。
summary.importance: 明确了OP(S)D这类后训练蒸馏方法的适用边界，其失效机制分析可以指导预训练与后训练的衔接设计，提出的稳定化方案可以降低后训练阶段的性能退化风险，为规模化蒸馏流水线提供可落地的优化方向，避免盲目套用OP(S)D带来的训练不稳定问题。
summary.technical_approach: 首先系统梳理了OP(S)D的完整设计空间，覆盖教师构造（自蒸馏/冻结教师/EMA教师）、特权信息（PI）类型（无/仅答案/完整回复/系统提示）、蒸馏损失设计（全词表KL/采样token策略梯度/Top-K反向KL/停止梯度Top-K）三类维度。随后识别出三个核心失效机制：1）学生生成的前缀会将教师带入局部状态，使其token级监督信号与学生轨迹不兼容；2）Top-K反向KL的近似计算会引入有偏梯度，破坏优化稳定性；3）OPSD只能学到跨实例的无PI共识策略，当PI为实例特定信息（如数学题的标准答案）时无法生效。最后提出三个针对性稳定化方案：带停止梯度的Top-K KL代理损失以消除有偏梯度、用可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）适配教师以提升任务对齐度、对学生做SFT以规范输出格式并稳定回复长度。
summary.experiments: 在数学推理、系统提示内化、对齐三类任务上完成对比验证：1）数学推理任务中，OPD效果高度依赖教师选择和损失形式，容易出现长度爆炸、内容重复、师生监督错位问题，OPSD在测试的所有数学推理设置下完全失效；2）系统提示内化和对齐任务中，OPSD表现稳定有效，因为这类场景下PI诱导的是共享的潜在行为，可以压缩为测试时无PI的通用策略；3）提出的三类稳定化方案可分别缓解对应失效机制，显著降低OPD在推理任务上的不稳定性和性能退化概率。
summary.reading_guide: 先阅读第1节的图1，快速把握OP(S)D的设计空间、失效场景和修复方案的整体框架；再重点读第3节的三个失效机制的具体分析；最后扫一眼稳定化方案的核心效果结论。不需要精读损失函数的公式推导细节，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。
summary.authors_note: 包含UIUC研究人员，其中一位作者为UIUC实习期间完成该工作，其余作者背景未披露。

summary_en.core_problem: On-policy distillation (OPD) and on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) used in LLM post-training show significant scenario-dependent performance, with instability and even performance degradation in some settings. There is no systematic analysis of their working/failure mechanisms, nor targeted stabilization solutions.
summary_en.importance: Clarifies the applicable boundaries of OP(S)D post-training distillation methods. Its failure mechanism analysis can guide the interface design between pretraining and post-training, and the proposed stabilizers reduce the risk of performance degradation in post-training stages, providing implementable optimization directions for large-scale distillation pipelines to avoid training instability caused by blind application of OP(S)D.
summary_en.technical_approach: First maps the full OP(S)D design space across three dimensions: teacher construction (self-distillation / frozen teacher / EMA teacher), privileged information (PI) types (none / answer only / full response / system prompt), and distillation loss design (full-vocab KL / sampled-token policy gradient / Top-K reverse KL / stop-gradient Top-K). Then identifies three core failure mechanisms: 1) student-generated prefixes push the teacher into local states where its token-level supervision is incompatible with the student trajectory; 2) Top-K reverse KL approximation introduces biased gradients that destabilize optimization; 3) OPSD only learns a single PI-free consensus policy across instances, which fails when PI is instance-specific (e.g., ground-truth answers for math problems). Finally proposes three targeted stabilizers: stop-gradient Top-K KL surrogate to eliminate biased gradients, RL with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) adapted teachers to improve task alignment, and student SFT to standardize output format and stabilize response length.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across three task categories: mathematical reasoning, system prompt internalization, and alignment. 1) On math reasoning, OPD performance is highly sensitive to teacher selection and loss formulation, prone to length explosion, repetition, and teacher-student supervision mismatch, while OPSD fails completely in all tested math reasoning settings. 2) On system prompt internalization and alignment, OPSD works stably as PI induces shared latent behavior that can be compressed into a general PI-free policy for test time. 3) The three proposed stabilizers mitigate corresponding failure modes and significantly reduce OPD instability and performance degradation on reasoning tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with Figure 1 in Section 1 for a high-level overview of OP(S)D design space, failure scenarios and fixes. Then focus on the detailed analysis of three failure mechanisms in Section 3, and finally scan the core effect conclusions of the stabilizers. No need to dive into detailed formula derivations of loss functions, estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Affiliated with UIUC; one author completed the work during an internship at UIUC, other author backgrounds are not disclosed.

recommendation.zh: 只看机制实验和修复部分即可；它提醒 OPD 不是免费午餐，PI 的训练-测试可见性比 loss 名字更关键。
recommendation.en: Read the mechanism and fix sections; the useful prior update is that OPD is not free, and PI visibility across train/test matters more than the loss label.

paper.title: Learning to Foresee: Unveiling the Unlocking Efficiency of On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as an efficient post-training paradigm for large language models. However, existing studies largely attribute this advantage to denser and more stable supervision, while the parameter-level mechanisms underlying OPD's efficiency remain poorly understood. In this work, we argue that OPD's efficiency stems from a form of ``foresight'': it establishes a stable update trajectory toward the final model early in training. This foresight manifests in two aspects

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“OPD 比 RL 更稳”这种现象层问题，而是更细一层：为什么 on-policy distillation 在参数更新层面能更快到达有效解，且这种效率差异具体体现在哪些模块、哪些更新方向上。作者把问题拆成两部分。第一，模块分配问题：同样大小的参数更新，为什么 OPD 带来的推理能力增益更高。第二，方向演化问题：为什么 OPD 在训练早期就能沿着接近最终解的方向前进，而 RL 往往需要更长的探索和修正。论文给出的中心结论是，OPD 的效率来自一种可观测的“foresight”：它会更早识别低边际收益模块，避免把更新浪费在功能冗余区域；同时它的更新更早收缩到少数稳定主方向，并且这些主方向与最终解的主子空间高度对齐。
summary.importance: 它的价值主要不在于提出一个全新的 post-train 框架，而在于把“蒸馏更容易优化”这件事从经验判断推进到参数动力学解释。对预训练研究员来说，这有三层启发。第一，训练效率不只是监督更密、更低方差，还和更新是否尽早进入正确子空间有关，这和预训练里常见的 low-rank update、module specialization、mid-layer importance 等现象是连着的。第二，论文把 RL 与 OPD 的差异落到模块边际效用和谱结构上，这为分析 SFT、RL、distillation、continual pretrain 之间的训练轨迹差异提供了可复用工具。第三，作者基于这个观察提出 EffOPD，用简单线性外推就能加速，说明如果一个训练范式早期方向已经足够稳定，那么后续很多算力可能只是沿既定方向缓慢推进。这对 cooldown、annealing、early stopping、trajectory extrapolation 都有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach:
方法部分分成“解释”与“利用”两层。解释层面，作者先统一起点，用同一个 base model 分别做 RL 和 OPD，把最终参数差写成 ΔW。随后做了几类分析。其一是 norm-controlled scaling：固定最终更新方向，只缩放更新幅度 α，比较在相同更新范数下的性能曲线。结果显示 OPD 在同等 norm 下带来的推理增益更高，说明 RL 的 ΔW 中包含更多与任务弱相关的分量。其二是模块边际效用分析：按层、按模块统计 sensitivity 与 update norm，观察哪些区域“改得多但收益小”。作者发现 RL 与 OPD 对重要模块的敏感性排序并不完全不同，但 RL 会在低效模块上累计更大更新，尤其是一些对最终推理收益贡献有限的区域；OPD 则更早压低这些区域的更新，把预算集中到中间层等更关键模块。论文把这类现象称为 Functional Redundancy Avoidance。其三是更新方向的谱分析与子空间演化分析：对 checkpoint 间的更新矩阵做奇异值分解，考察能量是否集中在少数主方向，以及这些主方向与最终 checkpoint 更新子空间的夹角或对齐度。作者观察到 OPD 的更新更早呈现低秩集中，主子空间更稳定，且与最终解更早对齐；RL 的谱更分散，对齐更晚且波动更大。其四是早期 checkpoint 可恢复性实验：对早期 OPD checkpoint 做 module-wise norm scaling，发现只用约 10% 训练进度的方向信息，就能恢复约 80% 的最终推理性能。这是“早期已锁定主结构”的关键证据。

在利用层面，作者提出 EffOPD。核心做法很直接：既然 OPD 的当前更新方向在早期就与最终方向高度一致，那么可以沿当前方向做线性外推，减少实际训练步数与样本数。它不是加新模块，也不是改 loss，而是一个 plug-and-play 的训练加速策略。论文强调它与现有加速手段正交，意味着可以叠加在已有 OPD pipeline 上。这里真正值得注意的不是线性外推本身，而是它成立的前提：训练轨迹必须足够稳定、方向漂移足够小。作者用前面的谱与子空间分析为这个前提提供了证据。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 1.5B 到 32B 参数规模，包含 pretrained、SFT-tuned 和 thinking 系列模型；RL baseline 包括 PPO、GRPO、DAPO，OPD 则使用 pattern-aligned teacher，通常来自同家族更强模型。关键结果有四类。第一，在最终 checkpoint 上做方向固定、幅度缩放时，OPD 在相同 update norm 下取得明显更高的 reasoning gain，支持“不是更新更大，而是更新更有效”。第二，模块分析显示 RL 在低边际收益模块上累积了更多冗余更新，而 OPD 更集中于中间层等对推理更关键的区域。第三，谱分析显示 OPD 的更新具有更强 low-rank concentration，主子空间更早与最终解对齐；RL 的更新方向更分散，后期还在持续修正。第四，EffOPD 在 1.5B–32B 多个设置上平均带来约 3× 训练加速，同时保持与 vanilla OPD 可比的最终性能。摘要和引言里还给出一个很关键的数字：对 OPD 而言，只用约 10% 训练进度的 checkpoint，经 module-wise norm scaling 后即可恢复约 80% 的最终 reasoning performance。这说明早期方向信息的含金量很高。

如果精读正文，建议特别留意作者是否报告了不同任务、不同 teacher-student gap、不同 RL 算法下子空间对齐曲线的一致性，以及 EffOPD 对超参的敏感性。因为这决定了“foresight”究竟是 OPD 的普遍属性，还是只在 pattern-aligned、同家族蒸馏里最明显。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合带着问题读，而不是顺着叙述读。先看 Figure 2 对应的 norm-controlled scaling 实验，确认作者要证明的不是“OPD 更新更小”而是“同样的更新量更有效”。再看 Functional Redundancy Avoidance 那一节，重点看层/模块粒度的 sensitivity 与 update norm 是否真的解耦，以及哪些模块被判定为低边际收益。然后看谱分析和子空间演化图，关注两个问题：一是 OPD 的低秩集中是否在训练很早就出现；二是“与最终解对齐”是用什么度量定义的。最后看 EffOPD，判断它到底是稳定可复现的工程技巧，还是高度依赖特定训练曲线形状。

如果只有 20 分钟，建议看 Introduction、Figure 2、谱分析主图、EffOPD 主结果表。若有 1 小时，值得把附录里不同模型规模和不同 RL baseline 的一致性结果也看掉，因为这决定结论能否外推到更广的 post-train 设置。对做预训练的人，最值得深挖的点不是 OPD 本身，而是“早期主子空间锁定”是否也出现在大规模 pretrain、mid-train domain shift、SFT 冷启动这些场景里。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a more specific question than the usual claim that OPD is simply easier to optimize than RL. It tries to identify the parameter-level mechanism behind that efficiency gap. Why does on-policy distillation reach a useful solution faster, and where exactly does the difference appear in the update trajectory? The authors decompose this into two issues. First, module allocation: under the same update budget, why does OPD convert parameter movement into reasoning gains more efficiently? Second, update direction: why does OPD move toward a final useful solution much earlier, while RL spends more time exploring and correcting? Their answer is a notion of “foresight.” OPD suppresses updates in low-marginal-utility regions early, and its updates collapse early onto a small set of stable dominant directions that are already well aligned with the final solution subspace.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is explanatory rather than purely algorithmic. It turns the vague intuition that distillation benefits from denser supervision into a concrete statement about update geometry. For pretraining researchers, this matters for three reasons. First, training efficiency is not only about lower-variance supervision; it is also about entering the right update subspace early. That connects directly to observations in pretraining around low-rank adaptation, module specialization, and the importance of middle layers. Second, the paper offers a reusable analysis lens for comparing RL, distillation, SFT, and continual pretraining through module utility and spectral structure. Third, the proposed EffOPD result suggests that once a training paradigm locks onto a stable direction early, a nontrivial fraction of later compute may just be slow progress along an already identified path. That has implications for cooldown schedules, early stopping, trajectory extrapolation, and compute allocation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work has two layers: explanation and exploitation. On the explanation side, the authors start from a shared base model and compare RL and OPD through their parameter deltas, ΔW. They then run several analyses. First is norm-controlled scaling: keep the final update direction fixed and scale only its magnitude by a factor α, then evaluate models of the form W_base + αΔW. OPD delivers larger reasoning gains than RL at the same update norm, which implies that RL contains more task-weak components in its update. Second is module-level marginal utility analysis: they inspect sensitivity and accumulated update norm across layers and modules, asking where the model changes a lot without corresponding performance benefit. Their finding is not that RL and OPD care about completely different modules, but that RL spends much more update budget on low-utility regions, whereas OPD suppresses those regions early and concentrates on more reasoning-critical modules, especially in middle layers. They call this Functional Redundancy Avoidance. Third is spectral and subspace evolution analysis: they study singular value concentration of updates across checkpoints and measure alignment between early dominant subspaces and the final update subspace. OPD shows stronger low-rank concentration, earlier stabilization, and much earlier alignment with the final solution. RL remains more diffuse and keeps rotating its update directions later into training. Fourth is early-checkpoint recoverability: after module-wise norm scaling, an OPD checkpoint at roughly 10% of training recovers about 80% of the final reasoning performance. This is a strong empirical sign that the main structure of the final solution is already present very early.

On the exploitation side, they propose EffOPD. The idea is simple: if OPD directions are already close to the final direction early in training, then one can linearly extrapolate along the current update direction and reduce the number of optimization steps and samples. This is not a new architecture or loss; it is a plug-and-play acceleration strategy built on the observed trajectory stability. The important point is not linear extrapolation by itself, but the condition under which it works: the training path must be directionally stable enough. The earlier spectral analysis is used to justify that condition.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments span models from 1.5B to 32B parameters, including pretrained, SFT-tuned, and thinking-style models. RL baselines include PPO, GRPO, and DAPO. OPD uses pattern-aligned teachers, typically stronger models from the same family. The main empirical results are fourfold. First, under fixed update direction and matched update norm, OPD yields substantially larger reasoning gains than RL, supporting the claim that OPD updates are more task-relevant rather than merely smaller or larger. Second, module-level analysis shows that RL accumulates more redundant updates in low-marginal-utility modules, while OPD concentrates more on modules that matter for reasoning. Third, spectral analysis shows stronger low-rank concentration and earlier final-subspace alignment for OPD; RL updates are more dispersed and continue to drift later in training. Fourth, EffOPD delivers about 3× average training acceleration across multiple settings from 1.5B to 32B while maintaining final performance comparable to vanilla OPD. One especially important number appears early in the paper: an OPD checkpoint at only around 10% of training can recover roughly 80% of final reasoning performance after module-wise norm scaling. That is the clearest quantitative evidence for early directional lock-in.

When reading the full paper, it is worth checking how robust these findings are across tasks, teacher-student gaps, and RL variants. That determines whether “foresight” is a broad property of OPD or mainly a feature of same-family, pattern-aligned distillation.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this one by following the claims, not the paper order. Start with the norm-controlled scaling result around Figure 2. That establishes the key point: OPD is not just moving parameters differently in size; it is using the same update budget more effectively. Then read the Functional Redundancy Avoidance section and inspect whether sensitivity and update norm really decouple at the module level, and which modules are identified as low utility. Next, read the spectral and subspace evolution analysis. Focus on two questions: how early does low-rank concentration emerge, and how exactly is alignment with the final solution measured? Finish with EffOPD and judge whether it is a robust engineering trick or something that depends strongly on a particular trajectory shape.

If time is limited to 20 minutes, read the introduction, the main scaling figure, the spectral plots, and the main EffOPD table. If you have an hour, the appendix is worth reading for consistency across scales and RL baselines. For a pretraining audience, the most interesting follow-up question is not OPD itself, but whether early dominant-subspace lock-in also appears in large-scale pretraining, mid-training domain shifts, or SFT warm-start regimes.

recommendation.zh: 读 §更新子空间分析即可；如果早期子空间对齐稳定，这个诊断可迁移到 SFT/RL 的训练预算裁剪。
recommendation.en: Read the update-subspace analysis; if early alignment is stable, the diagnostic is reusable for pruning SFT/RL training budgets.

paper.title: SimCT: Recovering Lost Supervision for Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a standard tool for transferring teacher behavior to a smaller student, but it implicitly assumes that teacher and student predictions are comparable token by token, an assumption that fails whenever the two models tokenize the same text differently. Under heterogeneous tokenizers, exact shared-token matching silently discards a large fraction of the teacher signal at precisely the positions where vocabularies disagree. We propose \textbf{\underline{Sim}ple \under

summary.core_problem: 解决异构 tokenizer 下 on-policy distillation 无法逐 token 对齐、从而丢失大量教师监督信号的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个很实际的训练接口问题。它不改变蒸馏目标本身，而是修正“监督该落在哪个单位上”这一前提，属于后训练/蒸馏流程中的方法改进；对跨 tokenizer 蒸馏、小模型继承大模型行为、以及 tokenizer 迁移都有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SimCT（Simple Cross-Tokenizer OPD）。核心做法不是重写 OPD loss，而是把 teacher-student 的比较单位从“共享 token”扩展到“双方 tokenizer 都能表达的最细短文本 continuation”。也就是说，除了完全共享的 token 外，还允许在短多 token 片段上比较两边对同一文本单元的概率，从而恢复原先因分词不一致而被静默丢弃的监督。论文进一步主张，这类 jointly tokenizable 的最小单元是跨 tokenizer 监督的最细接口；如果再做得更粗，会抹平 teacher 与 student 在局部决策上的差异，削弱 on-policy 学习信号。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示作者在三个异构 tokenizer 设置上做了实验，比较 SimCT 与传统只在共享 token 上做 OPD 的方法，并分析不同监督单元粒度的效果。核心结论是：在 tokenizer 不一致时，传统 OPD 会丢掉相当比例的监督，而 SimCT 能稳定恢复这部分信号并带来更好的蒸馏效果。当前可见信息未给出具体模型规模、数据量和提升幅度；从分享者解读看，方法实现较简单，当前更像是“单词/短片段级 KL”接口修正，而不是全词表分布蒸馏。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the loss of teacher supervision in on-policy distillation when teacher and student use different tokenizers and token-level alignment breaks down.
summary_en.importance: This is a practical training-interface problem rather than a new objective. The contribution is to fix where supervision should be applied under tokenizer mismatch, which matters for distillation, tokenizer migration, and transferring behavior from larger models to smaller ones.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes SimCT (Simple Cross-Tokenizer OPD). Instead of changing the OPD loss itself, it enlarges the supervision space from exact shared tokens to the finest short continuations that both tokenizers can realize. In other words, teacher and student are compared not only on identical tokens but also on short multi-token text units that correspond to the same underlying string. The paper argues that these jointly tokenizable minimal units are the finest valid supervision interface; coarser units erase useful teacher-student distinctions needed for on-policy learning.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the method is evaluated on three heterogeneous-tokenizer settings against standard OPD that only uses shared-token supervision, with additional analysis on supervision granularity. The main result is that standard OPD silently drops a substantial amount of signal under tokenizer mismatch, while SimCT recovers that signal and improves distillation quality. The visible metadata does not provide exact model sizes, data scale, or gains; based on the shared commentary, the implementation appears simple and closer to word/short-span KL matching than full-vocabulary distribution distillation.

recommendation.zh: 这是个很干净的接口层修补：不改 loss 先把 supervision 对齐做对；若你做跨 tokenizer 蒸馏，先读方法和消融，但别急着高估，内部 credit assignment 还没解决。
recommendation.en: A clean interface fix: get supervision alignment right before inventing new losses; worth reading if you do cross-tokenizer distillation, but do not over-credit it—the intra-span credit assignment problem is still open.

commentary.article_title: 腾讯hy：不同Tokenizer做OPD 这篇工作关注一个很实际但容易被忽略的问题：老师模型和学生模型使用不同 toke
commentary.article_excerpt: asf2013 关注 腾讯hy：不同Tokenizer做OPD 这篇工作关注一个很实际但容易被忽略的问题：老师模型和学生模型使用不同 tokenizer 时，传统 on-policy distillation 其实会丢掉大量监督信号。SimCT 的核心思路是：不改 OPD 的训练目标，而是重新设计 teacher 和 student 可以共同比较的监督空间。 它的做法很简单：不改 OPD loss，而是把监督空间从“共享 token”扩展到“双方 tokenizer 都能表达的最小文本单元”。比如 teacher 把 happy 切成 hap + py，student 切成 ha + pp + y，SimCT 就把完整的 happy 当作共同监督单元来比较。 感觉一些继续做的空间： 1.如果tokenizer异构的比较大，做一个最小文本单元内部的信用分配是否必要？或者会不会出现一个词的几个token abcd,教师模型概率上a很低但是bcd很高，但是学生模型是a很高，bcd很低，一中和监督信号没了的情况？ 2.这种方式目前是单个词KL，目前的主流趋势是全词表KL稳定性往往优于单词KL，结合之前的工作（基于token距离做loss不要求完全匹配）感觉可以往全词表KL方法上靠一靠。 #科研学习 昨天 15:19

paper.title: SimCT: Recovering Lost Supervision for Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a standard tool for transferring teacher behavior to a smaller student, but it implicitly assumes that teacher and student predictions are comparable token by token, an assumption that fails whenever the two models tokenize the same text differently. Under heterogeneous tokenizers, exact shared-token matching silently discards a large fraction of the teacher signal at precisely the positions where vocabularies disagree. We propose \textbf{\underline{Sim}ple \under

summary.core_problem: 现有同策略蒸馏（OPD）默认师生模型使用相同分词器，当二者分词器异构时，仅匹配共现token的监督方式会丢失大量教师模型的监督信号；现有跨分词器OPD方法要么引入额外计算开销、额外训练参数，要么降低监督粒度，造成性能损失。
summary.importance: 验证了仅通过扩展监督空间即可低成本恢复跨分词器蒸馏丢失的信号，不需要复杂的对齐模块，为不同模型家族之间的知识蒸馏、大模型轻量化部署提供了更简洁的方案，也为持续预训练中的跨模型知识迁移提供参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SimCT方法，不修改OPD原有的反向KL损失函数，仅扩展监督空间：除了师生分词器的共享token外，加入两个分词器都能表示的最短多token连续文本作为最小对齐单元，在这个统一空间上计算常规OPD损失；不需要额外参数、学习投影或最优传输计算，监督空间直接基于两个现有分词器构造。
summary.experiments: 在数学推理、代码生成基准上测试3个不同模型家族，相比SFT平均相对提升6.0%，稳定优于代表性跨分词器OPD基线；消融实验显示增加分词器不匹配文本的监督占比可提升性能，粗化最小对齐单元会丢失KL监督信号，降低下游任务收益。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读Introduction的跨分词器OPD问题分析部分、Methodology的最小对齐单元构造逻辑，以及实验的消融分析部分，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing on-policy distillation (OPD) for LLMs assumes identical tokenizers between teacher and student models. Under heterogeneous tokenizers, matching only shared tokens discards most teacher supervision signals, and existing cross-tokenizer OPD methods incur extra computation, additional trainable parameters, or coarser supervision granularity, leading to performance loss.
summary_en.importance: Demonstrates that supervision space expansion can recover lost cross-tokenizer distillation signals without complex alignment modules, providing a low-cost solution for knowledge distillation across different model families and lightweight LLM deployment, also offering reference for cross-model knowledge transfer in continual pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes SimCT, which keeps the standard reverse-KL OPD loss unchanged, expands the supervision space to include both shared tokens and minimal aligned units, which are the shortest multi-token continuations representable by both tokenizers. No additional parameters, learned projections or optimal transport computation are required, as the supervision space is constructed directly from the two existing tokenizers.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks across 3 model families. Achieves 6.0% average relative gain over SFT, outperforms representative cross-tokenizer OPD baselines consistently. Ablations show that increasing recovered supervision from tokenizer-mismatched text improves performance, while coarsening minimal aligned units reduces downstream gains.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the problem analysis in Introduction, the construction logic of minimal aligned units in Methodology, and ablation studies in Experiments. Expected reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 做跨tokenizer蒸馏的团队可直接复现该方法，异构模型迁移适配场景实用性强
recommendation.en: Teams working on cross-tokenizer distillation can directly reproduce this method, which has strong practicability in heterogeneous model migration scenarios

paper.title: Flow-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Flow Matching Models
paper.abstract: Existing Flow Matching (FM) text-to-image models suffer from two critical bottlenecks under multi-task alignment: the reward sparsity induced by scalar-valued rewards, and the gradient interference arising from jointly optimizing heterogeneous objectives, which together give rise to a 'seesaw effect' of competing metrics and pervasive reward hacking. Inspired by the success of On-Policy Distillation (OPD) in the large language model community, we propose Flow-OPD, the first unified post-training

summary.core_problem: 现有流匹配（FM）文生图模型在多任务对齐时存在标量奖励稀疏、多目标优化梯度干扰问题，导致性能跷跷板效应与普遍的奖励黑客
summary.importance: 范式迁移创新，首次将LLM领域的On-Policy Distillation（OPD）引入流匹配模型的后训练，提出统一的多任务对齐框架
summary.technical_approach: 提出Flow-OPD两阶段对齐策略：第一阶段通过单奖励GRPO微调训练多个领域专用教师模型，第二阶段经流冷启动、on-policy采样、任务路由三步编排整合异构专家知识到单个学生模型
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露完整实验设置与量化结果，仅说明方法可缓解流匹配多任务对齐的跷跷板效应与奖励黑客问题
summary.authors_note: 中国科学技术大学、加州大学、香港中文大学、小红书联合团队，无公开知名业界研究者背景

summary_en.core_problem: Existing Flow Matching (FM) text-to-image models suffer from scalar reward sparsity and gradient interference in multi-objective optimization during multi-task alignment, leading to performance seesaw effects and pervasive reward hacking
summary_en.importance: Paradigm migration innovation, first introduces On-Policy Distillation (OPD) from LLM field to post-training of Flow Matching models, and proposes a unified multi-task alignment framework
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Flow-OPD two-stage alignment strategy: first stage trains multiple domain-specialized teacher models via single-reward GRPO fine-tuning; second stage consolidates heterogeneous expertise into one student via three-step orchestration including flow cold start, on-policy sampling and task routing
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental setup and quantitative results are not disclosed in the abstract, only stated that the method alleviates seesaw effect and reward hacking in Flow Matching multi-task alignment
summary_en.authors_note: Joint team from USTC, UC, CUHK, Xiaohongshu Inc, no well-known industry researchers publicly identified

recommendation.zh: 做多模态生成对齐或流匹配训练的可参考其多专家OPD编排思路，纯文本预训练研究员仅需知晓该迁移方向
recommendation.en: Researchers working on multimodal generative alignment or Flow Matching can reference its multi-expert OPD orchestration; pure text LLM pretrain researchers only need awareness of this direction

paper.title: KL for a KL: On-Policy Distillation with Control Variate Baseline
paper.abstract: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) has emerged as a dominant post-training paradigm for large language models, especially for reasoning domains. However, OPD remains unstable in practice due to the high gradient variance of its single-sample Monte Carlo estimator, and recipes for stable training are still immature. We propose vOPD (On-Policy Distillation with a control variate baseline), which casts OPD as policy-gradient RL and stabilizes it by introducing a control variate baseline-canonically a val

summary.core_problem: On-Policy Distillation（OPD，同策略蒸馏）是当前推理类LLM训练的主流后训练范式，通过学生模型对教师模型的token级反向KL散度对齐实现快速收敛，已被通义千问3、GLM-5等工业级模型采用；但现有基于单样本蒙特卡洛估计的OPD存在梯度方差大、训练不稳定的问题，当前的稳定方案要么需要全词汇表KL计算带来50%以上的额外算力开销，要么采用top-k截断KL导致梯度有偏，无法同时兼顾效率、无偏性与训练稳定性。
summary.importance: 首次将策略梯度RL中的控制变量基线方法系统引入OPD范式，从理论上证明了OPD的值函数存在闭式解，无需额外 critic 模型或推理即可直接获取，解决了OPD训练稳定性的核心痛点；该方法与现有RLVR、GRPO、RLOO等后训练范式完全兼容，可直接落地到工业级训练管线，为推理类LLM的高效、稳定后训练提供了标准化的低成本方案。
summary.technical_approach: vOPD将OPD形式化为策略梯度RL问题，通过减去控制变量基线来降低梯度方差且不引入期望偏差。论文证明OPD的值函数存在闭式解：每步上下文中学生与教师的token级反向KL散度的负值，该值可直接从计算OPD目标的同一次前向传播中获取，不需要额外的critic模型、额外采样或反向传播。为进一步降低基线计算开销，可仅用学生模型输出的top-k个token近似基线；由于该近似不依赖采样得到的真实token，无论k取何值都不会破坏梯度的无偏性。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3和Olmo-3两个模型族的4个不同规模模型上，覆盖数学、科学领域的6个推理基准（MATH500、Minerva Math、AMC23、AIME24/25、SciKnowEval、GPQA-Diamond）进行测试：相比基础OPD，vOPD平均绝对准确率提升最多3%，其中MATH500基准上提升最多6.2%；相比top-k OPD稳定方案，vOPD性能显著更优；相比全词汇表OPD，vOPD性能持平但训练 wall-clock 时间最多降低57.7%。消融实验显示基线计算的top-k取值对最终性能影响极小，同时vOPD训练过程中的梯度范数显著更低，对高奖励token起到了正则化作用，进一步提升了稳定性。
summary.reading_guide: 精读§3理论部分，重点关注值函数闭式解的推导过程、top-k近似基线的无偏性证明；精读§4.2和§4.4的核心结果与跨模型、跨基准的泛化性实验；§4.3的消融实验和梯度范数分析部分需要重点关注，可理解方法的稳定机制；附录中的训练超参配置、与GRPO等RL方法的对比可作为落地参考。

summary_en.core_problem: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) is the dominant post-training paradigm for reasoning-focused LLMs, which aligns the student model with the teacher via token-level reverse KL divergence and has been adopted in industrial models like Qwen3 and GLM-5. However, OPD based on single-sample Monte Carlo estimation suffers from high gradient variance and training instability. Existing stabilization solutions either require full-vocabulary KL calculation that introduces over 50% extra compute overhead, or use top-k truncated KL leading to biased gradients, failing to balance efficiency, unbiasedness and training stability at the same time.
summary_en.importance: This work systematically introduces the control variate baseline method from policy gradient RL into the OPD paradigm. It theoretically proves that the OPD value function has a closed-form solution that can be directly obtained without additional critic models or inference, solving the core pain point of OPD training instability. The method is fully compatible with existing post-training paradigms such as RLVR, GRPO and RLOO, and can be directly integrated into industrial training pipelines, providing a standardized low-cost solution for efficient and stable post-training of reasoning LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: vOPD formulates OPD as a policy gradient RL problem, and reduces gradient variance by subtracting a control variate baseline without introducing bias in expectation. The paper proves that the OPD value function has a closed-form solution: the negative per-token reverse KL divergence between the student and the teacher at each step, which can be obtained directly from the same forward pass that computes the OPD objective, without additional critic models, extra rollouts or backward passes. To further reduce baseline computation cost, the baseline can be approximated using only the top-k tokens of the student output; since this approximation does not depend on the sampled ground-truth token, it preserves gradient unbiasedness regardless of the value of k.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations are conducted on 4 models of different sizes from the Qwen3 and Olmo-3 families across 6 reasoning benchmarks covering mathematics and science: MATH500, Minerva Math, AMC23, AIME24/25, SciKnowEval, and GPQA-Diamond. Compared to base OPD, vOPD achieves up to 3% absolute average accuracy gain, with a maximum improvement of 6.2% on the MATH500 benchmark. Compared to the top-k OPD stabilization variant, vOPD delivers significantly better performance. Compared to full-vocabulary OPD, vOPD matches its performance while reducing training wall-clock time by up to 57.7%. Ablation studies show that the choice of k for baseline approximation has minimal impact on final performance, and vOPD produces significantly lower gradient norms during training, acting as a regularizer on high-reward tokens to further improve stability.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on §3 for the theoretical derivation of the closed-form value function and the unbiasedness proof of the top-k approximate baseline. Read §4.2 and §4.4 carefully for core results and generalization performance across models and benchmarks. Pay special attention to the ablation studies and gradient norm analysis in §4.3 to understand the stabilization mechanism of the method. Training hyperparameter configurations and comparisons with RL methods like GRPO in the appendix provide practical references for implementation.

recommendation.zh: 把OPD重铸为策略梯度并用控制变量基线降方差是一个干净的理论贡献——值函数有闭式解无需额外critic这点尤其巧妙，值得在推理蒸馏pipeline中评估。
recommendation.en: Recasting OPD as policy gradient with a control variate baseline is a clean theoretical contribution—the closed-form value function requiring no extra critic is particularly elegant; worth evaluating in reasoning distillation pipelines.

paper.title: SOD: Step-wise On-policy Distillation for Small Language Model Agents
paper.abstract: Tool-integrated reasoning (TIR) is difficult to scale to small language models due to instability in long-horizon tool interactions and limited model capacity. While reinforcement learning methods like group relative policy optimization provide only sparse outcome-level rewards. Recently, on-policy distillation (OPD) has gained popularity by supplying dense token-level supervision from a teacher on student-generated trajectories. However, our experiments indicate that applying OPD to TIR leads t

summary.core_problem: 将On-policy Distillation（OPD）应用于小语言模型（SLM）的工具集成推理（TIR）时，错误的工具调用会在后续推理步骤中级联放大，导致学生-教师分布快速偏离，教师的token级监督变得不可靠甚至误导，引发训练不稳定甚至崩溃。
summary.importance: 解决了SLM在TIR任务上训练不稳定的核心失效模式。首次让0.6B量级模型在AIME 2025上达到26.13%准确率，在多个benchmark上比次优基线最高提升20.86%，为小模型agent能力迁移提供了更可靠的训练范式。
summary.technical_approach: SOD在每个推理步骤上根据学生与教师的分布差异自适应调整蒸馏强度。当学生与教师对齐良好时保留密集监督，当差异较大时逐步衰减该步骤的蒸馏信号，减少分布外状态下误导性监督的影响。核心机制是per-step的自适应重加权（step-wise reweighting），在vanilla OPD基础上增加了分步门控。
summary.experiments: 在数学、科学和代码benchmark上比次优基线最高提升20.86%。0.6B学生模型在AIME 2025上达到26.13%准确率，是首个在此难度推理benchmark上达到该水平的十亿参数以下模型。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读Introduction中关于级联错误机制的分析（图1）和Method部分step-wise reweighting的具体实现，实验部分看主要结果表格。预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: When applying On-policy Distillation (OPD) to tool-integrated reasoning (TIR) in small language models (SLMs), erroneous tool calls cascade across subsequent reasoning steps, causing rapid student-teacher distribution divergence. This renders the teacher's token-level supervision unreliable or misleading, leading to training instability and even collapse.
summary_en.importance: Addresses a critical failure mode in SLM agent training. First work to demonstrate a sub-billion-parameter model (0.6B) achieving 26.13% on AIME 2025, with up to 20.86% improvement over baselines across math, science, and code benchmarks. Provides a more reliable training paradigm for transferring agent capabilities to small models.
summary_en.technical_approach: SOD adaptively adjusts distillation strength at each reasoning step based on student-teacher divergence. When the student is well-aligned with the teacher, dense supervision is preserved. When deviation becomes large, the distillation signal for that step is progressively attenuated, reducing the influence of misleading supervision under out-of-distribution states. The core mechanism is step-wise reweighting, adding per-step adaptive gating to vanilla OPD.
summary_en.experiments: SOD outperforms the second-best baseline by up to 20.86% across multiple benchmarks. The 0.6B student model achieves 26.13% accuracy on AIME 2025, the first sub-billion-parameter model to reach this level on such a challenging reasoning benchmark.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the cascade error analysis in Introduction (Figure 1) and the step-wise reweighting mechanism in Method. Scan the main results tables in Experiments. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看 failure analysis 和 step-level weighting；它不改预训练 prior，但对工具轨迹蒸馏的数据清洗很实用。
recommendation.en: Read the failure analysis and step-wise weighting; it does not change pretraining priors, but it is useful for cleaning tool-trajectory supervision.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China

paper.title: Prune-OPD: Efficient and Reliable On-Policy Distillation for Long-Horizon Reasoning
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) leverages dense teacher rewards to enhance reasoning models. However, scaling OPD to long-horizon tasks exposes a critical flaw: as the student's generated prefix inevitably diverges from the teacher's thought process, the teacher's dense reward loses local exploitability. Continuing to generate and evaluate tokens on these ``drifted'' trajectories not only degrades reward quality but also incurs massive computational waste. To address this, we introduce \textbf{Prun

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文关注长链推理中的 on-policy distillation：当 student 生成的前缀逐渐偏离 teacher 的思路后，teacher 在这些前缀上的 dense token-level reward 会变得不可靠，继续生成和打分会浪费计算，还可能引入低质量训练信号。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 reasoning post-training 很相关。OPD 处在 SFT、verifiable RL 和 teacher distillation 的交界处，近期系统把它作为降低长链推理训练成本的手段。Prune-OPD 的价值在于把“是否继续监督”从固定长度策略改成位置级可靠性判断。这个视角对预训练研究也有启发：长序列训练信号并不只是多或少的问题，还要看当前前缀下监督者的局部分布是否仍然可用。
summary.technical_approach: 基线 OPD 在 student 自己采样的轨迹上查询 teacher，并用 teacher 的 next-token distribution 给每个位置提供 dense reward，常见目标可写成 student trajectory 上的 reverse-KL 类 token-level loss。问题是 student prefix 一旦 drift，teacher 的局部分布可能仍可计算，但不再是可利用的学习目标。Prune-OPD 在每个位置比较 student 和 teacher 的候选 token 区域，主要指标是 top-k overlap ratio，也提供 teacher top-p/top-k action acceptance 作为更严格的变体。当兼容性低于阈值时，方法记录 prefix-drift event。累计 drift 会产生一个单调下降的 reliability weight，用来衰减后续位置的 OPD reward；同一个可靠性信号也用于动态控制有效 response length。它不是过滤整条样本，也不是简单截断到固定长度，而是在 token 位置上把计算和监督分配给 teacher 仍然局部可操作的区域。
summary.experiments: 作者报告在长链推理 OPD 训练中，Prune-OPD 可减少 37.6%–68.0% 的训练时间，同时保持或提升下游准确率。额外实验显示，当 student-teacher 兼容性保持较高时，控制器会保留长上下文监督，这说明它不是盲目缩短 response。论文还设计了 fixed-length pruning 对照，用来区分收益来自可靠性信号，还是仅仅来自更短的生成长度。提供的全文片段没有包含具体 benchmark 名称、模型规模、teacher/student 配置、绝对准确率和每个任务的提升幅度，引用实验结论时需要回到表格核对。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–40 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对 OPD 失败模式的定义，然后看 Background 里 token-level OPD objective 的写法，确认 reliability weight 是如何接入 loss 的。方法部分重点看 top-k overlap、top-p/top-k acceptance、prefix-drift event、monotone attenuation 和 dynamic rollout control。实验部分主要看三类对照：不开启 pruning 的 OPD、固定长度截断、基于可靠性信号的动态截断。若只关心基座研究，可重点吸收“长序列监督质量随轨迹深度变化”的诊断，而不必细读每个数学推理 benchmark。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a failure mode of on-policy distillation for long-horizon reasoning: once the student-generated prefix drifts away from the teacher’s reasoning path, the teacher’s dense token-level rewards on that prefix become less locally exploitable, while generation and teacher scoring continue to consume compute.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training paper rather than a pretraining contribution, but it is relevant to reasoning-model training. OPD sits between supervised fine-tuning, teacher distillation, and verifiable RL. The useful contribution is to replace a fixed rollout budget with a position-level reliability budget. For foundation-model training research, the broader lesson is that long-sequence supervision should be judged by local compatibility between the learner state and the supervisor, not only by sequence length or final-answer correctness.
summary_en.technical_approach: Standard OPD samples trajectories from the current student and queries the teacher on the same student-visited prefixes, producing dense token-level supervision, often through a reverse-KL-style objective. Prune-OPD adds an online reliability controller. At each position, it compares the student and teacher next-token distributions under the same prefix. The main signal is top-k overlap ratio; a stricter variant checks whether student actions are accepted by the teacher’s top-p or top-k set. When compatibility falls below a threshold, the method records a prefix-drift event. Accumulated drift events define a monotone reliability weight that downweights later OPD rewards. The same signal also determines an effective response length, allowing dynamic rollout control. The key distinction from fixed truncation is that Prune-OPD prunes where teacher supervision is locally unreliable, not merely after a preset number of tokens.
summary_en.experiments: The authors report training-time reductions of 37.6%–68.0% in long-horizon OPD settings while preserving or improving downstream accuracy. Additional runs indicate that the controller keeps long-context supervision when the compatibility signal remains high, which supports the claim that the method reallocates compute rather than simply shortening all responses. The paper also includes fixed-length pruning controls to test whether gains come from reliability-aware pruning rather than generic length reduction. The provided full-content excerpt does not include benchmark names, model sizes, teacher/student configurations, absolute accuracy numbers, or per-task margins, so those should be verified in the experimental tables before citation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 25–40 minutes. Start with the Introduction for the diagnosis of OPD prefix drift. Then read the background objective to see how token-level OPD rewards are computed and where a scalar reliability weight can be inserted. In the method section, focus on top-k overlap, top-p/top-k acceptance, prefix-drift events, monotone reward attenuation, and dynamic rollout control. In the experiments, compare standard OPD, fixed-length pruning, and reliability-aware pruning. For foundation-model researchers, the most transferable point is the depth-dependent degradation of supervision quality in long generated trajectories.

recommendation.zh: 长Horizon推理蒸馏中前缀漂移是实际训练中的真实痛点，动态截断机制可直接借鉴到推理增强蒸馏管线中。看§3的检测与截断策略即可
recommendation.en: Prefix drift in long-horizon reasoning distillation is a real pain point; the dynamic truncation mechanism is directly applicable to reasoning-enhanced distillation pipelines. Read §3 for detection and truncation strategies

paper.title: Asymmetric On-Policy Distillation: Bridging Exploitation and Imitation at the Token Level
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own trajectories with token-level teacher feedback and often outperforms off-policy distillation and standard reinforcement learning. However, we find that its standard advantage weighted policy gradient suffers from three structural weaknesses, including high variance updates, vanishing gradients in zero-advantage regions, and exploration bottlenecks when corrective signals are insufficient.We therefore propose Asymmetric On-Policy Distillati

summary.core_problem: 标准在线策略蒸馏（OPD）的优势加权策略梯度存在三个结构性缺陷：负优势区域更新方差高、零优势区域梯度消失、校正信号不足时存在探索瓶颈，限制了大模型教师向小模型学生的能力蒸馏效果。
summary.importance: 为强化学习驱动的知识蒸馏、小模型推理能力对齐训练提供了更稳定的训练目标设计思路，也可迁移到预训练后的强化学习微调阶段，降低训练方差、提升样本效率。
summary.technical_approach: 提出非对称在线策略蒸馏（AOPD），对不同优势区域采用差异化训练规则：正优势区域保留原有的优势加权策略梯度以强化正确决策，非正优势区域放弃低效的负强化，改为直接最小化学生在当前轨迹前缀下的输出分布与教师分布的散度，同时兼顾强化学习的利用特性与监督学习的校正效率。
summary.experiments: 在竞赛级数学推理基准测试中，跨不同模型规模、初始化预热设置，AOPD性能稳定优于标准OPD，弱初始化场景下提升幅度更明显；在连续工具使用适配任务中，也能更好保留模型原有能力。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第3章OPD负强化的缺陷分析、第4章AOPD的非对称损失设计、图1的两种学习模式示意图、图2的优势分布统计，预计阅读时长15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard on-policy distillation (OPD) with advantage-weighted policy gradient has three structural flaws: high update variance in negative advantage regions, vanishing gradients in zero advantage regions, and exploration bottlenecks when corrective signals are insufficient, which limits the effectiveness of distilling capabilities from large teacher models to small student models.
summary_en.importance: Provides a more stable training objective design for RL-driven knowledge distillation and reasoning capability alignment of small models. It can also be transferred to post-pretrain RL fine-tuning stages to reduce training variance and improve sample efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Asymmetric On-Policy Distillation (AOPD), which applies differentiated training rules for different advantage regions: retains the original advantage-weighted policy gradient in positive advantage regions to reinforce correct decisions, abandons inefficient negative reinforcement in non-positive advantage regions, and directly minimizes the divergence between the student's output distribution under the current trajectory prefix and the teacher's distribution, balancing the exploitation property of RL and correction efficiency of supervised learning.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on competition-level mathematical reasoning benchmarks, AOPD consistently outperforms standard OPD across different model scales and initialization warm-up settings, with more significant improvement under weak initialization. It also preserves the model's original capabilities better in continuous tool use adaptation tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Chapter 3 for defect analysis of OPD negative reinforcement, Chapter 4 for AOPD asymmetric loss design, Figure 1 for the two learning modes illustration, and Figure 2 for advantage distribution statistics. Estimated reading time is 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: OPD 是 RL 蒸馏中被低估的方向，这篇指出的三个结构性缺陷和非对称处理方案值得在内部蒸馏 pipeline 中做小规模 ablation，重点看 §3 的方法设计
recommendation.en: OPD is an underappreciated direction in RL distillation; the three structural flaws identified and the asymmetric treatment scheme are worth small-scale ablation in internal distillation pipelines. Focus on §3 for method design.
