paper.title: Lightning OPD: Efficient Post-Training for Large Reasoning Models with Offline On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as an efficient post-training paradigm for large language models. However, standard OPD requires a live teacher inference server throughout training, resulting in substantial infrastructure overhead. In this work, we investigate whether on-policy distillation can be performed offline. A natural approach is to precompute teacher log-probabilities once over SFT rollouts and reuse them during training. In practice, however, this offline variant fails to reli

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是一个很具体但长期被忽略的问题：OPD（On-Policy Distillation）虽然比基于可验证奖励的 RL 更稳定、监督更密，但它通常要求训练期间持续调用一个在线 teacher，对每条 student rollout 打分并给出 token-level 分布，基础设施成本很高。直觉上，可以把 teacher 在 SFT rollout 上的 log-prob 预先算好，离线复用，从而去掉在线 teacher server；但作者发现，简单这么做往往达不到标准 OPD 的效果。全文的核心结论是，问题不主要出在“离线近似”本身，而在于 OPD 里存在一个必要条件：SFT 阶段生成轨迹的 teacher，和 OPD 阶段提供 token 分布监督的 teacher，必须是同一个模型。作者把这个条件称为 teacher consistency，并证明如果这个条件被破坏，不仅 offline OPD 会偏，连 standard online OPD 也会收敛到带偏差的次优固定点。基于这个判断，Lightning OPD 不是单纯做一个工程加速版 OPD，而是把“teacher consistency + offline precompute”整理成一个理论上自洽、工程上更轻的后训练范式。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练接口研究，这篇工作的价值有两层。第一层是方法层面的：它把 OPD 从“必须依赖在线 teacher serving 的昂贵流程”改造成了可离线执行的流程，直接降低了大规模 reasoning post-training 的实验门槛。第二层更重要，是它指出了一个此前在 RL 风格 pipeline 里容易被忽视的训练信号一致性问题。很多团队会沿用 RLVR 的习惯，在 SFT 数据构造时选一个最会做题的 teacher，在后续蒸馏或 RL 阶段再换一个 teacher；这在 reward-only 训练里未必致命，但在 token-distribution supervision 的 OPD 里会形成结构性偏差。这个结论对 post-train 反哺 pretrain 很有启发：当训练目标依赖 reference policy 或 teacher distribution 时，数据来源、参考分布、优化目标三者必须对齐，否则增加数据量和训练步数也未必能补回来。贡献量级上，它不是提出全新学习范式，但对 OPD 这条线给出了一个足够扎实的理论条件和可落地替代方案，属于会影响后续 pipeline 设计的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
技术路线可以拆成三部分。第一部分是问题重述。标准 OPD 的做法是：student 在当前策略下采样 rollout，teacher 对 rollout 上每个 token 给出 log-prob，再结合 dense per-token advantage 做蒸馏更新。难点在于 rollout 分布随 student 变化，所以看起来 teacher 必须在线。作者先做经验观察，发现 OPD 训练期间 student 相对 SFT reference 的分布漂移并不大，这给了“固定 rollout 分布”的空间。

第二部分是 teacher consistency 的理论分析。作者指出，OPD 实际上有两个 teacher：一个用于生成 SFT 训练轨迹，决定了 reference policy π_ref 所在的数据支持；另一个用于 OPD 阶段提供目标分布。如果这两个 teacher 不一致，那么 student 被要求在一个由 teacher A 诱导的数据分布上，去拟合 teacher B 的 token 分布，目标函数会出现不可消除的偏差。作者把这种偏差写成优化目标中的系统性 mismatch，并分析其固定点性质：即使在线采样、即使训练足够久，也不会收敛到标准 OPD 想要的最优解。离线场景下，这个问题更严重，因为 rollout 分布也被冻结在错误 teacher 诱导的参考策略附近。

第三部分是 Lightning OPD 的构造。做法并不复杂，但关键在于约束关系被理顺了：先选定一个 teacher π_T；用这个同一个 teacher 生成 SFT 轨迹，把 base model 训成 reference policy π_ref；然后从 π_ref 采样固定 rollouts，对这些 responses 预计算同一个 teacher 的 token log-prob；最后在训练阶段只更新 student，不再需要在线 teacher。理论上，作者证明在 teacher consistency 成立时，Lightning OPD 与 standard OPD 共享相同最优点；两者的梯度差异在训练过程中有界，不会无限累积。更有意思的是，离线目标由于固定在 π_ref 支撑集上，天然带来一种抑制 policy drift 的隐式正则效果，因此不需要额外显式 KL penalty 也能保持稳定。这一点很像把 on-policy distillation 的有效区域锚定在 reference neighborhood 内，用数据支持而不是额外正则去限制漂移。

和已有方法相比，区别主要有三点。其一，不是简单把 online teacher cache 成离线表，而是先解释为什么有些离线 OPD 失败。其二，关注点不是 reward shaping 或 advantage estimator 改进，而是 teacher/data/reference 三者的一致性。其三，它把“offline”从近似妥协变成了在特定条件下与 online 等价的训练形式，这个论证比单纯报速度提升更重要。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖数学推理和代码生成两类任务，student-teacher 组合包括 Qwen3-4B ← Qwen3-8B，以及 Qwen3-8B ← Qwen3-32B。摘要里给出的主结论是：Lightning OPD 在所有评测上都能匹配或超过标准 OPD，同时由于去掉并行 teacher serving，整体训练吞吐约提升 4.0×。从全文叙述看，实验重点不只是“离线版能不能跑通”，而是围绕 teacher consistency 做了成体系验证。

关键实验应关注四类结果。第一类是 offline naive baseline 的失败：如果直接在现成 SFT rollout 上缓存 teacher log-prob，但 SFT teacher 和 OPD teacher 不一致，性能会明显落后于标准 OPD，且训练更难弥补差距。第二类是 teacher consistency ablation：当把 SFT 数据生成 teacher 与 OPD teacher 对齐后，offline Lightning OPD 的性能显著恢复，并接近甚至超过 online OPD。这组实验支撑了“问题根源不是 offline，而是不一致”。第三类是 online mismatch 对照：作者不仅证明 offline 受害，连 standard OPD 在 teacher mismatch 下也会退化，这一点很关键，因为它说明这是目标定义问题，不是缓存近似误差。第四类是训练动态分析：student 相对 π_ref 的漂移有限，离线目标训练更平稳，说明隐式正则确实在起作用。

从摘要能确定的数字包括：模型规模为 4B/8B/32B，任务覆盖 math 和 code，速度收益约 4 倍。更细的 benchmark 数字、消融表和训练曲线需要重点看正文实验章节与附录。若按这类论文常见写法，最值得盯的是：不同 teacher 组合下的 pass@k / accuracy 变化、offline 与 online 的 sample efficiency、以及 mismatch 条件下性能是否随训练步数继续恶化或只是早期受损。作者声称存在“irreducible bias”，因此如果图里显示延长训练也无法追平，那就是理论和实验最强的闭环。
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“先理论条件，再看实验验证”的顺序读。

第一遍先抓三件事。1）Introduction 里对 teacher consistency 的定义，以及为什么 OPD 与 RLVR 不同：RLVR 只依赖 reward，teacher 可以只是出题或验题工具；OPD 直接拟合 teacher distribution，所以 teacher 身份进入了目标函数。2）理论部分里关于 mismatch bias 和 shared optimum 的命题，重点看假设条件是什么，尤其是 rollout 分布、reference policy、advantage 权重如何进入证明。3）实验里 teacher consistency 的主消融，这是整篇文章最关键的证据。

第二遍建议细看图表。优先看：比较 online OPD、naive offline OPD、Lightning OPD 的主表；teacher matched vs mismatched 的对照表；训练曲线中 student-policy drift、loss 稳定性、性能随 step 变化的图。如果有附录中的推导，重点确认“gradient discrepancy bounded”是在哪些假设下成立，是否依赖 student 始终靠近 π_ref，还是结论更一般。

值得深挖的点有四个。第一，隐式正则到底来自固定 rollout 支撑集，还是来自 advantage 加权后的目标形状，这关系到它能否推广到更强分布漂移场景。第二，teacher consistency 是否要求严格同一 checkpoint，还是同一家族、同一训练阶段也足够。第三，如果 teacher 比较强但生成风格和目标 teacher 不同，能否通过 importance weighting 或 relabeling 修正。第四，这个思路能否推广到更广义的 offline RLHF / offline DPO / offline policy improvement。

如果时间有限，至少读完 Introduction、理论主命题、teacher consistency 消融、以及速度成本对比。这样已经能把文章最重要的判断抓住。若要复现实验，先确认 SFT 数据是谁生成的，再决定 OPD teacher；这是实现里最容易被忽略、但影响最大的地方。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical bottleneck in On-Policy Distillation (OPD): standard OPD needs a live teacher model during training to score student rollouts token by token, which makes reasoning post-training expensive and infrastructure-heavy. A natural workaround is to precompute teacher log-probabilities on SFT rollouts and reuse them offline. In practice, that naive offline variant often underperforms. The central claim of the paper is that the main issue is not offline approximation itself, but a missing condition in prior OPD pipelines: the teacher used to generate SFT trajectories and the teacher used to provide OPD token distributions must be the same model. The paper calls this teacher consistency. Once this condition is violated, both offline and online OPD optimize a biased objective and converge to a suboptimal fixed point. Lightning OPD is built on this observation: enforce teacher consistency, precompute teacher scores once on reference-policy rollouts, and remove the live teacher server without changing the target optimum.
summary_en.importance: Its significance is less about a small engineering speedup and more about clarifying what makes OPD well-defined. On the practical side, it turns OPD from a serving-heavy procedure into an offline-compatible one, which lowers the cost of large-scale reasoning post-training. On the conceptual side, it identifies a signal-alignment issue that matters whenever training depends on a reference distribution rather than scalar rewards. Many pipelines inherit RLVR habits: use one strong model to generate SFT data, then use another model for later distillation. That may be acceptable in reward-only settings, but in OPD the teacher distribution is part of the objective, so this mismatch creates structural bias. This matters for the pretrain–posttrain interface as well: if data source, reference policy, and supervision distribution are misaligned, more compute or more data may not fix the problem. The contribution is not a new learning paradigm, but it is a strong correction to how OPD pipelines should be designed.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three layers.

First, the paper reframes the online requirement in OPD. Standard OPD samples rollouts from the current student policy, queries the teacher for token log-probabilities on those rollouts, and updates the student with dense token-level advantage weighting. Because the rollout distribution changes during training, the teacher appears to be inherently online. The authors start from an empirical observation: during OPD, the student policy does not drift very far from the SFT reference policy. That opens the door to using a fixed rollout distribution.

Second, the paper introduces and analyzes teacher consistency. OPD implicitly involves two teachers: one teacher generates the trajectories used in SFT and therefore shapes the support of the reference policy, while another teacher may be used during OPD to provide target token distributions. If these are different, the student is asked to fit teacher B on data induced by teacher A. The paper argues that this creates an irreducible mismatch in the objective. The analysis goes beyond offline caching: even standard online OPD remains biased under this mismatch and converges to the wrong fixed point. Offline training makes the issue worse because the rollout distribution is also frozen around the wrong reference policy.

Third, Lightning OPD is the consistent offline construction. Choose one teacher π_T. Use that same teacher to generate SFT trajectories and train the base model into a reference policy π_ref. Then sample fixed rollouts from π_ref, precompute token log-probabilities from the same teacher on those responses, and train the student without any live teacher server. The theoretical result is the key part: under teacher consistency, Lightning OPD shares the same optimum as standard OPD, and the gradient discrepancy between the offline and online objectives stays bounded during training. The paper also argues that the offline objective introduces an implicit regularization effect: because training remains anchored to the support of π_ref, policy drift is naturally limited even without an explicit KL penalty.

Relative to prior OPD work, the novelty is not just caching teacher outputs. The paper explains why some offline attempts fail, isolates the failure mode as teacher mismatch, and turns offline OPD from a heuristic approximation into a conditionally equivalent training procedure.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments cover mathematical reasoning and code generation, with student–teacher pairs including Qwen3-4B distilled from Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-8B distilled from Qwen3-32B. The headline result stated in the paper is that Lightning OPD matches or exceeds standard OPD across all reported benchmarks while delivering about a 4.0× training speedup by removing parallel teacher serving.

The most important empirical evidence appears to come from four types of comparisons. First, a naive offline baseline: simply caching teacher log-probabilities on existing SFT rollouts does not reliably match standard OPD when the SFT teacher and the OPD teacher differ. Second, teacher-consistency ablations: once the same teacher is used for both SFT trajectory generation and OPD supervision, offline performance recovers and becomes competitive with online OPD. Third, online mismatch controls: the paper shows that teacher inconsistency also hurts standard online OPD, which is crucial because it demonstrates that the issue is objective bias rather than offline approximation error. Fourth, training-dynamics analysis: the student stays relatively close to the reference policy, and the offline variant shows stable optimization behavior, supporting the implicit-regularization argument.

From the provided content, the confirmed concrete numbers are the model scales (4B, 8B, 32B), the task domains (math and code), and the roughly 4× speed gain. The detailed benchmark numbers, ablation tables, and training curves should be checked in the main experimental section and appendix. The most informative figures are likely those showing matched vs mismatched teachers, online vs offline comparisons, and whether longer training fails to close the gap under mismatch. If the paper indeed shows that the gap persists with more steps or more data, that is the strongest empirical support for the irreducible-bias claim.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in the following order: definition, theory, then ablations.

Start with the introduction and isolate the exact meaning of teacher consistency. The important distinction is why OPD differs from RLVR: RLVR depends on rewards, while OPD directly fits a teacher distribution, so the teacher identity enters the objective itself.

Then move to the theoretical section. Focus on two claims: why teacher mismatch induces a biased objective, and under what assumptions Lightning OPD shares the same optimum as standard OPD. Pay attention to how the rollout distribution, reference policy, and token-level advantage weighting appear in the derivation. The bounded gradient-discrepancy result is especially worth checking carefully, because it determines whether the offline approximation is merely stable near initialization or theoretically controlled throughout training.

After that, read the ablations before the headline benchmark table. The matched-vs-mismatched teacher comparison is the core evidence of the paper. Also inspect training curves for policy drift, optimization stability, and performance over steps. If there is an appendix with proofs, it is worth checking whether the equivalence result requires the student to remain close to π_ref or whether the statement is stronger.

The most useful questions to keep in mind while reading are: how strict teacher consistency needs to be in practice; whether the implicit regularization comes mainly from fixed rollout support or from the weighted objective itself; whether mismatch could be corrected by relabeling or importance weighting; and whether the same logic extends to broader offline preference optimization or offline RLHF settings.

If time is limited, read the introduction, the main theorem statements, the teacher-consistency ablation, and the throughput/cost comparison. That is enough to capture the paper’s main contribution and its practical implication for post-training pipelines.

commentary.article_excerpt: 大模型任我行 关注 英伟达：离线策略蒸馏Lightning OPD 📖标题：Lightning OPD: Efficient Post-Training for Large Reasoning Models with Offline On-Policy Distillation 🌐来源：arXiv, 2604.13010v1 🛎️文章简介 🔸研究问题：如何在消除实时教师推理服务器带来的巨大基础设施开销的同时，保持在线策略蒸馏（OPD）的高效性与高性能？ 🔸主要贡献：论文发现了“教师一致性”这一关键条件，并据此提出了 Lightning OPD 框架，通过预计算教师概率实现了无需实时服务器的离线训练，在大幅降低算力成本的同时达到了最先进性能。 📝重点思路 🔸提出教师一致性原则，指出监督微调（SFT）阶段生成数据的教师模型必须与 OPD 阶段提供分布参考的教师模型完全一致，否则会导致不可消除的梯度偏差。 🔸设计 Lightning OPD 两阶段流程：首先在 SFT 阶段利用指定教师生成轨迹并微调基座模型得到参考策略；随后在预处理阶段仅对该参考策略的 rollout 进行一次性的教师对数概率计算并存储。 🔸构建离线训练目标，在正式训练学生模型时直接读取预存的教师概率值，完全解耦了训练过程与实时教师推理服务，将在线采样分布固定为 SFT 后的参考分布。 🔸理论证明在满足教师一致性前提下，该离线方法与标准在线 OPD 共享相同的最优解，且梯度差异有界，同时固定的 Rollout 分布引入了隐式正则化效应以抑制策略漂移。 🔎分析总结 🔸实验表明违反教师一致性会导致在线和离线 OPD 均收敛至次优固定点，且在离线设置下由于分布不匹配叠加，性能下降更为显著。 🔸该方法显著提升了训练效率，相比标准 OPD 实现了 4.0 倍的加速，将 8B 模型的训练成本从 120 GPU 小时降低至 30 GPU 小时，且无需维护高并发的教师服务集群。 🔸训练动态分析显示，学生策略在整个训练过程中始终紧密围绕参考分布，重要性权重的均值和方差保持稳定，验证了隐式正则化的有效性。 💡个人观点 论文识别出被以往研究忽视的“教师一致性”理论约束，将原本被视为必须的在线交互转化为一次性的离线预处理。 #LLM #大模型 #强化学习 #论文分享 #英伟达 6天前

paper.title: Rethinking On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models: Phenomenology, Mechanism, and Recipe
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become a core technique in the post-training of large language models, yet its training dynamics remain poorly understood. This paper provides a systematic investigation of OPD dynamics and mechanisms. We first identify that two conditions govern whether OPD succeeds or fails: (i) the student and teacher should share compatible thinking patterns; and (ii) even with consistent thinking patterns and higher scores, the teacher must offer genuinely new capabilities b

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是：为什么同样是 on-policy distillation，某些 teacher 能稳定带来提升，某些看起来更强的 teacher 却几乎没有效果，甚至完全失败。论文把问题从“teacher 分数高不高”转成了“teacher 与 student 的分布关系是什么”。全文给出的结论有两条。第一，student 和 teacher 需要有足够接近的 thinking pattern，也就是在 student 自己会访问到的状态上，两者高概率 token 的支持集要有较高重合；如果初始分布差得太远，token 级梯度很难把 student 拉过去。第二，teacher 不能只是 benchmark 分数更高，还必须携带 student 训练中尚未获得的新能力或新知识；如果二者只是同一家族、同数据、同 recipe 的尺度差异，那么 teacher 对 student 来说可能几乎是“分布上不可区分”的，OPD 就缺少可迁移信号。论文进一步指出，OPD 学到的主要不是抽象的 outcome-level 奖励，而是 teacher 在局部 token 分布上的思维轨迹与偏好结构。
summary.importance: 对预训练与后训练接口的意义很直接。工业界已经把 OPD 当成 RL 之外的一条低成本强化路径，但此前对其成功条件理解很粗。这里给出的“分布重合 + 新知识增量”两条件，把 teacher 选择、数据选择、warm start 设计都从经验问题变成了可诊断的问题。对基座研究员来说，价值不只在 post-train。它说明：模型之间的可蒸馏性，不由最终分数单独决定，而由训练数据、训练 recipe、模型家族导致的局部分布几何决定。这和预训练里常见的 scaling 直觉不同：更大模型不自动意味着更好的 teacher。另一个重要点是，论文把 OPD 的有效监督定位到 overlap tokens 上，这对设计更便宜的蒸馏目标、理解 dense token supervision 的真正作用范围、以及分析长链推理中后段 token 不稳定性，都有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上分三层。第一层是 phenomenology。作者系统比较不同 teacher-student 组合，包括同家族不同尺度、不同训练 recipe、以及 reverse distillation 设置，观察哪些组合成功、哪些失败。核心诊断量包括 top-k overlap ratio、teacher/student entropy gap、token-level advantage，以及 rollout correctness 与 reward 的关系。这里最关键的不是看 teacher 的绝对能力，而是看在 student 采样出的 prefix 上，teacher 的高概率 token 是否与 student 有足够重合。第二层是 mechanism。作者把 OPD 的梯度作用点缩到 token 集合层面，发现成功训练时，teacher 与 student 在 student-visited states 上的分布会持续靠近：高概率 token 重合上升，熵差收窄，共享 top-k token 承载几乎全部联合概率质量。更重要的是，他们做了限制性实验：只保留 overlap token 上的监督，效果可以匹配完整 top-k 蒸馏；这说明真正起作用的梯度主要来自两者都已经赋予较高概率的 token，而不是 teacher 独有的长尾 token。失败情形下，初始 overlap 低、熵不匹配，导致局部优化几何过平或方向不稳定，训练无法进入有效区间。第三层是 recipe。针对失败配置，作者提出两种补救。其一是 off-policy cold start：先用 teacher rollout 做一段 warmup SFT，把 student 拉到更接近 teacher 的局部分布，再切换到 OPD。其二是 teacher-aligned prompt selection：优先使用来自 teacher post-training 数据分布的 prompt，提高高概率 token 对齐效率。但这种做法会显著压低 student entropy，因此需要混入 OOD prompts 保持分布宽度。最后，论文还分析了 trajectory depth 对 reward 质量的影响，发现越靠后 token，监督越差，且不稳定会从后往前传播。这提示当前 OPD 在长时程推理和 agent 场景里会遇到结构性限制。
summary.experiments: 实验最有信息量的结果有四组。第一，成功与失败的 token-level 动态差异非常清楚。成功 OPD 中，teacher/student 的 top-k overlap ratio 会从约 72% 持续升到 91%；共享 top-k token 最终覆盖 97% 到 99% 的联合概率质量；同时 entropy gap 持续缩小。失败运行则从一开始就表现为 overlap 停滞、熵差长期存在。第二，reverse distillation 验证了“高分不等于可蒸馏”。在同家族 1.5B 与 7B 的设置里，尽管 teacher 更大更强，但若二者共享相同数据和 recipe，student 视角下 teacher 的分布增量很小，蒸馏收益有限，说明尺度差本身不提供足够新知识。第三，监督来源消融显示 overlap tokens 几乎就是全部有效信号。只在 overlap 集上做监督，性能接近完整 top-k；这比“teacher 全分布都重要”的直觉更细，也解释了为什么分布错位时 OPD 很难救。第四，recipe 实验表明两种补救都能把失败配置拉回成功动态：cold-start SFT 能提高初始 overlap，teacher-aligned prompts 能增强局部 token advantage，但后者会让 student 熵下降过快，因此必须与分布外 prompt 混合。论文摘要里没有完整列出所有 benchmark 数字和训练规模，给出的最关键定量信号主要是上述分布统计与恢复趋势；阅读正文时应重点看各组 teacher-student 配置、成功/失败曲线和 prompt mixing 的消融表。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合按“现象—机制—配方”顺序读。先看第 3 节，抓住两个成功条件：thinking-pattern consistency 和 genuinely new capabilities。这里决定了整篇的判断框架。然后看第 4 节的 token-level mechanism，重点盯 overlap ratio、entropy gap、shared top-k mass 这几个量，以及 overlap-only supervision 的消融；这是全文最有解释力的部分。第 5 节看 recipe，不要只看“能不能救回来”，更要看为什么 cold start 有效、为什么 teacher-aligned prompt 会带来低熵副作用。第 6 节值得细读，尤其是 trajectory depth 与 reward quality 的关系，这部分对长链 reasoning、agent rollout、甚至 RLHF 中 dense reward 的局限都有启发。图表上优先看：成功/失败 OPD 的分布动态对比图、reverse distillation 结果、overlap-only ablation、以及 prompt mixing 的熵变化。泛读大约 30 到 45 分钟；如果要把它转成可执行 recipe，建议连附录中的训练细节和 teacher/student 组合表一起看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a precise question: why does on-policy distillation sometimes work well, while a seemingly stronger teacher can fail to improve the student at all? The answer developed through the full paper is not “teacher quality” in the benchmark sense, but the geometry of the teacher-student distributions on states visited by the student. Two conditions emerge. First, the student and teacher must share compatible thinking patterns, meaning their high-probability token sets need substantial overlap on student-generated prefixes. If the initial mismatch is too large, token-level gradients are too weak or too misaligned to move the student into the teacher’s regime. Second, a higher-scoring teacher is not enough; the teacher must contain capabilities or knowledge that are genuinely new relative to the student’s training history. If teacher and student come from the same family, data mixture, and recipe, then scale alone may not create a meaningful transfer signal. In that case, the teacher can be distributionally almost indistinguishable from the student from the student’s own perspective.
summary_en.importance: This matters beyond a narrow post-training recipe. OPD is already used as a practical alternative or complement to RL-style post-training because it provides dense token-level supervision at lower cost. What was missing was a reliable account of when it should work. The paper turns teacher selection from a heuristic into a diagnosable problem: success depends on local distributional compatibility and on whether the teacher adds non-redundant knowledge. For pretraining researchers, this is useful because it challenges a common scaling intuition. A larger model is not automatically a better teacher if both models were shaped by the same data and optimization pipeline. The paper also identifies overlap tokens as the main locus of useful supervision. That has direct implications for cheaper distillation objectives, for understanding what dense token supervision is actually doing, and for why long-horizon reasoning becomes unstable when later-token supervision degrades.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper is organized around three layers: phenomenology, mechanism, and recipe. In the phenomenology part, the authors compare a range of teacher-student pairings, including same-family different-scale models, models trained with different recipes, and reverse distillation settings. The key measurements are top-k overlap ratio, teacher-student entropy gap, token-level advantage, and the relation between reward and rollout correctness. The central move is to evaluate teacher usefulness on student-visited states rather than by standalone teacher scores. In the mechanism section, the analysis becomes token-level. Successful OPD runs show a consistent signature: teacher and student distributions become progressively closer on the student’s own trajectories; high-probability token overlap rises; entropy mismatch narrows; and the shared top-k tokens account for nearly all of the combined probability mass. A crucial ablation then restricts supervision to overlap tokens only and finds that this matches full top-k distillation. This is the strongest mechanistic result in the paper. It suggests that OPD works mainly by sharpening and reweighting tokens that both models already consider plausible, rather than by directly injecting teacher-only tail tokens. Failure cases, by contrast, start with low overlap and persistent entropy mismatch, which creates poor local optimization geometry. In the recipe section, the authors propose two recovery strategies for otherwise failing settings. Off-policy cold start uses teacher-generated rollouts for a warmup SFT phase before switching to OPD, explicitly increasing initial overlap. Teacher-aligned prompt selection samples prompts from the teacher’s post-training distribution to improve alignment on high-probability tokens, though this also lowers student entropy and therefore needs mixing with out-of-distribution prompts. The final section studies supervision quality along the trajectory and shows that reward quality degrades with depth, with instability appearing first at later tokens and then propagating backward.
summary_en.experiments: The most informative results are about dynamics rather than a single benchmark number. In successful OPD runs, the top-k overlap ratio between teacher and student rises from roughly 72% to 91%, while the shared top-k tokens account for about 97% to 99% of the combined probability mass. At the same time, the entropy gap narrows steadily. Failed runs show the opposite pattern: overlap stagnates early and entropy mismatch persists. Reverse distillation is especially revealing. In same-family 1.5B-to-7B settings, the larger teacher may score higher, but if both models were trained with the same data and recipe, the teacher offers little distributional novelty from the student’s perspective, so gains are limited. Another key ablation shows that supervision restricted to overlap tokens performs on par with full top-k supervision, which strongly supports the proposed mechanism. The recipe experiments then show that both recovery methods can turn failing configurations into successful ones: cold-start SFT improves initial overlap, and teacher-aligned prompts improve local token-level advantage. However, the latter also drives student entropy down too aggressively, so prompt mixing is required. The paper’s most important quantitative evidence is therefore in the distributional diagnostics and recovery curves, not just in end-task scores.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with Section 3. The two conditions for success are the conceptual backbone of the paper: compatible thinking patterns and genuinely new teacher knowledge. Then read Section 4 carefully. The overlap ratio, entropy gap, shared top-k mass, and the overlap-only supervision ablation are the core explanatory pieces. Section 5 is useful if you care about turning the analysis into practice; pay attention not only to whether the fixes work, but to why cold start changes the optimization regime and why teacher-aligned prompts create a low-entropy side effect. Section 6 deserves more attention than the average recipe paper would get. The depth-dependent degradation of reward quality is relevant to long-chain reasoning, agent rollouts, and any setting that relies on dense token-level supervision. The most important figures are the successful-versus-failed OPD dynamics, the reverse distillation comparisons, the overlap-only ablation, and the entropy behavior under prompt mixing. For a skim-level read, 30 to 45 minutes is enough. For implementation or research follow-up, the appendices and exact teacher-student pairing details are worth checking.

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 on-policy distillation 的可靠性问题：学生模型在自己的采样轨迹上接受教师 token-level 监督，但学生探索到的状态未必有训练价值，教师在这些学生轨迹上的逐 token 反馈也未必可信。两者都会让 OPD 在长链推理、多任务和多模态蒸馏中不稳定。
summary.importance: 这是一篇 post-train 方向的高相关论文。它没有改变基座预训练目标，但对 pretrain ↔ posttrain 接口有实际信息量。原因是 OPD 同时吸收了 SFT 的 dense supervision 和 RL 的 on-policy sampling：学生不会只模仿离线专家答案，而是在自己会到达的状态上学习；教师又能提供比终局 reward 更细的 token 级训练信号。论文的主要贡献是把 OPD 的失败来源拆成两个可操作问题：状态探索不足和教师监督不可靠，并给出一套在 LLM 与 MLLM 上统一使用的 recipe。对做持续预训练、能力合并、专家模型蒸馏和多模态统一模型的人来说，它提供的是训练信号质量控制方法，而不只是一个蒸馏 loss。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Uni-OPD，核心是 dual-perspective optimization：从学生侧改善探索，从教师侧校准监督。基础 OPD 设定是：给定问题 q，学生策略 πθ 采样轨迹 τ；训练时在这些 on-policy prefix 上最小化学生和教师 πT 的 reverse KL。这个目标可以被解释为在学生实际访问的状态上施加 token-level reward，因此比离线 SFT 更少受 exposure bias 影响，也比只用终局奖励的 RL 更容易做细粒度 credit assignment。学生侧使用两种数据平衡。第一是 offline difficulty-aware balancing，先按样本难度组织训练分布，避免训练批次被过易样本主导，也避免大量不可学样本带来噪声。第二是 online correctness-aware balancing，根据学生当前采样轨迹的正确性动态调节训练样本，让模型持续看到“有信息量”的状态，尤其是接近决策边界的正确与错误轨迹。教师侧提出 outcome-guided margin calibration。它不盲目信任教师在学生轨迹上的 token 概率，而是用 outcome reward 作为全局锚点检查轨迹级排序：正确轨迹的聚合教师分数应高于错误轨迹。若教师的逐 token 信号在轨迹级别与结果奖励不一致，就通过 margin 约束进行校准，使 token-level supervision 与最终正确性保持更一致。这个设计针对的是 OPD 的常见问题：教师在 OOD 学生前缀上退化、给流畅但错误的推理较高概率、多个教师之间信号冲突，或在多模态输入上产生不稳定的 token 偏好。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 5 个领域和 16 个 benchmark，包含 LLM 与 MLLM 设置。论文报告了多种蒸馏场景：single-teacher distillation、multi-teacher distillation、strong-to-weak distillation，以及 text-only 与 multimodal task 混合的 cross-modal distillation。关键实验结论是，单独使用 vanilla OPD 会受到学生采样分布和教师信号质量的限制；加入 offline difficulty-aware balancing 和 online correctness-aware balancing 后，学生访问到的训练状态更有信息量；再加入 outcome-guided margin calibration 后，教师 token 监督与结果正确性的顺序一致性提高，训练效果更稳定。消融的核心价值在于证明三件事：探索平衡和监督校准解决的是不同瓶颈；只做数据平衡不能修复错误教师信号；只做教师校准也不能弥补学生状态覆盖不足。正文片段未给出可核验的逐 benchmark 数值，因此不应编造具体提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先看 Introduction 中对 OPD 两个瓶颈的定义，因为这是整篇论文的判断框架。然后看 Methodology 的 OPD 梯度推导，尤其是 reverse KL 如何诱导 token-level reward；这部分决定了它和 SFT、GRPO 类 RL 的差异。随后重点读 Fig. 2 和 3.3、3.4：3.3 看两种 balancing 如何构造训练分布，3.4 看 outcome reward 如何校准教师 token 信号。实验部分优先看三类内容：order-consistency 的分析图、三组件消融、LLM/MLLM 和 multi-teacher 设置下的稳定性对比。值得深挖的是 margin calibration 的可替代实现，例如能否用 verifier、process reward model 或 execution feedback 替代简单 outcome reward，以及这种校准是否会过度压制教师的软分布信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies when on-policy distillation is reliable. OPD trains a student on its own sampled trajectories with token-level teacher supervision, but two things can fail: the student may not explore informative states, and the teacher may give unreliable token-level guidance on student-generated prefixes.
summary_en.importance: This is a high-signal post-training paper for foundation-model researchers. It does not propose a new pretraining objective, but it is relevant to the interface between pretraining and post-training. OPD combines two useful properties: on-policy sampling from RL and dense token-level supervision from distillation. The paper’s contribution is to turn OPD reliability into two controllable training-signal problems: state coverage and teacher-signal calibration. That matters for expert merging, continual capability injection, multimodal unification, and strong-to-weak transfer.
summary_en.technical_approach: Uni-OPD uses a dual-perspective recipe. From the student side, it improves exploration with two balancing strategies. Offline difficulty-aware balancing shapes the training distribution by sample difficulty, so training is not dominated by trivial examples or by examples that are too hard to learn from. Online correctness-aware balancing then uses the student’s current rollout correctness to keep training focused on informative states, especially near the boundary between correct and incorrect behavior. From the teacher side, the paper introduces outcome-guided margin calibration. Vanilla OPD trusts the teacher’s token probabilities on student rollouts, but those rollouts can be out of distribution for the teacher. The proposed calibration uses outcome reward as a global anchor: after aggregating token-level teacher scores over a trajectory, correct trajectories should rank above incorrect ones by a margin. If this order consistency is violated, the teacher signal is adjusted. This is meant to handle teacher degradation on unusual student prefixes, fluent but wrong reasoning chains, conflicts between multiple teachers, and unstable multimodal supervision.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers 5 domains and 16 benchmarks across LLM and MLLM settings. The paper tests single-teacher distillation, multi-teacher distillation, strong-to-weak distillation, and cross-modal distillation that mixes text-only and multimodal tasks. The main empirical message is that vanilla OPD is limited by both student exploration and teacher reliability. The two balancing strategies improve the informativeness of student-generated states, while outcome-guided margin calibration improves the agreement between token-level teacher supervision and final correctness. The ablations are important because they separate the two bottlenecks: balancing cannot fix a miscalibrated teacher signal, and calibration cannot compensate for poor state coverage. The provided content does not expose verifiable per-benchmark numbers, so specific accuracy gains should not be inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is worth a careful read. Start with the introduction, where the two OPD bottlenecks are defined. Then read the OPD gradient derivation in the methodology section; it clarifies why reverse-KL distillation on student rollouts can be viewed as token-level reward learning. The most important parts are Fig. 2 and Sections 3.3–3.4: Section 3.3 explains how the data distribution is balanced, and Section 3.4 explains how outcome reward calibrates teacher supervision. In the experiments, prioritize the order-consistency analysis, component ablations, and the LLM/MLLM multi-teacher results. A useful follow-up question is whether the margin calibration can be driven by verifiers, process reward models, or execution feedback without destroying the useful soft information in teacher distributions.

recommendation.zh: 读 §3 的两个 bottleneck 和 teacher order-consistency；若指标干净，可直接变成内部蒸馏诊断项。
recommendation.en: Read the two bottlenecks and teacher order-consistency analysis; if the metrics are clean, they become immediate internal OPD diagnostics.

paper.title: MAD-OPD: Breaking the Ceiling in On-Policy Distillation via Multi-Agent Debate
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own trajectories under token-level teacher supervision, but existing methods are capped by a single-teacher capability ceiling: when the teacher errs, the student inherits the error. OPD also remains largely unexplored in agentic tasks, where per-step errors compound across long trajectories and destabilize training. We propose MAD-OPD (Multi-Agent Debate-driven On-Policy Distillation), which breaks this ceiling by recasting the distillation t

summary.core_problem: 在 on-policy distillation（OPD）里，学生模型沿着自己的采样轨迹学习，但监督信号来自教师分布；当教师在学生访问到的“困难状态”上出错或过度自信时，学生会被锁死在单教师能力上限，并在多步 agentic 任务中因误差累积而训练不稳定。论文要解决的是：如何在 OPD 框架内获得比单教师更可靠的逐 token 监督，并给出与任务结构匹配的 divergence 选择原则，从而把 OPD 扩展到长轨迹的 agentic 场景。
summary.importance: 对 post-train 侧的蒸馏范式有直接增量：把“多模型协作（debate/consensus）”从离线数据蒸馏带进 on-policy 训练环，目标是突破单教师 ceiling，并把 OPD 更系统地推到工具使用/环境交互的长轨迹任务。更有价值的部分是把 divergence 选择显式解释为“逐 token reward 设计”，并给出针对 agentic 稳定性与代码生成一致性的不同选择（JSD vs reverse KL）的动机与验证路径；这类分析对后续做 OPD/RLHF 混合目标、或做更稳定的 dense 信号训练有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach:
1) MAD-OPD：在每个决策点（state s_t=(x, ŷ_<t)）不再用单一教师分布 p，而是让多个教师围绕学生当前 on-policy 状态进行多轮 debate，产出 debate transcript 作为 privileged context c；每个教师在 debate 后给出 token-level 分布与置信度，训练时对教师贡献做置信度加权，形成“debate-conditioned teacher distribution”来监督学生 q。关键点不是简单 ensemble，而是让教师对学生的具体 rollout 做“在线反应”，把多代理讨论带来的纠错/补全能力注入到逐 token 监督里。
2) OPAD（On-Policy Agentic Distillation）：面向 agentic 任务引入 step-level 的环境交互与采样机制，强调在多步轨迹中进行 on-policy 采样与监督，以缓解 per-step error compounding 导致的分布偏移与训练崩溃。它作为训练管线层面的改造，使得 MAD-OPD 和单教师 OPD 都能在 agentic setting 下跑起来。
3) divergence 作为 reward 设计：论文沿用“OPD 等价于 dense token-level RL surrogate”的视角，把 r_D(s_t)=-D(p||q) 视为由 divergence 决定的奖励。基于 privileged distillation 的结构性不对称（教师条件在 c 上、学生不条件在 c 上），讨论两类典型失配：a) 教师对学生采样 token 给近零概率（p(v)→0, q(v)>0），在 agentic 多步中更常见；b) 教师在多个可行 token 上分散质量、学生需要做一致选择，在代码生成更常见。由此提出任务自适应原则：agentic 训练用有界的 JSD 来抑制极端梯度/奖励尖峰、提升稳定性；代码生成用 reverse KL 更偏向 mode-seeking，鼓励输出在局部更一致、更“收敛”到单一路径。论文声称同时给出理论与实证支撑。
summary.experiments: 给定的全文片段未包含实验设置与具体数值表格（模型规模、教师数量、debate 轮数、agentic 环境、代码基准、提升幅度、稳定性指标等），因此无法基于全文内容复述关键数字与消融。就方法描述而言，合理的关键消融应包括：单教师 OPD vs 多教师无 debate ensemble vs MAD-OPD；置信度加权 vs 均匀加权；OPAD 的 step-level 采样/交互开关；JSD vs KL vs reverse KL 在 agentic 与 code 两类任务上的稳定性（loss spike、成功率方差、轨迹长度分布）与质量权衡。若论文正文确有这些结果，应以“是否真正突破 strongest teacher、以及是否显著降低训练崩溃/回退频率”作为主要判据。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 里三点限制 L1–L3，确认作者把 OPD 的痛点定义在“单教师 ceiling + agentic 误差累积 + divergence 选择缺乏原则”。
- 精看 Preliminaries and Divergence Analysis：这里把 divergence 选择写成 reward 设计，并区分 agentic vs code 的两类失配模式；这是论文最可迁移的部分。
- 再看 MAD-OPD 的训练环：重点是 debate transcript 如何进入 teacher 分布、置信度如何定义与加权、以及计算开销如何控制（每步多教师多轮 debate 的成本通常是主要工程瓶颈）。
- 最后快速扫实验与消融（若正文完整）：优先找“超过最强单教师”的证据、以及稳定性指标（方差/失败率/loss spike）而不只是均值提升。

summary_en.core_problem: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own rollouts with token-level supervision from a teacher distribution. In practice it hits a single-teacher ceiling (teacher mistakes get copied) and becomes fragile in long-horizon agentic tasks where step-wise errors compound. The paper targets: (i) how to produce stronger, more reliable token supervision than any single teacher while staying on-policy, and (ii) how to choose the OPD divergence in a task-structured way rather than as a generic hyperparameter.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a post-training/distillation contribution, but it matters to pretrain researchers insofar as OPD is increasingly used as a dense-signal alternative to outcome-reward RL and as a bridge between pretrain and alignment. The most reusable idea is framing divergence choice as per-token reward design, then arguing for different divergences for different regimes (bounded JSD for agentic stability; reverse KL for coherent code generation). The multi-agent debate-in-the-loop design is also a concrete attempt to break the “teacher upper bound” that often limits strong-to-weak distillation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
1) MAD-OPD: replace a single teacher with a deliberative committee. At each student-visited state s_t=(x, ŷ_<t), multiple teacher models run a debate conditioned on the student’s current on-policy context. The debate transcript becomes privileged context c for the teachers, yielding debate-conditioned token distributions. Teachers’ contributions are aggregated with post-debate confidence weights, producing the supervision signal for the student.
2) OPAD: an agentic OPD pipeline that explicitly incorporates step-level environment interaction/sampling to make OPD workable in multi-step tool-use settings, where distribution shift and compounding errors otherwise destabilize training.
3) Divergence principle: using the known equivalence between OPD and a dense token-level RL surrogate, the paper treats r_D(s_t) = -D(p||q) as a reward shaped entirely by the divergence. With privileged distillation asymmetry (teacher conditions on c, student does not), it highlights two mismatch patterns: near-zero teacher mass on student-sampled tokens (common in agentic rollouts) vs multi-modal valid tokens where the student must commit consistently (common in code). It then motivates bounded JSD for stability in the former and reverse KL (mode-seeking) for coherence in the latter, claiming theoretical and empirical validation.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full-text excerpt does not include the experimental section or any concrete numbers (model sizes, number of teachers, debate rounds, agentic environments, code benchmarks, gains, stability metrics). As a result, specific quantitative findings cannot be faithfully reported here. The critical checks to look for in the paper are: (i) whether MAD-OPD surpasses the strongest single teacher (not just improves over a weaker baseline), (ii) stability improvements in long-horizon settings (variance, failure rate, loss spikes), and (iii) clean ablations separating debate vs simple ensembling, and divergence choices per task type.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Read the Introduction for the three stated limitations (single-teacher ceiling, lack of agentic coverage, ad-hoc divergence choice).
- Focus on the divergence analysis section: the reward-design interpretation and the agentic-vs-code mismatch taxonomy are the most transferable.
- Then inspect the MAD-OPD loop details: how debate transcripts condition teacher distributions, how confidence is defined, and how compute is controlled.
- Finally, scan experiments/ablations for evidence of exceeding the best teacher and for stability metrics beyond mean performance.

recommendation.zh: 值得看方法和消融；若 debate 教师真能越过单教师 ceiling，可直接影响后训练蒸馏数据生成策略。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; if debate teachers truly beat the single-teacher ceiling, it changes distillation data generation.

paper.title: TIP: Token Importance in On-Policy Distillation

summary.core_problem: 在On-Policy Distillation（学生用自身rollout、教师对每个token给分布监督）中，训练成本主要由“对所有token做teacher scoring并反传”造成，但并非所有token都同等提供学习信号。论文要解决的核心问题是：OPD里哪些token位置最“重要”（对一步梯度更新后的期望损失下降贡献最大），以及如何用不增加额外计算的方式挑选这些token，从而在几乎不损性能的情况下显著省显存/算力。
summary.importance: 对预训练/持续训练范式的直接启发很强：它把token-level重要性与训练动态联系起来，给出可落地的“token子采样训练”原则，尤其适用于teacher-student式的持续蒸馏、RL pretrain/在线自举式训练中昂贵的per-token监督场景。贡献量级上：在保留约50% token时可达到与全token训练相当或更好的效果，并报告峰值显存最高可降约47%，更激进保留下显存节省可到约58%。更重要的是提出了结构性盲点：仅用学生熵做采样会系统性漏掉“低熵但师生分歧大”的过度自信错误token，而这些token携带高密度纠错信号；这对设计更稳健的数据/梯度预算分配策略很关键。
summary.technical_approach:
论文提出TIP：用两个训练中“本来就会算”的量刻画每个token位置的状态空间——学生熵h_t（不确定性）与师生散度/分歧δ_t（本质上就是该token的蒸馏损失项，如KL/交叉熵差异）。在(h_t, δ_t)平面上划分四象限：
- Q1：高熵高分歧（不确定且错得多）
- Q2：高熵低分歧（不确定但与教师一致）
- Q3：低熵高分歧（过度自信但错，数量少）
- Q4：低熵低分歧（自信且对，信息量低）
经验上token分布高度不均衡：Q4约40–47%，Q1+Q2约40–52%，Q3仅3–15%但“纠错密度”很高。
理论部分用“一步更新后期望损失下降”的代理目标来定义最优token权重w_t：在β-smooth假设与token可分近似（忽略跨token协方差）下，推导出最优权重与每token梯度统计（期望梯度与二阶矩）相关，并据此证明三点：
(1) oracle权重会强烈偏好高熵区域（Q1/Q2）而抑制Q4；
(2) 任何仅依赖熵的打分都结构性无法区分“低熵且对”(Q4)与“低熵但错”(Q3)，因此会漏掉Q3；
(3) 将分歧δ_t与熵结合可恢复对Q3的覆盖。
为此提出参数无关的Soft-OR打分（直觉上对“高熵”或“高分歧”任一成立就给高权重），在不引入额外teacher调用/额外前向的前提下，仅用现成的h_t与δ_t实现token选择/加权。
summary.experiments:
论文在多个模型家族与两个任务域验证TIP象限与采样策略：数学推理与长时序agentic planning（DeepPlanning）。关键结果包括：
- 仅用熵采样：保留50% token即可匹配或超过全token训练，同时峰值显存最多降低约47%；更激进的保留率下显存节省最高约58%，但熵采样开始因漏掉Q3而出现性能回落。
- Soft-OR（熵+分歧）：在数学推理上稳定优于仅熵选择，说明Q3类“过度自信错误token”对纠错很关键。
- 任务差异：在DeepPlanning这类长时序规划域，论文观察到“Q3-only选择最强”（至少在其设置下最占优/最稳健），暗示规划任务中模型更常出现“自信但走偏”的关键分叉点，纠错信号集中在少量低熵高分歧token。
此外，论文给出象限占比范围（Q3为3–15%）与token级案例（附录B.4）来解释Q1/Q3的语义特征。你若要复现/迁移，需重点核对：OPD损失具体形式（δ_t定义）、token保留率策略、以及不同任务域下象限阈值/分位数划分方式（文中以entropy/divergence阈值划象限）。
summary.reading_guide:
精读建议（建议2–3小时）：
1）Section 4（TIP Taxonomy）+ Figure 2/Table 1：先建立四象限的直觉、占比分布与为何Q3虽少但关键；
2）Section 5（Theoretical Analysis）+ Appendix A：重点看一步更新代理目标、token可分近似、以及“熵对Q3结构性盲”的证明（Proposition 2）——这是方法正当性的核心；
3）Section 7实验主结果：对比entropy-only vs Soft-OR vs Q3-only在不同保留率下的曲线，关注何时开始掉点以及掉点对应的象限覆盖变化；
4）Appendix B.4 token案例：理解Q3在语义上通常对应哪些“自信走错”的位置（例如数学推理中的关键转折、规划中的关键动作选择）。
值得深挖的研究点：把TIP从“采样/丢token”推广到“自适应loss reweighting/动态序列截断/按象限分配teacher compute”；以及在RL pretrain或持续学习中，δ_t可否用价值差/优势函数替代，形成统一的token级预算分配框架。

summary_en.core_problem: On-policy distillation (OPD) is expensive because the teacher provides token-level supervision on the student’s own rollouts, yet not every token position contributes equally to learning. The paper asks which tokens carry the most useful learning signal in OPD and how to select them using only quantities already computed during training, reducing memory/compute without hurting performance.
summary_en.importance: High relevance to pretraining and continual distillation regimes: it provides a principled token-budget allocation rule for settings where per-token supervision is costly (teacher-student continual training, online distillation, RL-pretrain-like bootstrapping with dense token losses). Reported impact is practical and sizable: keeping ~50% of tokens via entropy-based sampling can match or beat all-token training while cutting peak memory by up to ~47%; more aggressive retention reaches up to ~58% peak-memory savings. Conceptually, it identifies a critical blind spot of entropy-only selection: it systematically drops low-entropy but high teacher–student divergence tokens (overconfident mistakes) that contain dense corrective signal.
summary_en.technical_approach:
TIP frames token importance in a 2D state space defined by (i) student entropy h_t and (ii) teacher–student divergence δ_t (essentially the per-token distillation disagreement already present in the OPD loss). Crossing the two axes yields four quadrants: high-entropy/high-divergence (Q1), high-entropy/low-divergence (Q2), low-entropy/high-divergence (Q3: overconfident wrong), and low-entropy/low-divergence (Q4: confident correct). Empirically, Q3 is rare (3–15%) but disproportionately valuable.
The theory defines “importance” via a one-step expected loss decrease objective: under β-smoothness and a token-separable approximation (ignoring cross-token gradient covariance), the optimal per-token weight depends on token-wise gradient statistics. This leads to three key results: (1) an oracle strongly favors high-entropy regions over Q4; (2) any entropy-only score is structurally unable to distinguish Q3 from Q4 (both low entropy), hence misses overconfident errors; (3) incorporating divergence restores coverage. Based on this, the paper proposes a parameter-free Soft-OR score that boosts tokens that are either high-entropy or high-divergence, requiring no extra computation beyond standard OPD.
summary_en.experiments: Validated across multiple model families and two domains: mathematical reasoning and long-horizon agentic planning (DeepPlanning). Main findings: (i) entropy-based selection at 50% retention matches/exceeds all-token training while reducing peak memory by up to ~47%; (ii) at more aggressive retention, entropy-only begins to degrade because it drops Q3 tokens; (iii) Soft-OR (entropy + divergence) consistently improves over entropy-only on math reasoning; (iv) in DeepPlanning, Q3-only selection is reported as strongest/most effective in their setup, suggesting planning errors concentrate in a small set of overconfident-but-wrong decision points. The paper also reports quadrant mass statistics (Q4 ~40–47%, Q1+Q2 ~40–52%, Q3 ~3–15%) and provides token-level examples (Appendix B.4) illustrating Q1/Q3 behavior.
summary_en.reading_guide: Deep-read path (2–3 hours): (1) TIP taxonomy section + the quadrant figure/table to internalize what each region means and why Q3 matters despite being small; (2) the theory section + Appendix A to understand the one-step descent surrogate, the separability assumption, and the proof of entropy’s structural blindness to Q3 (Proposition 2); (3) main experiments (Section 7) focusing on retention-rate sweeps and where entropy-only starts failing; (4) Appendix B.4 token examples to build intuition about what Q3 looks like in math/planning. Good follow-ups: extend TIP from hard token dropping to adaptive loss reweighting, dynamic truncation, or teacher-compute allocation; explore RL-pretrain analogs where δ_t could be replaced by advantage/value disagreement.

recommendation.zh: 给OPD蒸馏一个可落地的token子采样准则，且指出“只按学生熵采样会漏高纠错token”的坑；应直接接入省显存训练管线验证。
recommendation.en: Provides a practical token-subsampling rule for OPD and exposes the trap of entropy-only sampling missing high-correction tokens; I’d plug this into our distillation pipeline to cut memory.

paper.title: Rethinking On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models: Phenomenology, Mechanism, and Recipe

summary.core_problem: 论文聚焦 OPD（On-Policy Distillation，学生自采样轨迹、教师提供逐 token log-prob 作为稠密监督）在大模型后训练中“有时极其有效、有时完全失效”的核心不确定性：为什么更强的 teacher 反而可能无法提升 student？OPD 成功/失败由哪些可观测条件决定？其 token 级训练动力学与梯度信号到底来自哪里？以及如何把这些机制总结成可复现的训练配方来修复失败配置。
summary.importance:
对预训练/持续学习/训练动态研究的影响主要体现在“机制与配方”层面：
1) 给出 OPD 成功的两个必要条件（思维模式一致性 + teacher 必须带来 student 未见的新能力），把以往“teacher 更强→更好蒸馏”的直觉拆解为可检验的分布条件，为后续做 scaling/数据配比/持续蒸馏提供了诊断指标。
2) 提供 token 级机制证据：OPD 的有效梯度主要集中在 student-teacher 的 top-k 重叠 token 集合上；并展示成功运行的统一动力学签名（overlap 上升、entropy gap 收敛、概率质量集中）。这对理解“稠密监督为何有效/为何会失效”很关键，也能指导更稳健的蒸馏目标设计（例如只监督重叠集、或显式提升初始重叠）。
3) 给出可操作的修复 recipe（off-policy cold start、teacher-aligned prompt selection）并分析稠密监督随轨迹深度退化的成本，直接服务工业后训练流水线。

从基座研究视角，它不是新的预训练目标，但它把 OPD 作为一种“持续学习/自举式改进”的核心算子进行机制化解释，对未来 RL-pretrain、长链路推理蒸馏、以及 agentic 轨迹学习的稳定性研究都有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach:
全文结构是“现象学→机制→配方→成本/局限”的闭环。

(1) 现象学：两条成功条件
- 条件 A：Thinking-pattern consistency（思维模式一致）。作者用 student 与 teacher 的 top-k token 分布重叠度（overlap ratio）来刻画：如果初始重叠很低，即便 teacher benchmark 更高，OPD 也可能无法把 student 拉到 teacher 分布附近。
- 条件 B：Higher scores ≠ 新知识。即使思维模式一致、teacher 分数更高，如果 teacher 与 student 来自同数据同训练配方、只是 scale 更大，那么从 student 视角看 teacher 分布可能“不可区分”（distributionally indistinguishable），teacher 并没有提供 student 未见过的可迁移信号，OPD 增益会很小。
- 通过 weak-to-strong 的 reverse distillation 进一步验证：OPD 学到的本质是“思维模式/分布形状”，而不是简单地追逐 benchmark 分数。

(2) token 级机制：梯度信号的主承载体是 overlap tokens
- 成功 OPD 的统一签名：在 student 访问到的状态上，student 与 teacher 分布逐步变得更相似：top-k overlap ratio 持续上升；两者 entropy gap 逐渐缩小；重叠 token 集合承载了 97–99% 的联合概率质量。
- 失败 OPD：overlap 停滞、entropy mismatch 从一开始就存在并持续。
- 关键验证：只对“重叠 token 集合”施加监督，效果可匹配完整 top-k 监督，说明 OPD 的有效梯度主要来自重叠集；非重叠部分对优化贡献小或噪声大。

(3) Recipe：两种互补的失败修复策略
- Off-policy cold start：先用 teacher 生成的 rollouts 做一段 SFT warmup，提高初始 overlap，缩小思维模式差距，再切换到 OPD。
- Teacher-aligned prompt selection：用 teacher 后训练数据分布中的 prompts 来做 OPD，使监督集中在 teacher 高概率 token 上，更易对齐；但会导致 student entropy 显著降低（更“尖”/更保守），因此需要与 out-of-distribution prompts 混合以避免过拟合/塌缩。

(4) 稠密监督的成本与长轨迹问题
- reward 质量随 trajectory depth 系统性下降；不稳定性往往从后段 token 开始并向前传播。
- 重要观察：即便“失败 teacher”，其 reward 与 rollout 正确性在全局上仍相关，失败更像是局部优化几何问题：更大的 teacher 可能让 student 附近的 reward landscape 局部变平，导致 token 级梯度虽“方向正确”但幅度/曲率不足以推动策略更新。

整体上，作者把 OPD 从经验技巧提升为可诊断、可修复、可解释的训练算子，并给出一套与 token 分布几何直接对应的指标体系（overlap、entropy gap、probability mass concentration）。
summary.experiments:
从你提供的全文片段（引言+部分机制结论）中可以确定的关键数字/结论包括：
- 成功 OPD 的 top-k overlap ratio：从 72% 上升到 91%。
- 重叠 top-k token 承载的联合概率质量：97–99%。
- 只监督 overlap tokens 的实验：性能可匹配完整 top-k 监督（定性结论，片段未给具体分数）。
- 失败运行的特征：overlap 与 entropy gap 基本不动。
- reverse distillation 结论：同家族 1.5B 与 7B teacher 在 student 视角“分布不可区分”，因此即便 teacher 更强也可能不给增益。
- 长轨迹分析：reward 质量随深度下降，后段 token 先不稳定并向前传播；失败并非 reward 全局无信息，而是局部几何导致梯度无效。

但当前片段缺失大量你可能关心的“可复现细节数字”：具体 benchmark（数学/代码/指令遵循？）、OPD 目标形式（KL/advantage 形式/温度/截断 top-k 的 k 值）、训练步数与学习率、prompt 数量与来源、cold start 的长度、以及不同 teacher/student 组合的完整表格。精读时应去 §3–§6 的图表中补齐这些信息。
summary.reading_guide:
精读建议（must_read，建议 2–3 小时，带着复现实验的目的读）：
1) §3 Phenomenology：重点找“两个条件”的量化定义与判据（thinking-pattern consistency 的具体指标、k 的选择、阈值/相关性），以及 reverse distillation 的实验设置（同数据同配方如何定义、为何导致 indistinguishable）。
2) §4 Mechanism：精读 token 级分析图（overlap ratio 曲线、entropy gap、probability mass concentration），以及“只监督 overlap tokens≈全 top-k”的对照实验——这是全文最关键的机制证据，直接影响你如何设计更稳的 OPD loss。
3) §5 Recipe：把 cold start 与 prompt selection 当成可落地配方读，关注：warmup 需要多长、prompt mixing 比例、entropy 下降的副作用如何监控。
4) §6 Cost/Instability：重点看“深度越长 reward 越差”的定量曲线与不稳定传播分析；如果你做 RL-pretrain/agent 轨迹蒸馏，这部分决定 OPD 的适用边界。

值得深挖的研究点：
- 能否把 overlap ratio 作为训练时的在线诊断/早停信号？
- 能否设计显式提升 overlap 的目标（例如对齐 logits 的低秩子空间、或对非重叠 token 做更强的温度/平滑）？
- “teacher 造成局部平坦”这一假设能否用 Hessian/梯度噪声尺度进一步验证，并导出更好的优化器/学习率策略？
- 长轨迹下稠密监督退化：是否需要分段蒸馏、信用分配重加权、或与 outcome reward 混合？

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why On-Policy Distillation (OPD)—where the student samples its own rollouts and receives dense per-token supervision from a teacher—can be highly effective in some settings yet completely fail in others, sometimes even when the teacher is objectively stronger. It asks: what observable conditions govern OPD success vs failure, what is the token-level mechanism that actually drives learning, and what practical recipes can reliably recover OPD when it breaks.
summary_en.importance:
For foundation-model training research, the contribution is a rare mechanism-driven account of a widely used post-training primitive:
- It replaces the naive "stronger teacher helps" assumption with two testable distributional requirements (thinking-pattern compatibility and genuine novelty beyond the student’s training exposure), which is directly relevant to scaling, continual distillation, and data/recipe design.
- It identifies a concrete locus of effective gradients: the student–teacher top-k overlap tokens, supported by dynamics (overlap growth, entropy-gap closure, probability-mass concentration). This can inform more stable OPD objectives and diagnostics.
- It provides actionable recovery recipes (off-policy cold start; teacher-aligned prompt selection) and analyzes dense-supervision degradation with trajectory depth—highly relevant for long-horizon reasoning and agentic rollouts.

While not a new pretraining objective, it elevates OPD into a measurable, debuggable operator for continual improvement pipelines and potentially RL-pretrain-style self-bootstrapping.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper is organized as phenomenology → mechanism → recipe → cost/limits.

1) Phenomenology: two governing conditions.
(A) Thinking-pattern consistency: student and teacher must have compatible next-token distributions, quantified via top-k overlap ratio. If initial overlap is low, OPD often cannot recover even if the teacher scores higher.
(B) Higher benchmark scores do not imply new transferable knowledge: if teacher and student share the same data and training recipe (only scale differs), they may converge to distributions that are indistinguishable from the student’s perspective, leaving little signal for OPD.
Reverse distillation experiments are used to validate these claims and to argue OPD primarily learns "thinking patterns" (distributional behavior) rather than merely chasing benchmark metrics.

2) Token-level mechanism.
Successful OPD shows a consistent signature on student-visited states: increasing top-k overlap, shrinking entropy gap, and the overlap set capturing nearly all probability mass. Failing runs show stagnant overlap and persistent entropy mismatch.
A key test: supervising only the overlap tokens matches full top-k supervision, implying the overlap set is the main carrier of useful gradients.

3) Practical recipes.
- Off-policy cold start: warm up with SFT on teacher-generated rollouts to raise initial overlap, then switch to OPD.
- Teacher-aligned prompt selection: use prompts from the teacher’s post-training distribution to sharpen alignment on high-probability tokens; mitigate entropy collapse by mixing with out-of-distribution prompts.

4) Cost/instability with depth.
Reward quality degrades with trajectory depth; instability starts at later tokens and propagates backward. Even "failing" teachers provide globally informative reward, suggesting failure is due to local optimization geometry (e.g., a locally flat landscape around the student induced by a larger teacher), not purely reward noise.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text excerpt, the main quantitative/empirical anchors are:
- In successful OPD, top-k overlap ratio increases from 72% to 91%.
- The shared top-k overlap tokens account for 97–99% of the combined probability mass.
- Overlap-only supervision performs on par with full top-k supervision (qualitative claim in the excerpt).
- Failing runs exhibit stagnant overlap and persistent entropy mismatch.
- Reverse distillation indicates same-family 1.5B and 7B teachers can be distributionally indistinguishable to the student, explaining why a stronger teacher may not help.
- Dense supervision degrades with trajectory depth; instability originates at later tokens and propagates backward.

The excerpt does not include full benchmark tables, exact OPD loss details (k, temperature, weighting), training budgets, or prompt/data scales; those should be extracted from Sections 3–6 in the full paper for reproducibility.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Deep-read guide (2–3 hours, aiming to reuse the recipe):
- Section 3 (Phenomenology): focus on how thinking-pattern consistency is measured (top-k overlap definition, choice of k, thresholds) and how "new knowledge" is operationalized in reverse distillation.
- Section 4 (Mechanism): study the plots for overlap ratio, entropy gap, and probability-mass concentration; the overlap-only supervision experiment is the key mechanistic evidence.
- Section 5 (Recipe): treat as an implementation manual—how long the cold start is, how prompts are selected/mixed, and how entropy collapse is monitored.
- Section 6 (Cost/Instability): extract the depth-vs-reward degradation curves and the instability propagation analysis; this sets the boundary for long-horizon reasoning/agentic OPD.

Research angles worth probing: online overlap-based diagnostics/early stopping, objectives that explicitly increase overlap, verifying the "local flatness" hypothesis via curvature/gradient-noise analyses, and hybrid schemes for long trajectories (segmenting, reweighting, mixing outcome rewards).

recommendation.zh: 它改变我对 OPD 的 prior：teacher 更强不等于更好，先检查思维模式一致与 top-k overlap 动力学；建议立刻按其诊断指标复现实验。
recommendation.en: It updates my OPD prior: a stronger teacher isn’t automatically better—check reasoning-mode match and top-k overlap dynamics first; I’d replicate their diagnostics immediately.

paper.title: Lightning OPD: Efficient Post-Training for Large Reasoning Models with Offline On-Policy Distillation

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的核心问题是：OPD（On-Policy Distillation）在推理/后训练中效果好但强依赖“训练时实时teacher打分（log-prob）”的在线服务，导致基础设施成本高、复现困难；能否把OPD做成离线（预先算好teacher log-prob并复用）同时不掉性能？作者进一步指出：离线OPD失败的根因并不只是“离线近似”，而是一个被忽视但对任何OPD都必要的条件——SFT阶段生成轨迹的teacher与OPD阶段提供分布监督的teacher必须一致（teacher consistency），否则目标函数存在不可消除的偏差，在线/离线都会收敛到次优不动点。
summary.importance:
对后训练范式的贡献很实：
- 方法论层面：把“teacher consistency”提升为OPD管线的必要条件，解释了社区里常见做法（SFT用最强teacher产数据、OPD用另一个teacher做分布监督）为何会系统性伤害OPD，并给出理论化的偏差/不动点解释。这对构建可扩展、可复现的推理模型后训练流水线影响很大。
- 工程与效率层面：提出Lightning OPD把OPD从“必须在线teacher”改造成“离线一次性预计算teacher log-prob”，在保持（甚至超过）标准OPD效果的同时，去掉并行teacher serving，报告约4×训练加速/成本下降。
- 对预训练研究的启发：虽然属于post-training，但它揭示了“数据生成分布与蒸馏监督分布一致性”这一更一般的原则，可迁移到持续学习/自蒸馏/离线RL式预训练（RL pretrain）中：当你用A模型生成轨迹、用B模型提供token级密集监督时，优化目标可能内生偏置，scale数据也不一定能修正。
summary.technical_approach:
1）问题诊断：作者先观察到OPD阶段student相对SFT reference的分布漂移并不大（与近期RLVR分析一致：RL轨迹多为SFT轨迹的重加权子集、KL约束导致靠近reference），因此提出“离线预计算teacher log-prob并复用”看似可行；但朴素离线OPD效果不稳定。
2）关键条件：teacher consistency。OPD涉及两类teacher：
- SFT teacher：用于生成SFT训练轨迹/示范；
- OPD teacher：用于对student rollout给出token级分布（log-prob）与advantage信号。
作者指出两者不一致会在OPD目标中引入不可消除的偏差，使训练无论在线/离线、无论训练多久/数据多大，都收敛到次优固定点；离线情形更糟，因为rollout分布也被“错误teacher生成的SFT轨迹”锁死。
3）Lightning OPD框架（离线OPD的正确打开方式）：
- 选择一个teacher π_T；
- SFT阶段：用该teacher生成的轨迹对base model做SFT，得到reference policy π_ref；
- OPD阶段：从π_ref采样rollouts（固定分布），对这些固定responses一次性预计算同一个teacher π_T 的log-prob并缓存；训练时用缓存的teacher分布做OPD更新，无需在线teacher server。
4）理论结果（论文声称）：在teacher一致时，Lightning OPD与标准OPD共享相同最优解；两者梯度差异在训练过程中有界；离线目标还带来“隐式正则”抑制policy drift，从而不需要显式惩罚项（例如额外KL penalty）。这些结论共同解释了为何“离线可行”以及为何“必须一致”。
summary.experiments:
论文在数学推理与代码任务上评测Lightning OPD：
- 模型对：包含Qwen3-4B学生配Qwen3-8B teacher，以及Qwen3-8B学生配Qwen3-32B teacher等。
- 结论：Lightning OPD在所有基准上匹配或超过标准（在线）OPD；并通过移除并行teacher serving带来约4.0×加速。
- 论文还在引言中给出一个现实管线的反例：SFT数据由QwQ-32B生成，但OPD teacher用Qwen3-32B（不一致），作者预测并验证这种不一致会伤害OPD。
（注：当前提供的全文片段未包含各benchmark的具体分数表、训练token量/步数、OPD损失形式与超参、以及teacher不一致的定量退化幅度；精读时需要重点核对实验章节的数字与消融。）
summary.reading_guide:
精读建议（建议60–90分钟，优先级高）：
- 先精读“teacher consistency”的形式化定义与理论推导：作者如何刻画“不一致导致不可消除偏差/次优固定点”，以及在一致时为何离线与在线共享同一最优解、梯度差异为何有界。
- 重点看实验消融（若正文有）：
  1）一致 vs 不一致teacher的性能差距（最好按任务/模型对分解）；
  2）离线预计算在不同rollout分布（π_ref vs 训练中student）下的敏感性；
  3）“隐式正则防漂移”的证据：例如KL随训练变化、长训练是否更稳。
- 关注工程细节：缓存teacher log-prob的存储/IO开销、token级advantage如何计算、是否需要重算/分片、对长序列与大batch的吞吐影响。
- 值得深挖的研究点：把该一致性原则推广到更一般的“数据生成模型≠监督模型”的蒸馏/持续学习场景；以及是否能在允许不一致时，通过重要性采样/校正项消除偏差（论文声称不可消除，需看其假设边界）。

summary_en.core_problem: OPD (On-Policy Distillation) is effective for post-training reasoning models but typically requires a live teacher server to score every student rollout, creating major infrastructure and reproducibility barriers. The paper asks whether OPD can be made offline by precomputing teacher log-probabilities once and reusing them—then explains why naive offline OPD fails and identifies a necessary condition for any OPD pipeline: the teacher used to generate SFT trajectories must be the same teacher used to provide OPD distributional supervision (teacher consistency).
summary_en.importance:
This is a high-impact post-training paper with clear implications for scalable foundation-model training:
- Conceptual contribution: elevates “teacher consistency” from an implementation detail to a necessary condition, explaining systematic failures when SFT demonstrations come from one model while OPD supervision comes from another. The claim is strong: inconsistency induces an irreducible bias and a suboptimal fixed point even for online OPD, not just offline.
- Practical contribution: Lightning OPD removes the need for parallel teacher serving by caching teacher log-probs offline, reporting ~4× speedup while matching or exceeding standard OPD on reasoning/code benchmarks.
- Broader research lesson relevant to continual learning / self-distillation / RL-pretrain-like pipelines: mixing a data-generation policy and a different token-level supervising policy can bake in objective bias that does not vanish with more compute or data, so “distributional alignment” between generation and supervision matters as much as raw teacher strength.
summary_en.technical_approach:
1) Empirical motivation: student policies in OPD tend to drift only modestly from the SFT reference (consistent with observations that RL trajectories are largely reweighted SFT trajectories and KL constraints keep policies near the reference), suggesting offline reuse of teacher scores might work.
2) Root-cause analysis: OPD implicitly involves two teachers—an SFT teacher that produced the trajectories used to train the reference policy, and an OPD teacher that provides token-level distribution targets/advantages during distillation. If these differ, the OPD objective becomes biased; the paper argues this bias is irreducible and leads to convergence to a suboptimal fixed point regardless of training length or data scale. Offline OPD is further harmed because the rollout distribution is fixed to the (already mismatched) reference.
3) Lightning OPD (offline OPD done right): choose a single teacher π_T; (i) generate SFT trajectories with π_T and fine-tune the base model to obtain π_ref; (ii) sample rollouts from π_ref and precompute π_T log-probabilities once over these fixed responses; (iii) train the student with OPD using cached teacher scores—no live teacher server.
4) Theory claims: under teacher consistency, Lightning OPD shares the same optimum as standard OPD; the gradient discrepancy remains bounded during training; and the offline objective provides implicit regularization that limits policy drift without an explicit penalty term.
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluations are reported on math reasoning and code generation with multiple student–teacher pairs, including Qwen3-4B distilled from Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-8B distilled from Qwen3-32B. The headline results are: Lightning OPD matches or outperforms standard (online) OPD across benchmarks while delivering ~4.0× speedup by eliminating parallel teacher serving. The introduction also highlights a real-world inconsistent setup (SFT trajectories from QwQ-32B but OPD teacher as Qwen3-32B) as a predicted failure mode.
(Note: the provided excerpt does not include detailed score tables, training budgets, or ablation magnitudes; those should be verified in the main experiment section.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
How to read (60–90 minutes, worth a deep pass):
- Start with the formal definition and theoretical section on teacher consistency: locate the exact assumptions under which inconsistency yields an irreducible bias/suboptimal fixed point, and the proof that offline and online share the same optimum when consistent.
- Then read the ablations (if present): consistent vs inconsistent teacher, offline vs online, sensitivity to rollout distribution choice, and evidence for the claimed “implicit regularization” (e.g., KL drift curves).
- Finally, check the engineering details: how teacher log-probs are stored/sharded, I/O overhead, how per-token advantages are computed, and how this scales with long sequences.
- Research follow-ups to consider: whether bias under inconsistency can be corrected via importance weighting or explicit correction terms, and how the principle generalizes to continual/self-distillation pipelines.

recommendation.zh: 必须看其“teacher consistency”结论：SFT 产轨迹与 OPD 打分 teacher 不一致会系统性收敛到次优；动作是把你们蒸馏流水线 teacher 统一并离线缓存 logprob。
recommendation.en: Must-read for the “teacher consistency” constraint: mismatching the SFT trajectory teacher and OPD scoring teacher drives systematic suboptimal convergence; action item—unify teachers and cache logprobs offline.
